===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\Health.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  HiServer, HiDatabase, HiStatusOnline, HiCloud, HiMail,
  HiCash, HiShieldCheck, HiRefresh, HiClock, HiChip,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Spinner';
import { getDetailedHealth } from '../../services/hdmisp/health';

const REFRESH_MS = 30000;

const OK_STATES = ['up', 'enabled', 'connected', 'healthy', 'configured'];
const WARN_STATES = ['disabled', 'degraded', 'idle', 'separate_process'];

function StatusDot({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn = WARN_STATES.includes(status);
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
        ok ? 'bg-green-500' : warn ? 'bg-yellow-500' : 'bg-red-500'
      }`}
    />
  );
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn = WARN_STATES.includes(status);
  return (
    <Badge variant={ok ? 'success' : warn ? 'warning' : 'danger'} dot>
      {status || 'unknown'}
    </Badge>
  );
}

function ServiceCard({ icon: Icon, title, status, children }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{title}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot status={status} />
          <StatusBadge status={status} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">{children}</dl>
    </Card>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value, mono }) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd
        className={`text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs text-right truncate ${
          mono ? 'font-mono' : ''
        }`}
        title={String(value)}
      >
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, hint }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-[var(--text-muted)] uppercase tracking-wider">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-0.5 truncate">
        {value ?? 'â€”'}
      </p>
      {hint && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5 truncate">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Health() {
  const inFlight = useRef(false);

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);
  const [degraded, setDegraded] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    if (!silent) setLoading(true);

    try {
      const payload = await getDetailedHealth();
      if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && payload.server) {
        setData(payload);
        setLastUpdated(new Date());
        setErrorMsg(null);
        setDegraded(payload.status !== 'healthy');
      } else if (!silent) {
        setErrorMsg('Health endpoint returned an unexpected payload.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!silent) {
        setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Failed to load health');
      }
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (!silent) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(() => load(true), REFRESH_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [load]);

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-3 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {errorMsg || 'Health data unavailable.'}
        </p>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => load()}
          loading={loading}
          icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
        >
          Retry
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const s = data.server || {};
  const cpu = s.cpu || {};
  const mem = s.memory || {};
  const db = data.database || {};
  const cloud = data.cloudinary || {};
  const bridge = data.hdmBridge || {};
  const mpesa = data.mpesa || {};
  const radius = data.radius || {};
  const schedulers = data.schedulers || {};
  const overall = data.overall || { up: 0, total: 0 };
  const counts = data.data || {};
  const activity = data.activity || {};
  const isHealthy = !degraded && data.status === 'healthy';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              System Health
            </h1>
            <Badge variant={isHealthy ? 'success' : 'warning'} dot>
              {data.status || 'unknown'}
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="info">
              {overall.up ?? 0}/{overall.total ?? 0} services
            </Badge>
          </div>
          {lastUpdated && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Updated {lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString()} Â· auto-refresh 30s
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          icon={<HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />}
          onClick={() => load()}
          loading={loading}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <HiServer className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {s.appName || 'API server'}
            </span>
            <Badge variant="default">v{s.version || 'â€”'}</Badge>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <StatusDot status={s.status} />
            <StatusBadge status={s.status} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <Stat label="Node" value={s.node} />
          <Stat label="Environment" value={s.env} />
          <Stat label="Platform" value={s.platformFull} hint={s.arch} />
          <Stat label="Uptime" value={s.uptimeHuman} />
          <Stat label="CPU cores" value={cpu.cores} hint={cpu.model} />
          <Stat
            label="Load (1m/5m/15m)"
            value={cpu.loadAvg ? cpu.loadAvg.map((v) => v.toFixed(2)).join(' / ') : 'â€”'}
          />
          <Stat
            label="Memory (RSS)"
            value={`${mem.rssMb ?? 0} MB`}
            hint={`heap ${mem.heapUsedMb ?? 0}/${mem.heapTotalMb ?? 0} MB`}
          />
          <Stat
            label="System memory"
            value={`${mem.freeSystemMb ?? 0} / ${mem.totalSystemMb ?? 0} MB`}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <ServiceCard icon={HiDatabase} title="Database" status={db.status}>
          <Row label="Database" value={db.database} mono />
          <Row label="Host" value={db.host} mono />
          <Row label="Collections" value={db.collections} />
          <Row label="Documents" value={(db.documents ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
          <Row label="Ping" value={db.pingMs != null ? `${db.pingMs} ms` : null} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiCloud} title="Cloudinary" status={cloud.status}>
          <Row label="Cloud" value={cloud.cloud} mono />
          <Row label="Folder" value={cloud.folder} mono />
          <Row label="Ping" value={cloud.pingMs != null ? `${cloud.pingMs} ms` : null} />
          <Row label="Message" value={cloud.message} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiMail} title="HDM Bridge" status={bridge.status}>
          <Row label="From email" value={bridge.fromEmail} mono />
          <Row label="From name" value={bridge.fromName} />
          <Row label="SMS sender" value={bridge.smsSender} mono />
          <Row label="Email" value={bridge.emailEnabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'} />
          <Row label="SMS" value={bridge.smsEnabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiCash} title="M-Pesa" status={mpesa.status}>
          <Row label="Env" value={mpesa.env} />
          <Row label="Type" value={mpesa.transactionType} />
          <Row label="Shortcode" value={mpesa.shortCode} mono />
          <Row label="Till" value={mpesa.tillNumber} mono />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiStatusOnline} title="RADIUS" status={radius.status}>
          <Row label="Rate-limit attr" value={radius.rateLimitAttribute} mono />
          <Row label="Session timeout" value={radius.sessionTimeout} />
          <Row label="Acct interval" value={radius.acctInterimInterval} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiClock} title="Schedulers" status={schedulers.status}>
          <Row label="In-process" value={schedulers.inProcess ? 'Yes' : 'No'} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiChip} title="Data" status="up">
          <Row label="Providers" value={counts.providers} />
          <Row label="Admins" value={counts.admins} />
          <Row label="Customers" value={counts.customers} />
          <Row label="Sessions" value={(counts.sessions ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
          <Row label="Transactions" value={(counts.transactions ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
          <Row label="Notifications" value={(counts.notifications ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
        </ServiceCard>

        <ServiceCard icon={HiShieldCheck} title="Activity (24h)" status="up">

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiExternalLink } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { getInvoice } from '../../services/hdmisp/invoices';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatMoney';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

export default function InvoiceDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const inv = await getInvoice(id);
      setInvoice(inv);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load invoice');
      navigate('/hdmisp/invoices');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20"><Spinner size="lg" /></div>;
  }

  if (!invoice) return null;

  const inv = invoice;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={() => navigate('/hdmisp/invoices')}>
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono">{inv.invoiceNumber}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            Issued {inv.issuedAt ? formatDateTime(inv.issuedAt) : 'â€”'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(inv.status)} dot>{statusLabel(inv.status)}</Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <Card title="Summary" className="lg:col-span-2">
          <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Total</dt>
              <dd className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">{formatMoneyMajor(inv.total, inv.currency || 'KES')}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Amount due</dt>
              <dd className={`text-2xl font-bold mt-1 ${(inv.amountDue || 0) > 0 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'}`}>
                {formatMoneyMajor(inv.amountDue ?? 0, inv.currency || 'KES')}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Due date</dt>
              <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">{inv.dueDate ? formatDate(inv.dueDate) : 'â€”'}</dd>
            </div>
            {inv.paidAt && (
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Paid at</dt>
                <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">{formatDateTime(inv.paidAt)}</dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Customer">
          {inv.customerSnapshot ? (
            <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <Row label="Name">{inv.customerSnapshot.name}</Row>
              <Row label="Email">{inv.customerSnapshot.email}</Row>
              {inv.customerSnapshot.phone && <Row label="Phone">{inv.customerSnapshot.phone}</Row>}
            </dl>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No snapshot</p>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      {Array.isArray(inv.items) && inv.items.length > 0 && (
        <Card title="Items" padding={false}>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase text-xs">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Description</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Qty</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Unit</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Subtotal</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
                {inv.items.map((it, i) => (
                  <tr key={i}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-[var(--text-primary)]">{it.name || it.description || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-[var(--text-primary)]">{it.qty ?? it.quantity ?? 1}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-[var(--text-primary)]">{formatMoneyMajor(it.unitPrice ?? 0, inv.currency || 'KES')}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{formatMoneyMajor(it.subtotal ?? it.total ?? 0, inv.currency || 'KES')}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {Array.isArray(inv.paymentInstructions) && inv.paymentInstructions.length > 0 && (
        <Card title="Payment instructions">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {inv.paymentInstructions.map((m, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] rounded-lg p-3">
                <p className="font-medium text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">{m.title || m.code}</p>
                {m.description && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{m.description}</p>}
                {m.recipient && (
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-0.5 text-xs">
                    {Object.entries(m.recipient).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k, v]) => (
                      <div key={k} className="flex gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)] capitalize">{k}:</span>
                        <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono">{String(v)}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {inv.invoiceUrl && (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <a href={inv.invoiceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
            <Button variant="outline" icon={<HiExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />}>View full invoice</Button>
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-right text-xs break-all">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiEye, HiRefresh, HiDocumentText } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Pagination from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Pagination';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { getInvoices } from '../../services/hdmisp/invoices';
import { getProviders } from '../../services/hdmisp/providers';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatMoney';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel, PAGE_LIMIT } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

const STATUSES = ['draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled'];

export default function Invoices() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [providerId, setProviderId] = useState('');
  const [providers, setProviders] = useState([]);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getInvoices({
        page,
        limit: PAGE_LIMIT,
        status: status || undefined,
        providerId: providerId || undefined,
      });
      setItems(res.data || []);
      setMeta({
        page: res.meta?.page || 1,
        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,
        total: res.meta?.total || 0,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load invoices');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, status, providerId, toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    getProviders({ limit: 200 }).then((r) => setProviders(r.data || [])).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'invoiceNumber',
      label: 'Invoice',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)]">{row.invoiceNumber}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'total',
      label: 'Total',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{formatMoneyMajor(row.total, row.currency || 'KES')}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'amountDue',
      label: 'Due',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className={row.amountDue > 0 ? 'font-medium text-red-500' : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'}>
          {formatMoneyMajor(row.amountDue ?? 0, row.currency || 'KES')}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>{statusLabel(row.status)}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'issuedAt',
      label: 'Issued',
      render: (row) => <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.issuedAt ? formatDate(row.issuedAt) : 'â€”'}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: 'dueDate',
      label: 'Due',
      render: (row) => <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.dueDate ? formatDate(row.dueDate) : 'â€”'}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); navigate(`/hdmisp/invoices/${row._id}`); }}>
          <HiEye className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Invoices</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} invoice{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={load} loading={loading}>
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
            <button onClick={() => { setStatus(''); setPage(1); }} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${!status ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}`} type="button">All</button>
            {STATUSES.map((s) => (
              <button key={s} onClick={() => { setStatus(s); setPage(1); }} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${status === s ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}`} type="button">{statusLabel(s)}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="w-full sm:w-64">
            <select value={providerId} onChange={(e) => { setProviderId(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm">
              <option value="">All providers</option>
              {providers.map((p) => <option key={p._id} value={p._id}>{p.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          {loading && !items.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (

              <HiDocumentText className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No invoices match your filters</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table columns={columns} data={items} rowKey={(r) => r._id} onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/hdmisp/invoices/${r._id}`)} />
              <Pagination page={meta.page} totalPages={meta.totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\Legal.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { HiPlus, HiPencil, HiTrash, HiScale, HiEye } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Select';
import Toggle from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Toggle';
import Modal from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import Spinner from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import { getLegalDocs, createLegalDoc, updateLegalDoc, deleteLegalDoc } from '../../services/hdmisp/legal';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { LEGAL_TYPES, statusLabel } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

const EMPTY = { type: 'terms', title: '', content: '', version: '1.0', isActive: true };

export default function Legal() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();
  const [docs, setDocs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, mode: 'create', doc: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [viewTarget, setViewTarget] = useState(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(null);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getLegalDocs();
      setDocs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load legal docs');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm({ ...EMPTY });
    setModal({ open: true, mode: 'create', doc: null });
  };

  const openEdit = (d) => {
    setForm({ type: d.type || 'terms', title: d.title || '', content: d.content || '', version: d.version || '1.0', isActive: d.isActive !== false });
    setModal({ open: true, mode: 'edit', doc: d });
  };

  const patch = (k, v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));

  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.content.trim()) { toast.error('Title and content required'); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (modal.mode === 'create') {
        await createLegalDoc(form);
        toast.success('Document created');
      } else {
        await updateLegalDoc(modal.doc._id, { title: form.title, content: form.content, version: form.version, isActive: form.isActive });
        toast.success('Document updated');
      }
      setModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', doc: null });
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await deleteLegalDoc(confirmDelete._id);
      toast.success('Document deleted');
      setConfirmDelete(null);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20"><Spinner size="lg" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Legal Documents</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{docs.length} document{docs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
        </div>
        {isSuperadmin && <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreate}>New document</Button>}
      </div>

      {docs.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><div className="text-center py-12"><HiScale className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-3" /><p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No legal documents yet</p></div></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {docs.map((d) => (
            <Card key={d._id}>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <h3 className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">{d.title}</h3>
                      <Badge variant="info">{statusLabel(d.type)}</Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">v{d.version}</p>
                    {d.updatedAt && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">Updated {formatDateTime(d.updatedAt)}</p>}
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant={d.isActive ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>{d.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</Badge>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-1 pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-color)]">
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setViewTarget(d)} icon={<HiEye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>View</Button>
                  {isSuperadmin && (
                    <>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => openEdit(d)} icon={<HiPencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Edit</Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(d)} icon={<HiTrash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}>Delete</Button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create/edit modal */}
      <Modal open={modal.open} onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', doc: null })} title={modal.mode === 'create' ? 'Create document' : 'Edit document'} size="lg" footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', doc: null })}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={save} loading={saving}>Save</Button>
        </>
      }>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {modal.mode === 'create' && (
            <Select label="Type" value={form.type} onChange={(e) => patch('type', e.target.value)} options={LEGAL_TYPES.map((t) => ({ value: t, label: statusLabel(t) }))} />
          )}
          <Input label="Title *" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => patch('title', e.target.value)} />
          <Input label="Version" value={form.version} onChange={(e) => patch('version', e.target.value)} />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">Content (Markdown) *</label>
            <textarea value={form.content} onChange={(e) => patch('content', e.target.value)} rows={14} className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm resize-y font-mono" />
          </div>
          <Toggle label="Active" checked={form.isActive} onChange={(v) => patch('isActive', v)} />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* View modal */}
      <Modal open={!!viewTarget} onClose={() => setViewTarget(null)} title={viewTarget?.title} size="lg">
        {viewTarget && (
          <div className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] p-4 rounded-lg max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {viewTarget.content}
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog open={!!confirmDelete} onClose={() => setConfirmDelete(null)} onConfirm={doDelete} title="Delete document" message={`Permanently delete "${confirmDelete?.title}"?`} confirmLabel="Delete" variant="danger" loading={busy} />
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\Login.jsx =====
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Link, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiServer } from 'react-icons/hi';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Spinner from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Spinner';

export default function Login() {
  const { login, status } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/hdmisp';

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (status === 'idle' || status === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-primary)] flex items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === 'authenticated') {
    return <Navigate to={from} replace />;
  }

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      toast.success('Welcome back');
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
      <Link
        to="/"
        className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors"
      >
        <HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Return Home
      </Link>

      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 text-white mb-4">
            <HiServer className="w-8 h-8" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            HDM ISP
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1">
            Internet service provider admin
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4 text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="admin@hdm.co.ke"
            autoComplete="email"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          <Button type="submit" fullWidth size="lg" loading={submitting}>
            Sign In
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] text-center mt-6">
          Admin-only access. Providers use their own panel.
        </p>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { HiCheck, HiTrash, HiBell, HiRefresh } from 'react-icons/hi';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Pagination from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Pagination';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import {
  getNotifications,
  markNotificationRead,
  markAllNotificationsRead,
  deleteNotification,
} from '../../services/hdmisp/notifications';
import { relativeTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { PAGE_LIMIT } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

export default function Notifications() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [unreadOnly, setUnreadOnly] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getNotifications({
        page,
        limit: PAGE_LIMIT,
        unreadOnly: unreadOnly || undefined,
      });
      setItems(res.data || []);
      setMeta({
        page: res.meta?.page || 1,
        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,
        total: res.meta?.total || 0,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load notifications');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, unreadOnly, toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const doMarkRead = async (id) => {
    setBusy(id);
    try {
      await markNotificationRead(id);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to mark read');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const doMarkAll = async () => {
    setBusy('all');
    try {
      const res = await markAllNotificationsRead();
      toast.success(`Marked ${res?.modified ?? 0} as read`);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to mark all');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async (id) => {
    setBusy(id);
    try {
      await deleteNotification(id);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Notifications</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{meta.total} total</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={load} loading={loading}>Refresh</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" icon={<HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={doMarkAll} loading={busy === 'all'} disabled={meta.total === 0}>Mark all read</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button onClick={() => { setUnreadOnly(false); setPage(1); }} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${!unreadOnly ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}`} type="button">All</button>
        <button onClick={() => { setUnreadOnly(true); setPage(1); }} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${unreadOnly ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'}`} type="button">Unread only</button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
          {loading && !items.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <HiBell className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No notifications</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            items.map((n) => (
              <div key={n._id} className={`flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 ${!n.read ? 'bg-cyan-50/40 dark:bg-cyan-950/10' : ''}`}>
                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full mt-2 shrink-0 ${!n.read ? 'bg-cyan-500' : 'bg-transparent'}`} />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{n.title}</p>
                    <Badge variant="default">{n.type}</Badge>
                  </div>
                  {n.body && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-0.5">{n.body}</p>}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1">
                    {n.link && (
                      <Link to={n.link} className="text-xs text-cyan-600 hover:underline" onClick={() => !n.read && doMarkRead(n._id)}>Open</Link>
                    )}
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{relativeTime(n.createdAt)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                  {!n.read && (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => doMarkRead(n._id)} loading={busy === n._id} title="Mark read">
                      <HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => doDelete(n._id)} loading={busy === n._id} title="Delete">
                    <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
        {meta.totalPages > 1 && (
          <div className="p-4 border-t border-[var(--border-color)]">
            <Pagination page={meta.page} totalPages={meta.totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\PaymentMethods.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { HiCog } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Select';
import Toggle from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Toggle';
import Modal from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Modal';
import Spinner from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import { getPaymentMethods, updatePaymentMethod } from '../../services/hdmisp/paymentMethods';

export default function PaymentMethods() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();
  const [methods, setMethods] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [editTarget, setEditTarget] = useState(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({ label: '', enabled: false, config: {} });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getPaymentMethods();
      setMethods(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load payment methods');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const toggle = async (m) => {
    if (!isSuperadmin) return;
    setBusyId(m._id);
    try {
      await updatePaymentMethod(m._id, { enabled: !m.enabled });
      toast.success(`${m.label} ${m.enabled ? 'disabled' : 'enabled'}`);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to toggle');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const openEdit = (m) => {
    setEditTarget(m);
    setDraft({ label: m.label || '', enabled: m.enabled !== false, config: { ...(m.config || {}) } });
  };

  const patchCfg = (k, v) => setDraft((p) => ({ ...p, config: { ...p.config, [k]: v } }));

  const saveConfig = async () => {
    if (!editTarget) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await updatePaymentMethod(editTarget._id, {
        label: draft.label,
        enabled: draft.enabled,
        config: draft.config,
      });
      toast.success('Saved');
      setEditTarget(null);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const renderFields = () => {
    const code = editTarget?.code;
    const c = draft.config;

    switch (code) {
      case 'mpesa_stk':
        return (
          <>
            <Select label="Environment" value={c.env || 'sandbox'} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('env', e.target.value)} options={[{ value: 'sandbox', label: 'Sandbox' }, { value: 'production', label: 'Production' }]} />
            <Input label="Consumer key" value={c.consumerKey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('consumerKey', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Consumer secret" value={c.consumerSecret || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('consumerSecret', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Shortcode" value={c.shortcode || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('shortcode', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Passkey" value={c.passkey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('passkey', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Callback URL" value={c.callbackUrl || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('callbackUrl', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'mpesa_send':
        return (
          <>
            <Input label="Phone number" value={c.phone || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('phone', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Display name" value={c.name || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('name', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'mpesa_till':
        return (
          <>
            <Input label="Till number" value={c.tillNumber || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('tillNumber', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Business name" value={c.name || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('name', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'mpesa_paybill':
        return (
          <>
            <Input label="Paybill number" value={c.paybillNumber || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('paybillNumber', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Account number" value={c.accountNumber || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('accountNumber', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Business name" value={c.name || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('name', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'bank':
        return (
          <>
            <Input label="Bank name" value={c.bankName || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('bankName', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Account name" value={c.accountName || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('accountName', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Account number" value={c.accountNumber || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('accountNumber', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Branch" value={c.branch || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('branch', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="SWIFT" value={c.swift || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('swift', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'stripe':
        return (
          <>
            <Select label="Mode" value={c.mode || 'test'} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('mode', e.target.value)} options={[{ value: 'test', label: 'Test' }, { value: 'live', label: 'Live' }]} />
            <Input label="Publishable key" value={c.publishableKey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('publishableKey', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Secret key" value={c.secretKey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('secretKey', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Webhook secret" value={c.webhookSecret || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('webhookSecret', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'paypal':
        return (
          <>
            <Select label="Mode" value={c.mode || 'sandbox'} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('mode', e.target.value)} options={[{ value: 'sandbox', label: 'Sandbox' }, { value: 'live', label: 'Live' }]} />
            <Input label="Client ID" value={c.publicKey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('publicKey', e.target.value)} />
            <Input label="Secret" value={c.secretKey || ''} onChange={(e) => patchCfg('secretKey', e.target.value)} />
          </>
        );
      case 'cash':
        return <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No configuration needed.</p>;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20"><Spinner size="lg" /></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Payment Methods</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">Platform-wide methods. Providers enable the ones they use.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {methods.map((m) => (
          <Card key={m._id}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
                  <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{m.label || m.code}</p>
                  <Badge variant="default">{m.mode || 'manual'}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant={m.enabled ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>{m.enabled ? 'On' : 'Off'}</Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">{m.code}</p>
              </div>
              {isSuperadmin && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    icon={<HiCog className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    onClick={() => openEdit(m)}
                    title="Configure"
                    aria-label={`Configure ${m.label || m.code}`}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="switch"
                    aria-checked={m.enabled}
                    aria-label={`Toggle ${m.label || m.code}`}
                    title={m.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                    onClick={() => toggle(m)}
                    disabled={busyId === m._id}
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${
                      m.enabled ? 'bg-cyan-600' : 'bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                        m.enabled ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>
        ))}
        {methods.length === 0 && (
          <Card><p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-6 text-center">No payment methods configured</p></Card>
        )}
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={!!editTarget}
        onClose={() => setEditTarget(null)}
        title={`Configure ${editTarget?.label || ''}`}
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setEditTarget(null)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={saveConfig} loading={saving}>Save config</Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input label="Label" value={draft.label} onChange={(e) => setDraft((p) => ({ ...p, label: e.target.value }))} />
          <Toggle label="Enabled" checked={draft.enabled} onChange={(v) => setDraft((p) => ({ ...p, enabled: v }))} />
          <div className="border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-4 space-y-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider">Config</p>
            {renderFields()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\PendingPayments.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { HiCheck, HiX, HiRefresh, HiCreditCard } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Modal';
import Pagination from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Pagination';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import { getPendingPayments, confirmPayment, rejectPayment } from '../../services/hdmisp/billing';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatMoney';
import { PAGE_LIMIT } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

export default function PendingPayments() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);

  const [confirmTarget, setConfirmTarget] = useState(null);
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState(null);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPendingPayments({ page, limit: PAGE_LIMIT });
      setItems(res.data || []);
      setMeta({
        page: res.meta?.page || 1,
        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,
        total: res.meta?.total || 0,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load pending payments');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const doConfirm = async () => {
    if (!confirmTarget) return;
    if (!receipt.trim()) { toast.error('Receipt number is required'); return; }
    const txId = confirmTarget.transaction?.id;
    if (!txId) { toast.error('Missing transaction ID'); return; }
    setActionLoading(txId);
    try {
      await confirmPayment({
        transactionId: txId,
        receiptNumber: receipt.trim(),
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success('Payment confirmed');
      setConfirmTarget(null);
      setReceipt('');
      setNotes('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to confirm');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const doReject = async () => {
    if (!rejectTarget) return;
    if (!rejectReason.trim()) { toast.error('Reason is required'); return; }
    const txId = rejectTarget.transaction?.id;
    if (!txId) { toast.error('Missing transaction ID'); return; }
    setActionLoading(txId);
    try {
      await rejectPayment({ transactionId: txId, reason: rejectReason.trim() });
      toast.success('Payment rejected');
      setRejectTarget(null);
      setRejectReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to reject');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'provider',
      label: 'Provider',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm">
            {row.provider?.name || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.provider?.email || ''}</p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'invoice',
      label: 'Invoice',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.invoice?.invoiceNumber || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            {row.invoice?.purpose ? row.invoice.purpose : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'amount',
      label: 'Amount',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          {formatMoneyMajor(
            row.transaction?.amount ?? 0,
            row.transaction?.currency || 'KES'
          )}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'reference',
      label: 'Reference',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.transaction?.reference || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'note',
      label: 'Note',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.transaction?.note || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'submittedAt',
      label: 'Submitted',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.transaction?.submittedAt
            ? formatDateTime(row.transaction.submittedAt)
            : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => {
        const txId = row.transaction?.id;
        return (
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
            {isSuperadmin && (
              <>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="success"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setReceipt(row.transaction?.reference || '');
                    setNotes('');
                    setConfirmTarget(row);
                  }}
                  disabled={actionLoading === txId}
                  title="Confirm"
                >
                  <HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="danger"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setRejectReason('');
                    setRejectTarget(row);
                  }}
                  disabled={actionLoading === txId}
                  title="Reject"
                >
                  <HiX className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Pending Payments
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} payment{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''} awaiting confirmation
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={load}
          loading={loading}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4">
          {loading && !items.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <HiCreditCard className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No pending payments</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table columns={columns} data={items} rowKey={(r) => r.transaction?.id} />
              <Pagination page={meta.page} totalPages={meta.totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={!!confirmTarget}
        onClose={() => { setConfirmTarget(null); setReceipt(''); setNotes(''); }}
        title="Confirm payment"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => { setConfirmTarget(null); setReceipt(''); setNotes(''); }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="success"
              onClick={doConfirm}
              loading={actionLoading === confirmTarget?.transaction?.id}
            >
              Confirm
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {confirmTarget && (
            <div className="bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] rounded-lg p-3 text-sm space-y-1">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Provider:</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-medium">
                  {confirmTarget.provider?.name || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Invoice:</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-xs">
                  {confirmTarget.invoice?.invoiceNumber || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Amount:</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-semibold">
                  {formatMoneyMajor(
                    confirmTarget.transaction?.amount ?? 0,
                    confirmTarget.transaction?.currency || 'KES'
                  )}
                </span>
              </div>
              {confirmTarget.transaction?.reference && (
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Submitted reference:</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-xs">
                    {confirmTarget.transaction.reference}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {confirmTarget.transaction?.note && (
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Note:</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs">
                    {confirmTarget.transaction.note}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Input
            label="Receipt number *"
            value={receipt}
            onChange={(e) => setReceipt(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="RKT4X7Y8Z9"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Notes
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              rows={2}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm resize-y"
              placeholder="e.g. Cash payment received at office"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        open={!!rejectTarget}
        onClose={() => { setRejectTarget(null); setRejectReason(''); }}
        title="Reject payment"
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => { setRejectTarget(null); setRejectReason(''); }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={doReject}
              loading={actionLoading === rejectTarget?.transaction?.id}
            >
              Reject
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            This will mark the transaction as failed and reset the invoice so the provider can resubmit.
          </p>
          <Input
            label="Reason *"
            value={rejectReason}
            onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Payment not received"
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft, HiCheck, HiX, HiTrash, HiClock,

import {

import { formatDate, formatDateTime, relativeTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

const REASONS = [
  'Incomplete business documentation',
  'Unable to verify business',
  'Duplicate application',
  'Suspected fraud',
  'Policy violation',
  'Other',
];

export default function PendingProviderDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [approveOpen, setApproveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rejectOpen, setRejectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState(REASONS[0]);
  const [rejectCustom, setRejectCustom] = useState('');
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const p = await getPendingProvider(id);
      setData(p);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load pending provider');
      navigate('/hdmisp/pending');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const doApprove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await approvePendingProvider(id);
      toast.success('Provider approved');
      setApproveOpen(false);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to approve');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doReject = async () => {

    if (!finalReason) {
      toast.error('Reason is required');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await rejectPendingProvider(id, finalReason);
      toast.success('Provider rejected');
      setRejectOpen(false);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to reject');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await deletePendingProvider(id);
      toast.success('Pending record deleted');
      navigate('/hdmisp/pending');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return null;

  const p = data;
  const canAct = isSuperadmin && p.status !== 'approved';

  return (

          size="sm"

        >

        </Button>
      </div>

            {p.name || 'Pending Provider'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{p.email}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge variant={statusVariant(p.status)} dot>
            {statusLabel(p.status)}
          </Badge>
          {p.expiresAt && (
            <Badge variant={new Date(p.expiresAt) < new Date() ? 'danger' : 'default'}>
              Expires {relativeTime(p.expiresAt)}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <Card title="Applicant">
          <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <Row label="Name">
              <span className="font-medium">{p.name || 'â€”'}</span>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Email">{p.email || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Phone">{p.phone || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Status">
              <Badge variant={statusVariant(p.status)} dot>
                {statusLabel(p.status)}
              </Badge>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Registered">
              {p.createdAt ? formatDateTime(p.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
            <Row label="Expires">
              {p.expiresAt ? formatDate(p.expiresAt) : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
            {p.rejectionReason && (
              <Row label="Rejection reason">
                <span className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
                  {p.rejectionReason}
                </span>
              </Row>
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Billing plan">
          {p.billingPlanId && typeof p.billingPlanId === 'object' ? (
            <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <Row label="Plan">

function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-right text-xs break-all">
        {children}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
