import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiEye, HiCheck, HiX, HiTrash, HiRefresh, HiClock, HiSearch,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import Pagination from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Pagination';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import {
  getPendingProviders,
  approvePendingProvider,
  rejectPendingProvider,
  deletePendingProvider,
  expireStalePendingProviders,
} from '../../services/hdmisp/providers';
import { formatDate, relativeTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import {
  PENDING_STATUS_LIST,
  statusVariant,
  statusLabel,
  PAGE_LIMIT,
} from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';

const REASONS = [
  'Incomplete business documentation',
  'Unable to verify business',
  'Duplicate application',
  'Suspected fraud',
  'Policy violation',
  'Other',
];

export default function PendingProviders() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);

  const [approveTarget, setApproveTarget] = useState(null);
  const [rejectTarget, setRejectTarget] = useState(null);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState(REASONS[0]);
  const [rejectCustom, setRejectCustom] = useState('');
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPendingProviders({
        page,
        limit: PAGE_LIMIT,
        status: status || undefined,
        search: search || undefined,
      });
      setItems(res.data || []);
      setMeta({
        page: res.meta?.page || 1,
        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,
        total: res.meta?.total || 0,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load pending providers');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, status, search, toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // Debounce search
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      setSearch(searchInput);
      setPage(1);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const doApprove = async () => {
    if (!approveTarget) return;
    setActionLoading(approveTarget._id);
    try {
      await approvePendingProvider(approveTarget._id);
      toast.success('Provider approved');
      setApproveTarget(null);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to approve');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const doReject = async () => {
    if (!rejectTarget) return;
    const finalReason =
      rejectReason === 'Other' ? rejectCustom.trim() : rejectReason;
    if (!finalReason) {
      toast.error('Reason is required');
      return;
    }
    setActionLoading(rejectTarget._id);
    try {
      await rejectPendingProvider(rejectTarget._id, finalReason);
      toast.success('Provider rejected');
      setRejectTarget(null);
      setRejectReason(REASONS[0]);
      setRejectCustom('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to reject');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete) return;
    setActionLoading(confirmDelete._id);
    try {
      await deletePendingProvider(confirmDelete._id);
      toast.success('Pending record deleted');
      setConfirmDelete(null);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const doExpire = async () => {
    setActionLoading('expire');
    try {
      const res = await expireStalePendingProviders();
      toast.success(`Expired ${res?.expired ?? 0} stale records`);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to expire');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Provider',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
            {row.name || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">{row.email}</p>
          {row.phone && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.phone}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>
          {statusLabel(row.status)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'expiresAt',
      label: 'Expires',
      render: (row) => {
        if (!row.expiresAt) return <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">â€”</span>;
        const expired = new Date(row.expiresAt) < new Date();
        return (
          <span className={`text-xs ${expired ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'}`}>
            {formatDate(row.expiresAt)}
          </span>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Registered',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {relativeTime(row.createdAt)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => {
        const busy = actionLoading === row._id;
        const canAct = isSuperadmin && row.status !== 'approved';
        return (
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                navigate(`/hdmisp/pending/${row._id}`);
              }}
              title="View"
            >
              <HiEye className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
            {canAct && (
              <>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="success"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setApproveTarget(row);
                  }}
                  disabled={busy}
                  title="Approve"
                >
                  <HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="danger"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setRejectTarget(row);
                  }}
                  disabled={busy}
                  title="Reject"
                >
                  <HiX className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            {isSuperadmin && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setConfirmDelete(row);
                }}
                disabled={busy}
                title="Delete"
              >
                <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Pending Providers
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} application{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''} awaiting review
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              icon={<HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${actionLoading === 'expire' ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />}
              onClick={doExpire}
              loading={actionLoading === 'expire'}
            >
              Expire stale
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={load}
            loading={loading}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <HiSearch className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by name or email..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder-[var(--text-muted)] text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => { setStatus(''); setPage(1); }}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                !status
                  ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)]'
              }`}
              type="button"
            >
              All
            </button>
            {PENDING_STATUS_LIST.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s}
                onClick={() => { setStatus(s); setPage(1); }}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                  status === s
                    ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)]'
                }`}
                type="button"
              >
                {statusLabel(s)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          {loading && !items.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <HiClock className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                No pending providers match your filters
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table
                columns={columns}
                data={items}
                rowKey={(r) => r._id}
                onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/hdmisp/pending/${r._id}`)}
              />
              <Pagination
                page={meta.page}
                totalPages={meta.totalPages}
                onPageChange={setPage}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Approve modal */}
      <Modal
        open={!!approveTarget}
        onClose={() => setApproveTarget(null)}
        title={`Approve ${approveTarget?.name || 'provider'}`}
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setApproveTarget(null)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="success"
              onClick={doApprove}
              loading={actionLoading === approveTarget?._id}
            >
              Approve
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          Approving will create a provider account, seed settings, and send the
          welcome email + SMS to <strong>{approveTarget?.email}</strong>.
        </p>
      </Modal>

      {/* Reject modal */}
      <Modal
        open={!!rejectTarget}
        onClose={() => {
          setRejectTarget(null);
          setRejectReason(REASONS[0]);
          setRejectCustom('');
        }}
        title={`Reject ${rejectTarget?.name || 'provider'}`}
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setRejectTarget(null);
                setRejectReason(REASONS[0]);
                setRejectCustom('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={doReject}
              loading={actionLoading === rejectTarget?._id}
            >
              Reject
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            The applicant will be emailed the rejection reason.
          </p>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Reason
            </label>
            <select
              value={rejectReason}
              onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500"
            >
              {REASONS.map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>
                  {r}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          {rejectReason === 'Other' && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                Details
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={rejectCustom}
                onChange={(e) => setRejectCustom(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm resize-y focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500"
                placeholder="Explain the rejectionâ€¦"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!confirmDelete}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}
        onConfirm={doDelete}
        title="Delete pending provider"
        message={`Permanently delete the pending application for "${confirmDelete?.name}"? This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={actionLoading === confirmDelete?._id}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\hdmisp\Profile.jsx =====
import { useState } from 'react';
import { HiKey, HiUser, HiMail, HiShieldCheck, HiPhone } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { changePassword } from '../../services/hdmisp/auth';
import { initials } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatters';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';

export default function Profile() {
  const { admin } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [current, setCurrent] = useState('');
  const [next, setNext] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const name = admin?.name || 'Admin';
  const email = admin?.email || 'â€”';
  const role = admin?.adminRole === 'superadmin' ? 'Superadmin' : 'Support';

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!current || !next || !confirm) {
      toast.error('All fields are required');
      return;
    }
    if (next !== confirm) {
      toast.error('New passwords do not match');
      return;
    }
    if (next.length < 8) {
      toast.error('Password must be at least 8 characters');
      return;
    }
    if (next === current) {
      toast.error('New password must be different from current');
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await changePassword(current, next);
      toast.success('Password changed');
      setCurrent('');
      setNext('');
      setConfirm('');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to change password');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Profile</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">Your admin account</p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xl font-bold shrink-0">
            {initials(name) || 'A'}
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
              {name}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">{email}</p>
            <span className="inline-block mt-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-100 dark:bg-cyan-900/30 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 text-[10px] font-medium">
              {role}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Account">
        <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
          <Row label="Name">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiUser className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              {name}
            </span>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Email">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiMail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              {email}
            </span>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Role">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              {role}
            </span>
          </Row>
          {admin?.lastLoginAt && (
            <Row label="Last login">{formatDateTime(admin.lastLoginAt)}</Row>
          )}
        </dl>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Change password">
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Current password"
            type="password"
            value={current}
            onChange={(e) => setCurrent(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="New password"
            type="password"
            hint="At least 8 characters"
            value={next}
            onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Confirm new password"
            type="password"
            value={confirm}
            onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="new-password"
            required
          />
          <Button type="submit" icon={<HiKey className="w-4 h-4" />} loading={busy}>
            Update password
          </Button>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-right">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft, HiBan, HiCheck, HiTrash, HiRefresh, HiUser, HiPencil,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Select';
import Modal from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/ConfirmDialog';

import { useToast } from '../../context/hdmisp/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/hdmisp/AuthContext';
import {
  getProvider,
  updateProvider,
  suspendProvider,
  activateProvider,
  approveProviderSubscription,
  deleteProvider,
} from '../../services/hdmisp/providers';
import { getBillingPlans } from '../../services/hdmisp/billingPlans';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel, PROVIDER_STATUS_LIST } from '../../utils/hdmisp/constants';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatMoney';

export default function ProviderDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [provider, setProvider] = useState(null);
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ name: '', phone: '', billingPlanId: '', status: '' });

  const [suspendOpen, setSuspendOpen] = useState(false);
  const [suspendReason, setSuspendReason] = useState('');
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const p = await getProvider(id);
      setProvider(p);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load provider');
      navigate('/hdmisp/providers');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    getBillingPlans().then(setPlans).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const openEdit = () => {
    setEditForm({
      name: provider.name || '',
      phone: provider.phone || '',
      billingPlanId:
        typeof provider.billingPlanId === 'object' && provider.billingPlanId
          ? provider.billingPlanId._id
          : provider.billingPlanId || '',
      status: provider.status || 'active',
    });
    setEditOpen(true);
  };

  const doUpdate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await updateProvider(id, editForm);
      toast.success('Provider updated');
      setEditOpen(false);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to update');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doSuspend = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await suspendProvider(id, suspendReason);
      toast.success('Provider suspended');
      setSuspendOpen(false);
      setSuspendReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to suspend');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doActivate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await activateProvider(id);
      toast.success('Provider activated');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to activate');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doApproveSub = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await approveProviderSubscription(id);
      toast.success('Subscription approved');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to approve');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doDelete = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await deleteProvider(id);
      toast.success('Provider deleted');
      navigate('/hdmisp/providers');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!provider) return null;

  const p = provider;
  const plan = typeof p.billingPlanId === 'object' && p.billingPlanId ? p.billingPlanId : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/hdmisp/providers')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {p.name}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{p.email}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge variant={statusVariant(p.status)} dot>
            {statusLabel(p.status)}
          </Badge>
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={openEdit} icon={<HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />}>
            Edit
          </Button>
          {p.status === 'active' && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="warning"
              onClick={() => setSuspendOpen(true)}
              icon={<HiBan className="w-4 h-4" />}
            >
              Suspend
            </Button>
          )}
          {p.status !== 'active' && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="success"
              onClick={doActivate}
              loading={busy}
              icon={<HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />}
            >
              Activate
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={doApproveSub}
            loading={busy}
            icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
          >
            Approve subscription
          </Button>
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="danger"
              onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(true)}
              icon={<HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
            >
              Delete
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

        <Card title="Provider">
          <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <Row label="Name">{p.name || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Email">{p.email || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Phone">{p.phone || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Status">
              <Badge variant={statusVariant(p.status)} dot>
                {statusLabel(p.status)}
              </Badge>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Billing status">{statusLabel(p.billingStatus) || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Created">
              {p.createdAt ? formatDateTime(p.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
            {p.logoUrl && (
              <Row label="Logo">
                <a href={p.logoUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-cyan-600 hover:underline text-xs">
                  View
                </a>
              </Row>
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Subscription">
          <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <Row label="Plan">
              <span className="font-medium">{plan?.name || 'â€”'}</span>
            </Row>
            {plan && (
              <>
                <Row label="Price">
                  {formatMoneyMajor(plan.price ?? 0, plan.currency || 'KES')}
                </Row>
                <Row label="Cycle">{plan.billingCycle || 'â€”'}</Row>
                <Row label="Max routers">{plan.maxRouters ?? 'â€”'}</Row>
                <Row label="Max customers">{plan.maxCustomers ?? 'â€”'}</Row>
              </>
            )}
            <Row label="Ends">
              {p.subscriptionEndsAt ? formatDate(p.subscriptionEndsAt) : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Login account">

              <HiUser className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1" />
              No login account attached
            </p>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Edit modal */}
      <Modal
        open={editOpen}
        onClose={() => setEditOpen(false)}
        title="Edit provider"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setEditOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={doUpdate} loading={busy}>
              Save
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Name"
            value={editForm.name}
            onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
          />
          <Input
            label="Phone"
            value={editForm.phone}
            onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, phone: e.target.value })}
          />
          <Select
            label="Billing plan"
            value={editForm.billingPlanId}
            onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, billingPlanId: e.target.value })}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: 'No plan' },
              ...plans.map((pl) => ({ value: pl._id, label: pl.name })),
            ]}
          />
          <Select
            label="Status"
            value={editForm.status}
            onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, status: e.target.value })}
            options={PROVIDER_STATUS_LIST.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: statusLabel(s) }))}
          />
        </div>

      {/* Suspend modal */}
      <Modal
        open={suspendOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setSuspendOpen(false);
          setSuspendReason('');
        }}
        title={`Suspend ${p.name}`}
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setSuspendOpen(false);
                setSuspendReason('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={doSuspend} loading={busy}>
              Suspend

            label="Reason"

            onChange={(e) => setSuspendReason(e.target.value)}

      <ConfirmDialog

        onConfirm={doDelete}
        title="Delete provider"

        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={busy}
      />
    </div>
  );

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiEye, HiBan, HiCheck, HiPlus, HiRefresh, HiSearch, HiUsers,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/hdmisp/ui/Button';

  getProviders,

export default function Providers() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, totalPages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);

  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createForm, setCreateForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    password: '',
    billingPlanId: '',
  });
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [suspendTarget, setSuspendTarget] = useState(null);
  const [suspendReason, setSuspendReason] = useState('');

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getProviders({
        page,
        limit: PAGE_LIMIT,
        status: status || undefined,
        search: search || undefined,
      });
      setItems(res.data || []);
      setMeta({
        page: res.meta?.page || 1,
        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,
        total: res.meta?.total || 0,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load providers');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, status, search, toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    getBillingPlans().then(setPlans).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      setSearch(searchInput);
      setPage(1);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!createForm.name.trim() || !createForm.email.trim() || !createForm.password) {
      toast.error('Name, email, and password are required');
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await createProvider({
        name: createForm.name.trim(),
        email: createForm.email.trim(),
        phone: createForm.phone.trim() || undefined,
        password: createForm.password,
        billingPlanId: createForm.billingPlanId || undefined,
      });
      toast.success('Provider created');
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setCreateForm({ name: '', email: '', phone: '', password: '', billingPlanId: '' });
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create provider');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const doSuspend = async () => {
    if (!suspendTarget) return;
    setActionLoading(suspendTarget._id);
    try {
      await suspendProvider(suspendTarget._id, suspendReason);
      toast.success('Provider suspended');
      setSuspendTarget(null);
      setSuspendReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to suspend');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const doActivate = async (row) => {
    setActionLoading(row._id);
    try {
      await activateProvider(row._id);
      toast.success('Provider activated');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to activate');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Provider',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">{row.name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">{row.email}</p>
          {row.phone && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.phone}</p>}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'plan',
      label: 'Plan',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {typeof row.billingPlanId === 'object' && row.billingPlanId
            ? row.billingPlanId.name
            : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>
          {statusLabel(row.status)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'subscriptionEndsAt',
      label: 'Subscription',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.subscriptionEndsAt ? formatDate(row.subscriptionEndsAt) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => {
        const busy = actionLoading === row._id;
        return (
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                navigate(`/hdmisp/providers/${row._id}`);
              }}
              title="View"
            >
              <HiEye className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
            {row.status === 'active' && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="warning"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setSuspendReason('');
                  setSuspendTarget(row);
                }}
                disabled={busy}
                title="Suspend"
              >
                <HiBan className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            )}
            {row.status !== 'active' && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="success"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  doActivate(row);
                }}
                disabled={busy}
                title="Activate"
              >
                <HiCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Providers</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} active provider{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <Button
              icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}
            >
              New provider
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={load}
            loading={loading}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <HiSearch className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by name or email..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] placeholder-[var(--text-muted)] text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => { setStatus(''); setPage(1); }}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${
                !status
                  ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
              }`}
              type="button"
            >
              All
            </button>
            {PROVIDER_STATUS_LIST.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s}
                onClick={() => { setStatus(s); setPage(1); }}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium ${
                  status === s
                    ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                }`}
                type="button"
              >
                {statusLabel(s)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          {loading && !items.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <HiUsers className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No providers match your filters</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table
                columns={columns}
                data={items}
                rowKey={(r) => r._id}
                onRowClick={(r) => navigate(`/hdmisp/providers/${r._id}`)}
              />
              <Pagination
                page={meta.page}
                totalPages={meta.totalPages}
                onPageChange={setPage}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Create modal */}
      <Modal
        open={createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        title="Create provider"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCreate} loading={creating}>
              Create
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Business name *"
            value={createForm.name}
            onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, name: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Acme ISP"
          />
          <Input
            label="Admin email *"
            type="email"
            value={createForm.email}
            onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, email: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="admin@acmeisp.co.ke"
          />
          <Input
            label="Phone"
            value={createForm.phone}
            onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, phone: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="254712345678"
          />
          <Input
            label="Temp password *"
            type="password"
            value={createForm.password}
            onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, password: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Min 8 characters"
          />
          <Select
            label="Billing plan"
            value={createForm.billingPlanId}
            onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, billingPlanId: e.target.value })}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: 'No plan' },
              ...plans.map((p) => ({ value: p._id, label: p.name })),
            ]}
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            A welcome email will be sent to the provider with their login credentials.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Suspend modal */}
      <Modal
        open={!!suspendTarget}
        onClose={() => {
          setSuspendTarget(null);
          setSuspendReason('');
        }}
        title={`Suspend ${suspendTarget?.name || 'provider'}`}
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setSuspendTarget(null);
                setSuspendReason('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={doSuspend}
              loading={actionLoading === suspendTarget?._id}
            >
              Suspend
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            The provider will lose access to their portal immediately and receive an
            email notification.
          </p>
          <Input
            label="Reason"
            value={suspendReason}
            onChange={(e) => setSuspendReason(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Non-payment"
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  HiChartBar, HiRefresh, HiCash, HiUsers, HiServer,
  HiArrowUp, HiArrowDown, HiDownload, HiCalendar,

  getReportsSummary,

import { formatDate } from '../../utils/hdmisp/formatDate';

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Small helpers                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function toISODate(d) {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function daysAgo(n) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  return toISODate(d);
}

function todayISO() {
  return toISODate(new Date());
}

/** Parse a daily report row into { date, revenue, transactions } */
function normalizeDaily(row) {
  return {
    date: row.date || row._id || row.day || null,
    revenue: row.revenue ?? row.completedRevenue ?? row.total ?? 0,
    transactions: row.transactions ?? row.count ?? row.completed ?? 0,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Trend mini-chart (pure CSS/SVG, no deps)                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function Sparkline({ points, color = '#06b6d4' }) {
  if (!points || points.length < 2) {
    return <div className="h-24 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Not enough data</div>;
  }
  const w = 100;
  const h = 32;
  const max = Math.max(...points, 1);
  const min = Math.min(...points, 0);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const step = w / (points.length - 1);

  const coords = points.map((v, i) => {
    const x = i * step;
    const y = h - ((v - min) / range) * h;
    return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
  });

  const area = `0,${h} ${coords.join(' ')} ${w},${h}`;

  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" className="w-full h-24">
      <polygon points={area} fill={color} opacity="0.12" />
      <polyline
        points={coords.join(' ')}
        fill="none"
        stroke={color}
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
      />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Bar list (provider revenue)                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function RevenueBars({ rows, currency = 'KES' }) {
  if (!rows.length) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-8 text-center">No provider revenue for this period</p>;
  }
  const max = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.revenue), 1);
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-3">
      {rows.map((r) => (
        <li key={r.providerId || r.name}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-1">
            <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">{r.name || r.providerId || 'â€”'}</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] shrink-0">
              {formatMoneyMajor(r.revenue, currency)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600"
              style={{ width: `${Math.max((r.revenue / max) * 100, 2)}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

export default function Reports() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [loadingSummary, setLoadingSummary] = useState(true);
  const [loadingDaily, setLoadingDaily] = useState(true);
  const [loadingRevenue, setLoadingRevenue] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  const [daily, setDaily] = useState([]);
  const [revenue, setRevenue] = useState([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const [from, setFrom] = useState(daysAgo(29));
  const [to, setTo] = useState(todayISO());

  const loadSummary = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingSummary(true);
    try {
      const data = await getReportsSummary();
      setSummary(data || null);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to load summary');
    } finally {
      setLoadingSummary(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadDaily = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingDaily(true);
    try {
      const res = await getDailyReports({ from, to });
      setDaily((res.data || []).map(normalizeDaily));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load daily reports');
    } finally {
      setLoadingDaily(false);
    }
  }, [from, to, toast]);

  const loadRevenue = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingRevenue(true);
    try {
      const data = await getProviderRevenue({ from, to });
      setRevenue(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load provider revenue');
    } finally {
      setLoadingRevenue(false);
    }
  }, [from, to, toast]);

  useEffect(() => { loadSummary(); }, [loadSummary]);
  useEffect(() => { loadDaily(); }, [loadDaily]);
  useEffect(() => { loadRevenue(); }, [loadRevenue]);

  const refreshAll = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await Promise.all([loadSummary(), loadDaily(), loadRevenue()]);
    setRefreshing(false);
  };

  const setPreset = (days) => {
    setFrom(daysAgo(days - 1));
    setTo(todayISO());
  };

  /* Derived numbers */
  const dailyRows = [...daily].sort((a, b) => String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)));
  const revenuePoints = dailyRows.map((r) => Number(r.revenue) || 0);
  const totalRevenue = dailyRows.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r.revenue) || 0), 0);
  const totalTxns = dailyRows.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r.transactions) || 0), 0);
  const firstRev = revenuePoints[0] || 0;
  const lastRev = revenuePoints[revenuePoints.length - 1] || 0;
  const trendPct = firstRev > 0 ? ((lastRev - firstRev) / firstRev) * 100 : 0;

  const d = summary || {};
  const topProviders = [...revenue]
    .sort((a, b) => (b.revenue || 0) - (a.revenue || 0))
    .slice(0, 6);

  const statCards = [
    {
      label: 'Total Revenue (range)',
      value: formatMoneyMajor(totalRevenue, 'KES'),
      hint: `${dailyRows.length} day${dailyRows.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`,
      icon: HiCash,
      color: 'text-green-500',
    },
    {
      label: 'Transactions (range)',
      value: totalTxns.toLocaleString(),
      hint: 'Completed payments',
      icon: HiChartBar,
      color: 'text-cyan-500',
    },
    {
      label: 'Providers',
      value: (d.providers ?? 0).toLocaleString(),
      hint: 'All tenants',
      icon: HiUsers,
      color: 'text-amber-500',
    },
    {
      label: 'Sessions',
      value: (d.sessions ?? 0).toLocaleString(),
      hint: 'All time',
      icon: HiServer,
      color: 'text-violet-500',
    },
  ];

  const initialLoading = (loadingSummary && loadingDaily && loadingRevenue) && !summary && !daily.length && !revenue.length;

  if (initialLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Reports</h1>
            <Badge variant="info">Analytics</Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            Revenue and activity across the platform
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiDownload className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => exportCsv(dailyRows, from, to, toast)}
          >
            Export CSV
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />}
            onClick={refreshAll}
            loading={refreshing}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <Card>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</p>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={loadSummary}>Retry</Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Stat cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {statCards.map((s) => (
          <StatCard key={s.label} {...s} />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card>
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-end gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            {[
              { label: '7d', days: 7 },
              { label: '30d', days: 30 },
              { label: '90d', days: 90 },
              { label: '1y', days: 365 },
            ].map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreset(p.days)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                  from === daysAgo(p.days - 1) && to === todayISO()
                    ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)]'
                }`}
              >
                {p.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Input
              label="From"
              type="date"
              value={from}
              max={to}
              onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="To"
              type="date"
              value={to}
              min={from}
              max={todayISO()}
              onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] lg:ml-auto">
            <HiCalendar className="w-4 h-4" />

                <span>{dailyRows[dailyRows.length - 1]?.date ? formatDate(dailyRows[dailyRows.length - 1].date) : 'â€”'}</span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <SummaryRow label="Providers" value={(d.providers ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
            <SummaryRow label="Sessions" value={(d.sessions ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
            <SummaryRow label="Transactions" value={(d.transactions ?? 0).toLocaleString()} />
            <SummaryRow
              label="Avg / day"
              value={formatMoneyMajor(dailyRows.length ? totalRevenue / dailyRows.length : 0, 'KES')}
            />
          </dl>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Top providers */}
      <Card
        title="Top providers by revenue"
        description="Within selected range"
        actions={<Badge variant="default">{topProviders.length}</Badge>}
      >
        {loadingRevenue ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-10">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <RevenueBars rows={topProviders} />
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Daily table */}
      <Card title="Daily breakdown" description="Newest first" padding={false}>

          <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-cyan-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
          </div>
        ) : dailyRows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-10 text-center">No daily data for this range</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase text-xs">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Date</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Transactions</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Revenue</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
                {[...dailyRows].reverse().map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.date}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                      {r.date ? formatDate(r.date) : 'â€”'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                      {(Number(r.transactions) || 0).toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                      {formatMoneyMajor(Number(r.revenue) || 0, 'KES')}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
              <tfoot className="bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]">
                <tr>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase">Total</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                    {totalTxns.toLocaleString()}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                    {formatMoneyMajor(totalRevenue, 'KES')}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryRow({ label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm font-medium">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Download the daily rows as a CSV file. */
function exportCsv(rows, from, to, toast) {
  if (!rows.length) {
    toast.error('Nothing to export');
    return;
  }
  try {
    const header = ['date', 'transactions', 'revenue'];
    const lines = [header.join(',')];
    for (const r of rows) {
      lines.push([
        r.date || '',
        Number(r.transactions) || 0,
        Number(r.revenue) || 0,
      ].join(','));
    }
    const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `hdmisp-reports_${from}_to_${to}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast.success('CSV exported');
  } catch {
    toast.error('Failed to export CSV');
  }
}

function coerce(value, field) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    return field.default ?? (field.type === 'toggle' ? false : '');
  }
  if (field.type === 'number') {
    const n = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : (field.default ?? 0);
  }
  if (field.type === 'toggle') {
    return value === true || value === 'true' || value === 1;
  }
  return value;
}

function buildInitial(settingsObj) {
  const out = {};
  for (const group of GROUPS) {
    for (const field of group.fields) {
      out[field.key] = coerce(settingsObj?.[field.key], field);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export default function Settings() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperadmin } = useAuth();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [values, setValues] = useState({});
  const [initial, setInitial] = useState({});
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState({});

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getSettings();
      const built = buildInitial(data);
      setValues(built);
      setInitial(built);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load settings');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const dirtyKeys = useMemo(
    () => Object.keys(values).filter((k) => JSON.stringify(values[k]) !== JSON.stringify(initial[k])),
    [values, initial],
  );
  const dirtyCount = dirtyKeys.length;

  const setField = (key, value) => {
    if (!isSuperadmin) return;
    setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  };

  const resetAll = () => {
    setValues({ ...initial });
  };

  const saveAll = async () => {
    if (!isSuperadmin || !dirtyCount) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const patch = {};
      for (const k of dirtyKeys) patch[k] = values[k];
      // Use bulk endpoint if more than one field changed, else single PATCH.
      if (dirtyCount === 1) {
        const k = dirtyKeys[0];
        await updateSetting(k, values[k]);
      } else {
        await bulkUpdateSettings(patch);
      }
      toast.success(`Saved ${dirtyCount} setting${dirtyCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
      setInitial({ ...values });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save settings');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-24">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Settings</h1>
            <HiCog className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            Platform-wide configuration
            {!isSuperadmin && ' (read-only â€” superadmin required to edit)'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={load}
            loading={loading}
          >
            Reload
          </Button>
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={resetAll}
              disabled={!dirtyCount || saving}
            >
              Reset
            </Button>
          )}
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <Button
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={saveAll}
              loading={saving}
              disabled={!dirtyCount}
            >
              Save{dirtyCount ? ` (${dirtyCount})` : ''}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {GROUPS.map((group) => {
        const Icon = group.icon;
        const isCollapsed = collapsed[group.id];
        const groupDirty = group.fields.some((f) => dirtyKeys.includes(f.key));
        return (
          <Card key={group.id} padding={false}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCollapsed((p) => ({ ...p, [group.id]: !p[group.id] }))}

function FieldRow({ field, value, onChange, disabled, dirty }) {
  const label = (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
      {field.label}
      {dirty && (
        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
          Unsaved
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );

  const wrapperClass = 'max-w-xl';

  switch (field.type) {
    case 'toggle':
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 max-w-xl">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)]">{label}</p>
            {field.hint && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">{field.hint}</p>}
          </div>
          <Toggle
            checked={!!value}
            onChange={(v) => onChange(v)}
            disabled={disabled}
          />
        </div>
      );

    case 'select':
      return (
        <div className={wrapperClass}>
          <Select
            label={label}
            value={value ?? ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
            options={field.options || []}
            disabled={disabled}
          />
        </div>
      );

    case 'color':
      return (
        <div className={wrapperClass}>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
            {label}
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="color"
              value={value || '#06b6d4'}
              onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
              disabled={disabled}
              className="h-9 w-12 rounded border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={value || ''}
              onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
              disabled={disabled}
              placeholder="#06b6d4"
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm font-mono disabled:opacity-60"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case 'number':
      return (
        <div className={wrapperClass}>
          <Input
            label={label}
            type="number"
            value={value ?? ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value === '' ? '' : Number(e.target.value))}
            disabled={disabled}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
          />
          {field.hint && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{field.hint}</p>}
        </div>
      );

    case 'text':
    default:
      return (
        <div className={wrapperClass}>
          <Input
            label={label}
            value={value ?? ''}
            onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
            disabled={disabled}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
          />
          {field.hint && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{field.hint}</p>}
        </div>
      );
  }
}

                {t.mpesaReceiptNumber || 'â€”'}

                  <button onClick={() => copy('receipt', t.mpesaReceiptNumber)} className="text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-cyan-600">
                    {copiedField === 'receipt' ? <HiCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <HiClipboardCopy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  </button>

              <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-xs break-all mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                {t.checkoutRequestId || 'â€”'}
                {t.checkoutRequestId && (
                  <button onClick={() => copy('checkout', t.checkoutRequestId)} className="text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:text-cyan-600">
                    {copiedField === 'checkout' ? <HiCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <HiClipboardCopy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  </button>
                )}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Created</dt>
              <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">{t.createdAt ? formatDateTime(t.createdAt) : 'â€”'}</dd>
            </div>
            {t.providerId && (
              <div>
                <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Provider</dt>
                <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-xs mt-1">
                  {typeof t.providerId === 'object' ? (t.providerId.name || t.providerId._id) : t.providerId}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Raw callback">
          {t.rawCallback ? (
            <pre className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] p-3 rounded-lg overflow-auto max-h-96 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
              {JSON.stringify(t.rawCallback, null, 2)}
            </pre>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No callback data on record.</p>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Transactions() {

        page,
        limit: PAGE_LIMIT,
        status: status || undefined,
        phone: phone || undefined,
        from: from || undefined,
        to: to || undefined,
        providerId: providerId || undefined,
      });

        totalPages: res.meta?.totalPages || 1,

      setLoading(false);

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { getStats } from '../../services/marketbridge/dashboard';
import { getPayoutsList } from '../../services/marketbridge/orders';
import Card from '../../components/marketbridge/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/marketbridge/ui/Badge';
import Spinner from '../../components/marketbridge/ui/Spinner';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/marketbridge/formatDate';

export default function Accounts() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [revenue, setRevenue] = useState({ total: 0, today: 0 });
  const [payouts, setPayouts] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      getStats().catch(() => ({ data: { revenue: {} } })),
      getPayoutsList().catch(() => ({ data: { payouts: [] } })),
    ]).then(([statsRes, payoutsRes]) => {
      const stats = statsRes?.data || statsRes || {};
      const rev = stats.revenue || {};
      setRevenue({
        total: rev.total || 0,
        today: rev.today || 0,
      });

      const pData = payoutsRes?.data || payoutsRes || {};
      setPayouts(pData.payouts || []);
    }).catch(console.error).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  // Calculate store balances from payouts
  const storeBalances = {};
  payouts.forEach(p => {
    const name = p.storeId?.name || 'Unknown';
    if (!storeBalances[name]) storeBalances[name] = { name, pending: 0, released: 0, commission: 0 };
    if (p.status === 'released') {
      storeBalances[name].released += (p.amount || 0);
      storeBalances[name].commission += (p.orderId?.financials?.platformCommission || 0);
    } else {
      storeBalances[name].pending += (p.amount || 0);
    }
  });

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><Spinner size="lg" /></div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-6">ðŸ’³ Accounts</h1>

      {/* Platform Revenue */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-6">
        <Card>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">KES {revenue.total.toLocaleString()}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Total Revenue</p>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-violet-600">KES {revenue.today.toLocaleString()}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Today</p>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Store Balances */}
      <Card className="mb-6">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-4">Store Balances</h2>
        {Object.keys(storeBalances).length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4 text-center">No store balances yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Store</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Released</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Commission</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Total Earned</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
                {Object.values(storeBalances).map(s => (
                  <tr key={s.name} className="hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]">
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">{s.name}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-green-600">KES {s.released.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-violet-600">KES {s.commission.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">KES {(s.released).toLocaleString()}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Recent Payouts */}
      <Card>
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-4">Recent Payouts</h2>
        {payouts.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4 text-center">No payouts yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Date</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Store</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Order</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Amount</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
                {payouts.slice(0, 10).map((p, i) => (
                  <tr key={p._id || i} className="hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]">
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">{formatDate(p.releasedAt || p.createdAt)}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-[var(--text-primary)]">{p.storeId?.name || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-[var(--text-primary)] font-mono text-xs">{p.orderId?.orderNumber || 'â€”'}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">KES {(p.amount || 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2"><span className="text-xs font-medium text-green-600 bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{p.status}</span></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

  );
}
