const RETENTION = [7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365, 0].map((d) => ({
  value: d,
  label: d === 0 ? 'Keep forever' : `${d} days`,
}));

export default function Backups() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperAdmin } = useAuth();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState('list');

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [emailModal, setEmailModal] = useState({ open: false, backup: null });
  const [emailTo, setEmailTo] = useState('');
  const [emailSending, setEmailSending] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, backup: null });
  const [deleteBusy, setDeleteBusy] = useState(false);

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  const [settingsLoading, setSettingsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [settingsError, setSettingsError] = useState(null);
  const [settingsSaving, setSettingsSaving] = useState(false);

  const load = (p = 1) => {
    setLoading(true);
    getBackups({ page: p, limit: 20 })
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res?.data || res;
        setItems(data?.items || []);
        setMeta(data?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load(page);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [page]);

  const loadSettings = async () => {
    setSettingsLoading(true);
    setSettingsError(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/backups/settings');
      const data = res?.data?.data || res?.data || {};
      setSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...data });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.status === 404) {
        setSettingsError('Backup settings endpoint not configured on the backend.');
      } else {
        setSettingsError(err.message || 'Failed to load settings');
      }
    } finally {
      setSettingsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'settings') loadSettings();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tab]);

  const saveSettings = async () => {
    setSettingsSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.put('/backups/settings', settings);
      toast.success('Settings saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSettingsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      toast.info('Backup started â€” this may take up to 60 seconds');
      await createBackup();
      toast.success('Backup created');
      load(page);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = async (backup) => {
    try {
      await downloadBackup(backup._id || backup.id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Download failed');
    }
  };

  const handleSendEmail = async () => {
    if (!emailModal.backup) return;
    setEmailSending(true);
    try {
      await sendBackupEmail(emailModal.backup._id || emailModal.backup.id, {
        email: emailTo.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success('Backup emailed');
      setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null });
      setEmailTo('');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to send');
    } finally {
      setEmailSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.backup) return;
    setDeleteBusy(true);
    try {
      await deleteBackup(confirmDelete.backup._id || confirmDelete.backup.id);
      toast.success('Backup deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, backup: null });
      load(page);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleteBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'filename',
      label: 'File',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.filename}
          </p>
          {row.sizeHuman && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">
              {row.sizeHuman}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[row.status] || 'default'} dot>
          {row.status}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Created',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.createdAt ? formatDateTime(row.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleDownload(row);
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Download"
          >
            <HiDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setEmailTo('');
              setEmailModal({ open: true, backup: row });
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Send by email"
          >
            <HiMail className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          {isSuperAdmin && (
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setConfirmDelete({ open: true, backup: row });
              }}
              className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-red-600"
              type="button"
              title="Delete"
            >
              <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Backups
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} backup{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        {tab === 'list' && isSuperAdmin && (
          <Button
            icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={handleCreate}
            loading={creating}
          >
            Create backup
          </Button>
        )}
        {tab === 'settings' && isSuperAdmin && !settingsError && (
          <Button
            icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={saveSettings}
            loading={settingsSaving}
          >
            Save settings
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('list')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition ${
            tab === 'list'
              ? 'border-violet-600 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400'
              : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
          }`}
          type="button"
        >
          Backups
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('settings')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
            tab === 'settings'
              ? 'border-violet-600 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400'
              : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
          }`}
          type="button"
        >
          <HiCog className="w-4 h-4" />
          Settings
        </button>
      </div>

      {tab === 'list' && (
        <Card padding={false}>
          <div className="p-4">
            <Table
              columns={columns}
              data={items}
              loading={loading}
              rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
              emptyMessage="No backups yet"
            />
            <Pagination
              page={meta.page}
              totalPages={meta.pages}
              onPageChange={setPage}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {tab === 'settings' && (
        <Card>
          {settingsLoading ? (
            <div className="py-12 flex justify-center">
              <Spinner size="lg" />
            </div>
          ) : settingsError ? (
            <div className="text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-lg p-4">
              <p className="font-medium mb-1">Settings not available</p>
              <p className="text-xs">{settingsError}</p>
              <p className="text-xs mt-2">
                Ask the backend team to implement{' '}
                <code className="font-mono">GET /admin/backups/settings</code>{' '}
                and <code className="font-mono">PUT /admin/backups/settings</code>.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Toggle
                label="Auto backup enabled"
                description="Run backups on a schedule"
                checked={!!settings.enabled}
                onChange={(v) => setSettings({ ...settings, enabled: v })}
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <Select
                  label="Frequency"
                  value={settings.frequency || 'daily'}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({ ...settings, frequency: e.target.value })
                  }
                  options={FREQUENCIES}
                  disabled={!settings.enabled}
                />
                <Input
                  label="Time (HH:mm)"
                  value={settings.time || '02:00'}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({ ...settings, time: e.target.value })
                  }
                  placeholder="02:00"
                  disabled={!settings.enabled}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <Select
                  label="Retention"
                  value={settings.retentionDays ?? 30}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      retentionDays: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  options={RETENTION}
                />
                <Input
                  label="Max backups"
                  type="number"
                  value={settings.maxBackups ?? 10}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      maxBackups: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                />
              </div>
              <Toggle
                label="Email on completion"
                checked={!!settings.emailOnCompletion}
                onChange={(v) =>
                  setSettings({ ...settings, emailOnCompletion: v })
                }
              />
              {settings.emailOnCompletion && (
                <Input
                  label="Notification email"
                  type="email"
                  value={settings.emailRecipient || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({ ...settings, emailRecipient: e.target.value })
                  }
                  placeholder="admin@hdm.co.ke"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      <Modal
        open={emailModal.open}
        onClose={() => setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null })}
        title="Email backup"
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSendEmail} loading={emailSending}>
              Send
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Input
          label="Recipient email"
          type="email"
          hint="Leave empty to send to your own email"
          value={emailTo}
          onChange={(e) => setEmailTo(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="admin@hdm.co.ke"
        />
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, backup: null })}
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
        title="Delete backup"
        message={`Delete ${confirmDelete.backup?.filename}? The file will be removed from Cloudinary and the database.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={deleteBusy}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  const load = useCallback(async () => {

  if (loading && !stats) {

          icon={HiCheckCircle}
          color="text-green-500"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Total users"

                </button>

        </Card>

        <Card
          title="Recent payments"
          description="Latest transactions"
          actions={
            <Button
              size="sm"

              icon={<HiArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
            >
              View all
            </Button>
          }
          padding={false}
        >
          <div className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
            {recentPayments.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-8 text-center">
                No recent payments
              </p>
            ) : (
              recentPayments.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p._id}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/meteo/payments/${p._id}`)}
                  className="w-full text-left px-4 py-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                  type="button"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">

                      {formatMoneyMajor(p.amount, p.currency || 'KES')}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono truncate">
                      {p.reference || p._id?.slice(-8)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                    <Badge variant="success" dot>
                      Paid
                    </Badge>
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                      {relativeTime(p.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\meteo\Health.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  HiServer,
  HiDatabase,
  HiStatusOnline,
  HiMail,
  HiDeviceMobile,
  HiCloud,
  HiRefresh,
  HiSparkles,
  HiCash,
  HiCreditCard,
  HiGlobe,
  HiHeart,
  HiClock,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/meteo/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import { getHealth } from '../../services/meteo/health';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/meteo/formatDate';

const OK_STATES = ['up', 'enabled', 'connected', 'healthy'];
const REFRESH_MS = 30000;

function StatusDot({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn = status === 'disabled' || status === 'degraded';
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
        ok ? 'bg-green-500' : warn ? 'bg-gray-400' : 'bg-red-500'
      }`}
    />
  );
}

export default function Health() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await getHealth();
        setData(res?.data || res);
        setLastUpdated(new Date());
      } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load health');
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [toast]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(() => load(true), REFRESH_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return null;

  const weather = data.weather || {};

      {/* Server â€” expanded */}
      <Card title="Server" className="md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <HiServer className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {s.url || 'API server'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <StatusDot status={s.status} />
            <Badge variant={OK_STATES.includes(s.status) ? 'success' : 'default'}>
              {s.status}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>

          <Stat label="Node" value={s.node} />
          <Stat label="Environment" value={s.env} />
          <Stat label="Hostname" value={s.hostname} />

          <Stat
            label="Platform"
            value={s.platformFull || s.platform}
            hint={s.arch ? `arch: ${s.arch}` : undefined}
          />
          <Stat label="Uptime" value={s.uptimeHuman} hint={
            s.uptimeSeconds ? `${s.uptimeSeconds.toLocaleString()}s` : undefined

          <Stat
            label="Started"
            value={s.startedAt ? formatDate(s.startedAt, 'full') : 'â€”'}

function ServiceCard({ icon: Icon, title, status, children }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{title}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot status={status} />
          <Badge variant={OK_STATES.includes(status) ? 'success' : 'default'}>
            {status || 'unknown'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>
      <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">{children}</dl>
    </Card>
  );
}

function Detail({ label, value, mono }) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd
        className={`text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs text-right truncate ${
          mono ? 'font-mono' : ''
        }`}
        title={String(value)}
      >
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, hint }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-[var(--text-muted)] uppercase tracking-wider">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-0.5 truncate">
        {value ?? 'â€”'}
      </p>
      {hint && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5 truncate">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiCheckCircle,
  HiXCircle,
  HiMail,
  HiRefresh,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/meteo/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/meteo/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/meteo/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/meteo/ui/Select';
import Textarea from '../../components/meteo/ui/Textarea';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import {
  getInvoice,
  approveInvoice,
  cancelInvoice,
  markInvoicePaid,
  resendInvoice,
} from '../../services/meteo/invoices';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/meteo/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/meteo/formatMoney';
import {
  PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES,
  statusVariant,
  statusLabel,
} from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

const METHOD_OPTIONS = PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES.map((m) => ({
  value: m,
  label: statusLabel(m),
}));

export default function InvoiceDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [approveOpen, setApproveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [markPaidOpen, setMarkPaidOpen] = useState(false);
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState('bank');
  const [payRef, setPayRef] = useState('');
  const [payAmount, setPayAmount] = useState('');
  const [cancelOpen, setCancelOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getInvoice(id);
      setInvoice(res?.data || res);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load invoice');
      navigate('/meteo/invoices');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const doApprove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await approveInvoice(id);
      toast.success('Invoice approved');
      setApproveOpen(false);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to approve');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doMarkPaid = async () => {
    if (!payMethod) {
      toast.error('Payment method required');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const body = { method: payMethod, reference: payRef || undefined };
      if (payAmount && !isNaN(Number(payAmount))) {
        body.amountPaid = Number(payAmount);
      }
      await markInvoicePaid(id, body);
      toast.success('Invoice marked paid');
      setMarkPaidOpen(false);
      setPayRef('');
      setPayAmount('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to mark paid');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doCancel = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await cancelInvoice(id, { reason: cancelReason || undefined });
      toast.success('Invoice cancelled');
      setCancelOpen(false);
      setCancelReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to cancel');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doResend = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await resendInvoice(id);
      toast.success('Invoice email sent');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to resend');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!invoice) return null;

  const isPaid = invoice.status === 'paid';
  const isCancelled = invoice.status === 'cancelled';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/meteo/invoices')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {invoice.invoiceNumber}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {invoice.tenant?.name || invoice.tenantName || 'â€”'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(invoice.status)} dot>
          {statusLabel(invoice.status)}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <Card title="Summary">
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Total</dt>
            <dd className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {formatMoneyMajor(invoice.total, invoice.currency || 'KES')}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Amount due</dt>
            <dd
              className={`text-lg font-bold ${
                (invoice.amountDue || 0) > 0
                  ? 'text-red-600'
                  : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'
              }`}
            >
              {formatMoneyMajor(invoice.amountDue || 0, invoice.currency || 'KES')}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Issued</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {invoice.issuedAt ? formatDate(invoice.issuedAt) : 'â€”'}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Due</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {invoice.dueDate ? formatDate(invoice.dueDate) : 'â€”'}
            </dd>
          </div>
        </dl>

        <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {isPaid && (
            <Button
              variant="success"
              size="sm"
              icon={<HiCheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={() => setApproveOpen(true)}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              Approve & activate
            </Button>
          )}
          {!isPaid && !isCancelled && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={() => setMarkPaidOpen(true)}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              Mark paid

          {!isPaid && !isCancelled && (
            <Button
              variant="danger"

              disabled={busy}

              Cancel
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            icon={<HiMail className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={doResend}
            disabled={busy}
            loading={busy}
          >
            Resend email

        </div>
      </Card>

      {Array.isArray(invoice.items) && invoice.items.length > 0 && (
        <Card title="Items" padding={false}>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">

              <thead className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase text-xs">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Description</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Qty</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Unit</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">Total</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">

                  <tr key={i}>

                      {line.name || line.description}

            hint={`Defaults to amount due: ${formatMoneyMajor(
              invoice.amountDue || invoice.total,
              invoice.currency || 'KES'
            )}`}
            value={payAmount}
            onChange={(e) => setPayAmount(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={String(invoice.amountDue || invoice.total)}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Cancel modal */}
      <Modal
        open={cancelOpen}
        onClose={() => setCancelOpen(false)}
        title="Cancel invoice"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCancelOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={doCancel} loading={busy}>
              Cancel invoice
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">
          The invoice will be cancelled. The tenant won't be able to pay it.
        </p>
        <Textarea
          label="Reason"
          hint="Optional"
          value={cancelReason}
          onChange={(e) => setCancelReason(e.target.value)}
          rows={3}
        />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { INVOICE_STATUS_LIST, statusVariant, statusLabel } from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  { value: '', label: 'All statuses' },
  ...INVOICE_STATUS_LIST.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: statusLabel(s) })),
];

export default function Invoices() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [tenantId, setTenantId] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    getInvoices({
      page,
      limit: 20,
      status: status || undefined,
      tenantId: tenantId || undefined,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const data = res?.data || res;
        setItems(data?.items || []);
        setMeta(data?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [page, status, tenantId]);

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'invoiceNumber',
      label: 'Invoice',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-mono text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">

        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'tenant',
      label: 'Tenant',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          {row.tenant?.name || row.tenantName || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'total',
      label: 'Total',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          {formatMoneyMajor(row.total, row.currency || 'KES')}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'amountDue',
      label: 'Due',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span
          className={
            row.amountDue > 0
              ? 'font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'
              : 'text-[var(--text-muted)]'
          }
        >
          {formatMoneyMajor(row.amountDue || 0, row.currency || 'KES')}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>
          {statusLabel(row.status)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'dueDate',
      label: 'Due',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.dueDate ? formatDate(row.dueDate) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\meteo\Login.jsx =====
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Link, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiCloud } from 'react-icons/hi';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/meteo/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import Input from '../../components/meteo/ui/Input';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';

export default function Login() {
  const { login, status } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/meteo';

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (status === 'idle' || status === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-primary)] flex items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === 'authenticated') {
    return <Navigate to={from} replace />;
  }

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      toast.success('Welcome back');
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
      <Link
        to="/"
        className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors"
      >
        <HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Return Home
      </Link>

      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-purple-600 text-white mb-4">
            <HiCloud className="w-8 h-8" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            HDM METEO
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1">
            Admin access only
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4 text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="admin@hdm.co.ke"
            autoComplete="email"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          <Button type="submit" fullWidth size="lg" loading={submitting}>
            Sign In
          </Button>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\meteo\PaymentDetail.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiRefresh } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/meteo/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/meteo/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/meteo/ui/Input';
import Textarea from '../../components/meteo/ui/Textarea';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/meteo/AuthContext';
import {
  getPayment,
  refundPayment,
} from '../../services/meteo/payments';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../utils/meteo/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/meteo/formatMoney';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel } from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

export default function PaymentDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperAdmin } = useAuth();

  const [payment, setPayment] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [refundOpen, setRefundOpen] = useState(false);
  const [refundAmount, setRefundAmount] = useState('');
  const [refundReason, setRefundReason] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPayment(id);
      setPayment(res?.data || res);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load payment');
      navigate('/meteo/payments');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const doRefund = async () => {
    if (!refundReason.trim()) {
      toast.error('Reason is required');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const body = { reason: refundReason.trim() };
      if (refundAmount && !isNaN(Number(refundAmount))) {
        body.amount = Number(refundAmount);
      }
      await refundPayment(id, body);
      toast.success('Refund processed');
      setRefundOpen(false);
      setRefundAmount('');
      setRefundReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to refund');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!payment) return null;

  const isRefund = payment.type === 'refund';
  const canRefund = !isRefund && payment.status === 'success';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-3xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/meteo/payments')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {isRefund ? 'Refund' : 'Payment'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {payment.reference || payment._id}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge variant={isRefund ? 'info' : 'success'}>
            {statusLabel(payment.type || 'payment')}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant={statusVariant(payment.status)} dot>
            {statusLabel(payment.status)}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card title="Summary">
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Amount</dt>
            <dd className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {formatMoneyMajor(payment.amount, payment.currency || 'KES')}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Method</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {statusLabel(payment.method)}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Tenant</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {payment.tenant?.name || payment.tenantName || 'â€”'}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Invoice</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {payment.invoiceNumber || 'â€”'}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Created</dt>
            <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              {payment.createdAt ? formatDateTime(payment.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
            </dd>
          </div>
          {payment.reason && (
            <div className="col-span-2">
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs">Reason</dt>
              <dd className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {payment.reason}
              </dd>
            </div>
          )}
        </dl>

        {canRefund && (
          <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-[var(--border-color)] flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            {isSuperAdmin ? (
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                size="sm"
                icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
                onClick={() => setRefundOpen(true)}
                disabled={busy}
              >
                Refund
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                Refunds require super admin access.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={refundOpen}
        onClose={() => setRefundOpen(false)}
        title="Refund payment"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRefundOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={doRefund} loading={busy}>
              Refund
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            This will create a refund record for{' '}
            <strong>{payment.tenant?.name || 'this tenant'}</strong> and send a
            refund email.
          </p>
          <Input
            label="Refund amount (optional)"
            type="number"
            hint={`Defaults to ${formatMoneyMajor(payment.amount, payment.currency || 'KES')}`}
            value={refundAmount}
            onChange={(e) => setRefundAmount(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={String(payment.amount)}
          />
          <Textarea
            label="Reason *"
            value={refundReason}
            onChange={(e) => setRefundReason(e.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            placeholder="Customer requested"
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\meteo\PaymentMethods.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { HiCog, HiPlus, HiTrash } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/meteo/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/meteo/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/meteo/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/meteo/ui/Select';
import Toggle from '../../components/meteo/ui/Toggle';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/meteo/AuthContext';
import {
  getPaymentMethods,
  createPaymentMethod,
  updatePaymentMethod,
  togglePaymentMethod,
  deletePaymentMethod,
} from '../../services/meteo/paymentMethods';
import {
  PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES,
  PAYMENT_METHOD_MODES,
} from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

export default function PaymentMethods() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { isSuperAdmin } = useAuth();

  const [methods, setMethods] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);

  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, mode: 'edit', method: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    code: 'mpesa_till',
    label: '',
    mode: 'manual',
    enabled: true,
    config: {},
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, method: null });

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPaymentMethods();
      const data = res?.data || res;
      setMethods(data?.methods || []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load methods');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm({
      code: 'mpesa_till',
      label: '',
      mode: 'manual',
      enabled: true,
      config: {},
    });
    setModal({ open: true, mode: 'create', method: null });
  };

  const openEdit = (m) => {
    setForm({
      code: m.code || '',
      label: m.label || '',
      mode: m.mode || 'manual',
      enabled: m.enabled !== false,
      config: { ...(m.config || {}) },
    });
    setModal({ open: true, mode: 'edit', method: m });
  };

  const patch = (key, value) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  const patchConfig = (key, value) =>
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, config: { ...prev.config, [key]: value } }));

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.label.trim()) {
      toast.error('Label is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (modal.mode === 'create') {
        await createPaymentMethod({
          code: form.code,
          label: form.label,
          mode: form.mode,
          enabled: form.enabled,
          config: form.config,
        });
        toast.success('Method created');
      } else {
        await updatePaymentMethod(modal.method._id || modal.method.id, {
          label: form.label,
          mode: form.mode,
          enabled: form.enabled,
          config: form.config,
        });
        toast.success('Method updated');
      }
      setModal({ open: false, mode: 'edit', method: null });
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggle = async (m) => {
    const id = m._id || m.id;
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      await togglePaymentMethod(id);
      toast.success(`${m.label} ${m.enabled ? 'disabled' : 'enabled'}`);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to toggle');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.method) return;
    const id = confirmDelete.method._id || confirmDelete.method.id;
    setBusyId(id);
    try {
      await deletePaymentMethod(id);
      toast.success('Method deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, method: null });
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const renderConfigFields = () => {
    switch (form.code) {
      case 'mpesa_till':
        return (
          <>
            <Input
              label="Till number"
              value={form.config.tillNumber || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('tillNumber', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Business name"
              value={form.config.name || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('name', e.target.value)}
            />
          </>
        );
      case 'mpesa_paybill':
        return (
          <>
            <Input
              label="Paybill number"
              value={form.config.paybillNumber || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('paybillNumber', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Account number"
              value={form.config.accountNumber || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('accountNumber', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Business name"
              value={form.config.name || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('name', e.target.value)}
            />
          </>
        );
      case 'mpesa_send':
        return (
          <>
            <Input
              label="Receiving phone"
              value={form.config.phone || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('phone', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Display name"
              value={form.config.name || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('name', e.target.value)}
            />
          </>
        );
      case 'bank':
        return (
          <>
            <Input
              label="Bank name"
              value={form.config.bankName || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('bankName', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Account name"
              value={form.config.accountName || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('accountName', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Account number"
              value={form.config.accountNumber || ''}
              onChange={(e) => patchConfig('accountNumber', e.target.value)}
            />
          </>
        );
      case 'stripe':
        return (
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            Stripe credentials are managed on the server.
          </p>
        );
      case 'mpesa_stk':
        return (
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            M-Pesa STK credentials are managed on the server.
          </p>
        );
      case 'cash':
        return (
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            No configuration needed.
          </p>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Payment methods
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {methods.length} methods configured
          </p>
        </div>
        {isSuperAdmin && (
          <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreate}>
            New method
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {methods.map((m) => {
          const id = m._id || m.id;
          return (
            <Card key={id}>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
                    <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                      {m.label}
                    </p>
                    <Badge variant={m.mode === 'auto' ? 'info' : 'default'}>
                      {m.mode}
                    </Badge>
                    <Badge variant={m.enabled ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
                      {m.enabled ? 'On' : 'Off'}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                    {m.code}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                  {isSuperAdmin && (
                    <>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openEdit(m)}
                        className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
                        type="button"
                        title="Edit"
                      >
                        <HiCog className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, method: m })}
                        className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 text-red-600"
                        type="button"
                        title="Delete"
                      >
                        <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleToggle(m)}
                    disabled={busyId === id || !isSuperAdmin}
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition disabled:opacity-50 ${
                      m.enabled ? 'bg-violet-600' : 'bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600'
                    }`}
                    type="button"
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white transition ${
                        m.enabled ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={modal.open}
        onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, mode: 'edit', method: null })}
        title={modal.mode === 'create' ? 'Create payment method' : `Edit ${modal.method?.label || ''}`}
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setModal({ open: false, mode: 'edit', method: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} loading={saving}>
              Save
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {modal.mode === 'create' && (
            <Select
              label="Code"
              value={form.code}
              onChange={(e) => patch('code', e.target.value)}
              options={PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES.map((c) => ({
                value: c,
                label: c,
              }))}
            />
          )}
          <Input
            label="Label *"
            value={form.label}
            onChange={(e) => patch('label', e.target.value)}
          />
          <Select
            label="Mode"
            value={form.mode}
            onChange={(e) => patch('mode', e.target.value)}
            options={PAYMENT_METHOD_MODES}
          />
          <Toggle
            label="Enabled"
            checked={form.enabled}
            onChange={(v) => patch('enabled', v)}
          />
          <div className="border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
              Config
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-3">{renderConfigFields()}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, method: null })}
        title="Delete method"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, method: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={handleDelete} loading={!!busyId}>
              Delete
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          Delete <strong>{confirmDelete.method?.label}</strong>? You must disable
          it first.
        </p>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiClock,
  HiRefresh,
  HiInbox,
  HiArrowUp,
} from 'react-icons/hi';

import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';

import { getPendingList } from '../../services/meteo/pending';
import { relativeTime } from '../../utils/meteo/formatDate';
import { statusVariant, statusLabel } from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

const TABS = [
  { key: 'registrations', label: 'Registrations', icon: HiInbox },
  { key: 'renewals', label: 'Renewals', icon: HiRefresh },
  { key: 'upgrades', label: 'Upgrades', icon: HiArrowUp },
];

const POLL_MS = 30000;

export default function Pending() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState('registrations');
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await getPendingList({ tab, page, limit: 20 });
        setData(res?.data || res);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load pending');
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [tab, page, toast]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tab, page]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => load(true), POLL_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tab, page]);

  const counts = data?.counts || {
    registrations: 0,
    renewals: 0,
    upgrades: 0,
  };
  const items = data?.items || [];
  const meta = data?.meta || { total: 0, page: 1, pages: 1 };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Business',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.name || row.tenant?.name || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            {row.slug || row.tenant?.slug || row._id?.slice(-8)}
          </p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'planCode',
      label: 'Plan',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant="info">
          {row.planCode || row.tenant?.planCode || 'â€”'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>
          {statusLabel(row.status)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Created',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {relativeTime(row.createdAt)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            navigate(`/meteo/pending/${row._id || row.id}`);
          }}
        >
          Review
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          Pending approvals
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
          {meta.total} awaiting review
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Tab strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        {TABS.map((t) => {
          const Icon = t.icon;
          const count = counts[t.key] || 0;
          const isActive = tab === t.key;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setTab(t.key);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl border text-left transition ${
                isActive
                  ? 'border-violet-300 dark:border-violet-800 bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/30'
                  : 'border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--card-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                <Icon
                  className={`w-5 h-5 shrink-0 ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400'
                      : 'text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                  }`}
                />
                <span
                  className={`text-sm font-medium truncate ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300'
                      : 'text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </span>
              </div>
              <Badge
                variant={count === 0 ? 'default' : 'warning'}
                dot={count > 0}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={items}
            loading={loading}
            rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
            onRowClick={(row) =>
              navigate(`/meteo/pending/${row._id || row.id}`)
            }
            emptyMessage={`No ${tab} awaiting review`}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiCheckCircle,
  HiXCircle,
  HiCreditCard,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/meteo/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/meteo/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/meteo/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/meteo/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/meteo/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/meteo/ui/Select';
import Textarea from '../../components/meteo/ui/Textarea';
import Spinner from '../../components/meteo/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/meteo/ToastContext';
import {
  getPending,
  approvePending,
  rejectPending,
  confirmPendingPayment,
} from '../../services/meteo/pending';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/meteo/formatDate';
import { formatMoneyMajor } from '../../utils/meteo/formatMoney';
import {
  PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES,
  statusVariant,
  statusLabel,
} from '../../utils/meteo/constants';

const REASONS = [
  'Incomplete business information',
  'Unable to verify business',
  'Duplicate account',
  'Suspected fraud',
  'Outside service area',
  'Other',
];

const METHOD_OPTIONS = PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES.map((m) => ({
  value: m,
  label: statusLabel(m),
}));

export default function PendingDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [approveOpen, setApproveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [approveNotes, setApproveNotes] = useState('');

  const [rejectOpen, setRejectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState(REASONS[0]);
  const [rejectCustom, setRejectCustom] = useState('');

  const [payOpen, setPayOpen] = useState(false);
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState('mpesa_stk');
  const [payRef, setPayRef] = useState('');
  const [payNote, setPayNote] = useState('');

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPending(id);
      setData(res?.data || res);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load');
      navigate('/meteo/pending');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const doApprove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await approvePending(id, { notes: approveNotes });
      toast.success('Tenant approved');
      setApproveOpen(false);
      navigate('/meteo/pending');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to approve');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doReject = async () => {
    const finalReason =
      rejectReason === 'Other' ? rejectCustom.trim() : rejectReason;
    if (!finalReason) {
      toast.error('Reason is required');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await rejectPending(id, { reason: finalReason });
      toast.success('Tenant rejected');
      setRejectOpen(false);
      navigate('/meteo/pending');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to reject');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const doConfirmPayment = async () => {
    if (!payMethod) {
      toast.error('Payment method is required');
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await confirmPendingPayment(id, {
        method: payMethod,
        reference: payRef || undefined,
        note: payNote || undefined,
      });
      toast.success('Payment confirmed');
      setPayOpen(false);
      setPayRef('');
      setPayNote('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to confirm payment');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return null;

  const { tenant, owner, invoice } = data;
  const invoicePaid = invoice?.status === 'paid';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-24">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/meteo/pending')}
        >
          Back to queue
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {tenant?.name || 'â€”'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {tenant?.slug || 'â€”'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {tenant?.status && (
            <Badge variant={statusVariant(tenant.status)} dot>
              {statusLabel(tenant.status)}
            </Badge>
          )}
          {invoice && (
            <Badge variant={invoicePaid ? 'success' : 'warning'} dot>
              {invoicePaid ? 'Payment confirmed' : 'Payment pending'}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <Card title="Tenant">

              <span className="font-mono text-xs">

              </span>

            <Row label="Plan">
              <span className="capitalize">
                {tenant?.planCode || 'â€”'}
              </span>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Status">
              <Badge variant={statusVariant(tenant?.status)}>
                {statusLabel(tenant?.status)}
              </Badge>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Created">
              {tenant?.createdAt
                ? formatDate(tenant.createdAt, 'full')
                : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
          </dl>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Owner">
          {owner ? (
            <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <Row label="Name">{owner.fullName || 'â€”'}</Row>
              <Row label="Email">
                <span className="text-xs">{owner.email}</span>
              </Row>
              {owner.phone && <Row label="Phone">{owner.phone}</Row>}
            </dl>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">
              No owner on record.
            </p>

              No invoice on record.
            </p>
          )}

        <Card title="Payment instructions (shown to customer)">

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            icon={<HiCreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => setPayOpen(true)}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            Confirm payment
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          onClick={() => setRejectOpen(true)}
          icon={<HiXCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
          disabled={busy}
        >
          Reject
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={() => setApproveOpen(true)}
          icon={<HiCheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
          disabled={busy}
        >
          Approve
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Approve modal */}
      <Modal
        open={approveOpen}
        onClose={() => setApproveOpen(false)}
        title="Approve tenant"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setApproveOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={doApprove} loading={busy}>
              Approve
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">
          <strong>{tenant?.name}</strong> will be activated and the owner
          notified.
        </p>
        <Textarea
          label="Internal notes"
          hint="Optional"
          value={approveNotes}
          onChange={(e) => setApproveNotes(e.target.value)}
          rows={3}
        />
      </Modal>

      {/* Reject modal */}
      <Modal
        open={rejectOpen}
        onClose={() => setRejectOpen(false)}
        title="Reject tenant"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRejectOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={doReject} loading={busy}>
              Reject
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">
          The owner of <strong>{tenant?.name}</strong> will be emailed the
          reason.
        </p>
        <Select
          label="Reason"
          value={rejectReason}
          onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
          options={REASONS.map((r) => ({ value: r, label: r }))}
        />
        {rejectReason === 'Other' && (
          <div className="mt-4">
            <Textarea
              label="Details"
              value={rejectCustom}
              onChange={(e) => setRejectCustom(e.target.value)}
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </Modal>

      {/* Confirm payment modal */}
      <Modal
        open={payOpen}
        onClose={() => setPayOpen(false)}
        title="Confirm payment"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setPayOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={doConfirmPayment} loading={busy}>
              Confirm payment
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {invoice && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] rounded-lg text-sm">
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Invoice</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                  {invoice.invoiceNumber}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Amount due</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-violet-600">
                  {formatMoneyMajor(invoice.amountDue, invoice.currency || 'KES')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <Select
            label="Payment method"
            value={payMethod}
            onChange={(e) => setPayMethod(e.target.value)}
            options={METHOD_OPTIONS}
          />
          <Input
            label="Reference"
            value={payRef}
            onChange={(e) => setPayRef(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="QK47ABC123"
          />
          <Textarea
            label="Internal note"
            hint="Optional"
            value={payNote}
            onChange={(e) => setPayNote(e.target.value)}
            rows={2}
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-right text-xs break-all">
        {children}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
