import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  getApps,
  createApp,
  updateApp,
  deleteApp,
} from '../../services/portfolio/apps';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Toggle from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Toggle';
import SearchBar from '../../components/portfolio/ui/SearchBar';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { HiPencil, HiTrash, HiStar, HiPlus } from 'react-icons/hi';

const CATEGORIES = [
  'Web Apps',
  'Mobile',
  'Desktop',
  'APIs',
  'Games',
  'Open Source',
  'Security',
  'Other',
];

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  name: '',
  slug: '',
  shortDescription: '',
  description: '',
  category: 'Web Apps',
  technologies: [],
  icon: '',
  screenshots: [],
  urls: { live: '', github: '', playstore: '', appstore: '' },
  features: [],
  featured: false,
  rating: 0,
  version: '1.0.0',
  isActive: true,
};

export default function Apps() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [apps, setApps] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, app: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, id: null });

  const fetchApps = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getApps()
      .then((res) => setApps(res.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load apps'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchApps();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const filtered = apps.filter(
    (a) =>
      !search.trim() ||
      a.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      a.category?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const autoSlug = (name) =>
    name
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setModal({ open: true, app: null });
  };

  const openEdit = (app) => {
    setForm({
      ...EMPTY_FORM,
      ...app,
      urls: { ...EMPTY_FORM.urls, ...(app.urls || {}) },
    });
    setModal({ open: true, app });
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      toast.error('Name is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        slug: form.slug?.trim() || autoSlug(form.name),
      };
      if (modal.app) await updateApp(modal.app._id, payload);
      else await createApp(payload);
      toast.success(modal.app ? 'App updated' : 'App created');
      setModal({ open: false, app: null });
      fetchApps();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try {
      await deleteApp(confirmDelete.id);
      toast.success('App deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null });
      fetchApps();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'Name',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {row.icon && (
            <img
              src={row.icon}
              alt=""
              className="w-6 h-6 rounded"
              onError={(e) => {
                e.target.style.display = 'none';
              }}
            />
          )}
          <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.name}
          </span>
          {row.featured && <HiStar className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'category',
      label: 'Category',
      render: (row) => <Badge variant="green">{row.category || 'â€”'}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'rating',
      label: 'Rating',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          {row.rating || 0}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'isActive',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) =>
        row.isActive !== false ? (
          <Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge variant="default">Inactive</Badge>
        ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => openEdit(row)}>
            <HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="danger"
            onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: row._id })}
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6 gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Apps
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {apps.length} app{apps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-1 sm:flex-none">
          <div className="flex-1 sm:w-64">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={setSearch}
              placeholder="Search apps..."
            />
          </div>
          <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreate}>
            New App
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={filtered}
            loading={loading}
            emptyMessage="No apps yet."
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={modal.open}
        onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, app: null })}
        title={modal.app ? 'Edit App' : 'New App'}
        size="lg"
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Name *"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm((p) => ({ ...p, name: e.target.value }))
              }
            />
            <Input
              label="Slug"
              hint="Auto-generated from name"
              value={form.slug}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm((p) => ({ ...p, slug: e.target.value }))
              }
              placeholder={autoSlug(form.name)}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Category
            </label>
            <select
              value={form.category}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm((p) => ({ ...p, category: e.target.value }))
              }
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500"
            >
              {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                <option key={c} value={c}>
                  {c}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <Input
            label="Short Description"
            value={form.shortDescription}

              }))

            />

              onChange={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, isActive: v }))}
            />
          </div>

              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setModal({ open: false, app: null })}

            </Button>

              Save
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null })}
        title="Delete App"
        message="Permanently delete this app?"
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  getBackups,
  getBackupSettings,
  updateBackupSettings,
  createBackup,
  uploadBackup,
  sendBackupEmail,
  cleanupBackups,
  downloadBackup,
  deleteBackup,
  restoreBackup,
} from '../../services/portfolio/backups';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Table';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Toggle from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Toggle';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import Spinner from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/portfolio/formatDate';
import {
  HiDownload,
  HiTrash,
  HiRefresh,
  HiCloud,
  HiServer,
  HiPlus,
  HiClock,
  HiCog,
  HiMail,
  HiUpload,
  HiPlay,
} from 'react-icons/hi';

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
  enabled: false,
  frequency: 'daily',
  time: '02:00',
  retentionDays: 30,
  maxBackups: 10,
  emailOnCompletion: false,
  emailRecipient: '',
};

export default function Backups() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const uploadRef = useRef(null);

  const [backups, setBackups] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  const [savingSettings, setSavingSettings] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [createModal, setCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [backupForm, setBackupForm] = useState({
    type: 'manual',
    compressionType: 'gzip',
    includesMedia: false,
  });
  const [emailModal, setEmailModal] = useState({ open: false, id: null });
  const [emailTo, setEmailTo] = useState('');
  const [emailSending, setEmailSending] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, id: null });
  const [confirmRestore, setConfirmRestore] = useState({
    open: false,
    backup: null,
  });
  const [restoreConfirmText, setRestoreConfirmText] = useState('');
  const [restoreBusy, setRestoreBusy] = useState(false);
  const [cleanupBusy, setCleanupBusy] = useState(false);
  const [uploadBusy, setUploadBusy] = useState(false);

  const fetchBackups = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getBackups()
      .then((res) => setBackups(res.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load backups'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBackups();
    getBackupSettings()
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res.data || res;
        if (data) setSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...data });
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await createBackup(backupForm);
      toast.success('Backup created');
      setCreateModal(false);
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create backup');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try {
      await deleteBackup(confirmDelete.id);
      toast.success('Backup deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null });
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async () => {
    if (restoreConfirmText !== 'RESTORE') return;
    setRestoreBusy(true);
    try {
      await restoreBackup(confirmRestore.backup._id);
      toast.success('Restore completed');
      setConfirmRestore({ open: false, backup: null });
      setRestoreConfirmText('');
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to restore');
    } finally {
      setRestoreBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = async (backup) => {
    try {
      await downloadBackup(backup._id);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Download failed');
    }
  };

  const handleSendEmail = async () => {
    if (!emailTo.trim()) return;
    setEmailSending(true);
    try {
      await sendBackupEmail(emailModal.id, emailTo.trim());
      toast.success(`Backup sent to ${emailTo}`);
      setEmailModal({ open: false, id: null });
      setEmailTo('');
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to send');
    } finally {
      setEmailSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCleanup = async () => {
    setCleanupBusy(true);
    try {
      await cleanupBackups();
      toast.success('Cleanup completed');
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Cleanup failed');
    } finally {
      setCleanupBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.name.endsWith('.json')) {
      toast.error('Only .json backup files are allowed');
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 100 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error('Max file size is 100 MB');
      return;
    }
    setUploadBusy(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    try {
      await uploadBackup(formData);
      toast.success('Backup uploaded');
      fetchBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setUploadBusy(false);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSettings = async () => {
    setSavingSettings(true);
    try {
      await updateBackupSettings(settings);
      toast.success('Settings saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save settings');
    } finally {
      setSavingSettings(false);
    }
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes) return 'â€”';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'type',
      label: 'Type',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={row.type === 'auto' ? 'info' : 'green'}>
          {row.type || 'manual'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'storage',
      label: 'Storage',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {row.fileUrl ? (
            <>
              <HiCloud className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Cloud</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <HiServer className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Local</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'fileName',
      label: 'File',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate max-w-[240px] block">
          {row.fileName || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'fileSize',
      label: 'Size',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs">{formatFileSize(row.fileSize)}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge
          variant={
            row.status === 'completed'
              ? 'success'
              : row.status === 'failed'
              ? 'danger'
              : 'warning'
          }
        >
          {row.status || 'completed'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Created',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {formatDate(row.createdAt, 'full')}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => handleDownload(row)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Download"
          >
            <HiDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setEmailTo('');
              setEmailModal({ open: true, id: row._id });
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Send by email"
          >
            <HiMail className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setRestoreConfirmText('');
              setConfirmRestore({ open: true, backup: row });
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Restore"
          >
            <HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: row._id })}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-red-600"
            type="button"
            title="Delete"
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            System Backups
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {backups.length} backup{backups.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={<HiPlay className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={handleCleanup}
            loading={cleanupBusy}
          >
            Run Cleanup
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={<HiUpload className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => uploadRef.current?.click()}
            loading={uploadBusy}
          >
            Upload Backup
          </Button>
          <input
            ref={uploadRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".json"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={handleUpload}
          />
          <Button
            icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => setCreateModal(true)}
          >
            Create Backup
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Settings */}
      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
          <HiClock className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Auto-Backup
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Toggle
              label="Enable Auto-Backup"
              description="Automatically create backups on schedule"
              checked={settings.enabled}
              onChange={(v) => setSettings((p) => ({ ...p, enabled: v }))}
            />
            {settings.enabled && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                    Frequency
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={settings.frequency}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSettings((p) => ({ ...p, frequency: e.target.value }))
                    }
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500"

          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Delete Confirm */}

        message="Permanently delete this backup? The file is also removed from storage."
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  const [folderContents, setFolderContents] = useState({ resources: [], subFolders: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState([]);
  const [previewModal, setPreviewModal] = useState({ open: false, url: '' });
  const [newFolderModal, setNewFolderModal] = useState(false);
  const [newFolderPath, setNewFolderPath] = useState('');
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState({ open: false, type: '', target: '' });
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  const fetchData = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      getCloudinaryStats().catch(() => ({})),
      currentFolder
        ? getCloudinaryFolder(currentFolder).catch(() => ({ resources: [], subFolders: [] }))
        : getCloudinaryFolders().catch(() => ({ folders: [], rootFiles: [] })),
    ]).then(([s, f]) => {
      setStats(s?.data || s || {});
      if (currentFolder) {
        const d = f?.data || f || {};
        setFolderContents({ resources: d.resources || [], subFolders: d.subFolders || [] });
      } else {
        const d = f?.data || f || {};
        setFolders(d.folders || []);
        setRootFiles(d.rootFiles || []);
      }
    }).catch(console.error).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [currentFolder]);

  const navigateToFolder = (folder) => { setCurrentFolder(folder); setSelected([]); };

  const goBack = () => {
    const parts = currentFolder.split('/');
    parts.pop();
    setCurrentFolder(parts.join('/'));
    setSelected([]);
  };

  const toggleSelect = (publicId) => {
    setSelected(prev => prev.includes(publicId) ? prev.filter(i => i !== publicId) : [...prev, publicId]);
  };

  const selectAll = () => {
    const files = currentFolder ? (folderContents.resources || []) : (rootFiles || []);
    if (selected.length === files.length) setSelected([]);
    else setSelected(files.map(f => f.public_id));
  };

  const handleDeleteFiles = async () => {
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    setActionLoading(true);
    try { await deleteCloudinaryFiles(selected); setSelected([]); fetchData(); }
    catch (e) { alert(e.message); }
    setActionLoading(false);
    setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', target: '' });
  };

  const handleUpload = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setActionLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    if (currentFolder) formData.append('folder', currentFolder);
    try { await uploadCloudinaryFile(formData); fetchData(); }
    catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
    setActionLoading(false);
  };

  const handleCreateFolder = async () => {
    if (!newFolderPath.trim()) return alert('Enter folder name');
    const path = currentFolder ? `${currentFolder}/${newFolderPath}` : newFolderPath;
    setActionLoading(true);
    try { await createCloudinaryFolder(path); setNewFolderModal(false); setNewFolderPath(''); fetchData(); }
    catch (e) { alert(e.message); }
    setActionLoading(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteFolder = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try { await deleteCloudinaryFolder(deleteConfirm.target); setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', target: '' }); fetchData(); }
    catch (e) { alert(e.message); }
    setActionLoading(false);
  };

  const formatBytes = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes) return '0 MB';
    const mb = bytes / 1024 / 1024;
    if (mb >= 1024) return `${(mb / 1024).toFixed(1)} GB`;
    return `${mb.toFixed(1)} MB`;
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes) return 'â€”';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><Spinner size="lg" /></div>;

  const files = currentFolder ? (folderContents.resources || []) : (rootFiles || []);
  const subFolders = currentFolder ? (folderContents.subFolders || []) : [];

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-6">â˜ï¸ Cloudinary Management</h1>

      {/* Stats */}
      {stats && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
          <Card>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Storage</p>
            <div className="w-full bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-full h-2.5 mt-2 mb-1">
              <div className="bg-green-600 h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${Math.min(stats.credits?.used_percent || 0, 100)}%` }} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{formatBytes(stats.storage?.usage)} / âˆž (Free plan)</p>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Credits</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{stats.credits?.usage || 0} / {stats.credits?.limit || 25}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">({stats.credits?.used_percent || 0}%)</p>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Resources</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{stats.resources || 0} files</p>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Bandwidth</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{formatBytes(stats.bandwidth?.usage)}</p>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {currentFolder && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={goBack}>â† Back</Button>
          )}
          <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            {currentFolder ? (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><HiFolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" /> {currentFolder}/</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><HiFolder className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" /> Root</span>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] ml-2">({files.length} files)</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setNewFolderModal(true)}><HiPlus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> New Folder</Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}><HiUpload className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Upload</Button>
          <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" className="hidden" onChange={handleUpload} />
          {selected.length > 0 && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm({ open: true, type: 'files', target: '' })}>
              <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Delete ({selected.length})
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Folders Panel */}
        <Card>
          <h3 className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-3">Folders</h3>
          {currentFolder ? (
            subFolders.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {subFolders.map(f => (
                  <button key={f.path || f.name} onClick={() => navigateToFolder(f.path || f.name)}
                    className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-left">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                      <HiFolder className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" /> {f.name || f.path?.split('/').pop()}
                    </span>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setDeleteConfirm({ open: true, type: 'folder', target: f.path || f.name }); }}>
                      <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                    </Button>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-8">
                <HiFolder className="w-10 h-10 text-[var(--text-muted)] mx-auto mb-2" />
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No subfolders</p>
              </div>
            )
          ) : (
            folders.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {folders.map(f => (
                  <button key={f.path || f.name} onClick={() => navigateToFolder(f.path || f.name)}
                    className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-left">
                    <HiFolder className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">{f.name || f.path}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-8">
                <HiFolder className="w-10 h-10 text-[var(--text-muted)] mx-auto mb-2" />
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No folders</p>
              </div>
            )
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* Files Panel */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <h3 className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">Files</h3>
            {files.length > 0 && (
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] cursor-pointer">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={selected.length === files.length && files.length > 0} onChange={selectAll} className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600 rounded" />
                Select All
              </label>
            )}
          </div>
          {files.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              {files.map(file => (
                <div key={file.public_id || file.asset_id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] group">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(file.public_id)} onChange={() => toggleSelect(file.public_id)} className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600 rounded flex-shrink-0" />
                    <button onClick={() => {
                      if (file.format === 'pdf') window.open(file.secure_url || file.url, '_blank');
                      else setPreviewModal({ open: true, url: file.secure_url || file.url });
                    }} className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      {file.format === 'pdf' ? <HiDocument className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500 flex-shrink-0" /> : <HiPhotograph className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500 flex-shrink-0" />}
                      <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">{file.public_id?.split('/').pop() || file.display_name || 'Unknown'}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] hidden sm:block">{formatFileSize(file.bytes)}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] hidden md:block">{file.format?.toUpperCase()}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] hidden lg:block">{file.width}Ã—{file.height}</span>
                    <button onClick={() => window.open(file.secure_url || file.url, '_blank')} className="text-xs text-green-600 hover:underline hidden group-hover:inline">View</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12">
              <HiPhotograph className="w-12 h-12 text-[var(--text-muted)] mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No files in this folder</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">Upload files or select a different folder</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Preview Modal */}
      <Modal open={previewModal.open} onClose={() => setPreviewModal({ open: false, url: '' })} title="Preview" size="xl">
        {previewModal.url && (
          <img src={previewModal.url} alt="Preview" className="max-w-full max-h-[75vh] rounded-lg object-contain mx-auto" />
        )}
      </Modal>

      {/* New Folder Modal */}
      <Modal open={newFolderModal} onClose={() => setNewFolderModal(false)} title="Create Folder" size="sm">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            {currentFolder ? `Creating folder in: ${currentFolder}/` : 'Creating folder in root'}
          </p>
          <Input label="Folder Name" value={newFolderPath} onChange={e => setNewFolderPath(e.target.value)} placeholder="new-folder" />
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setNewFolderModal(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCreateFolder} loading={actionLoading}>Create</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Delete Confirm */}
      <ConfirmDialog open={deleteConfirm.open} onClose={() => setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', target: '' })}
        onConfirm={deleteConfirm.type === 'folder' ? handleDeleteFolder : handleDeleteFiles}
        title={`Delete ${deleteConfirm.type === 'folder' ? 'Folder' : `${selected.length} File(s)`}`}
        message={deleteConfirm.type === 'folder'
          ? `Delete folder "${deleteConfirm.target}" and all its contents? This cannot be undone.`
          : `Delete ${selected.length} selected file(s)? This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete" variant="danger" loading={actionLoading} />
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\portfolio\communication\CommunicationTabBase.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  HiPlus,
  HiRefresh,
  HiTrash,
  HiPencil,
  HiEye,
  HiCheckCircle,
  HiMinusCircle,
  HiMail,
  HiDeviceMobile,
  HiPrinter,
  HiDocumentDownload,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Textarea from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Textarea';
import Spinner from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/Spinner';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { useHdm } from '../../../context/portfolio/HdmContext';
import { exportElementToPdf, printElement } from '../../../utils/portfolio/pdfExport';
import {
  listCommunications,
  getCommunication,
  createCommunication,
  updateCommunication,
  deleteCommunication,
  publishCommunication,
  unpublishCommunication,
  archiveCommunication,
  regenerateAdvert,
  uploadCommunicationImage,
  removeCommunicationImage,
  sendCommunicationEmail,
  sendCommunicationSms,
} from '../../../services/portfolio/communications';

const STATUS_VARIANT = {
  draft: 'default',
  published: 'success',
  archived: 'default',
};

const STATUS_FILTERS = [
  { value: '', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'draft', label: 'Drafts' },
  { value: 'published', label: 'Published' },
  { value: 'archived', label: 'Archived' },
];

export default function CommunicationTabBase({
  type,
  label,
  icon = 'ðŸ“„',
  fields = [],
  advertKinds = null,
  titlePlaceholder = 'Title',
  bodyPlaceholder = 'Write the content...',
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { company } = useHdm();

  const [view, setView] = useState('list');
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ total: 0, drafts: 0, published: 0, archived: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [statusLoading, setStatusLoading] = useState(null);
  const [rowAction, setRowAction] = useState(null);
  const [pdfLoading, setPdfLoading] = useState(false);

  const [createForm, setCreateForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    subtitle: '',
    body: '',
    fields: {},
    advertKind: advertKinds ? advertKinds[0].value : null,
  });
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState({ open: false, action: null });
  const [sendPanel, setSendPanel] = useState(null);
  const [emailInput, setEmailInput] = useState('');
  const [smsInput, setSmsInput] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const printRef = useRef(null);

  /* ============================================================
     Load list
     ============================================================ */
  const loadList = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await listCommunications({
          type,
          status: statusFilter || undefined,
          search: search || undefined,
        });
        const data = res?.data || res;
        setItems(data.communications || []);
        if (data.stats) setStats(data.stats);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load');
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [type, statusFilter, search, toast]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view === 'list') loadList();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [view, statusFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view !== 'list') return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => loadList(true), 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [search]);

  /* ============================================================
     Load detail
     ============================================================ */
  const loadDetail = async (id) => {
    setDetailLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getCommunication(id);
      const d = res?.data || res;
      setDetail(d);
      return d;
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load');
      return null;
    } finally {
      setDetailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const openEdit = async (id) => {
    setView('edit');
    setDetail(null);
    await loadDetail(id);
  };

  const openView = async (id) => {
    setView('view');
    setDetail(null);
    await loadDetail(id);
  };

  const backToList = () => {
    setView('list');
    setDetail(null);
    setCreateForm({
      title: '',
      subtitle: '',
      body: '',
      fields: {},
      advertKind: advertKinds ? advertKinds[0].value : null,
    });
    loadList();
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Create
     ============================================================ */
  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!createForm.title?.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const res = await createCommunication({
        type,
        title: createForm.title.trim(),
        subtitle: createForm.subtitle,
        body: createForm.body,
        fields: createForm.fields,
        advertKind: createForm.advertKind || null,
      });
      const created = res?.data || res;
      toast.success('Created as draft');
      if (created?._id) {
        setView('edit');
        setDetail(created);
        setCreateForm({
          title: '',
          subtitle: '',
          body: '',
          fields: {},
          advertKind: advertKinds ? advertKinds[0].value : null,
        });
      } else {
        backToList();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Save
     ============================================================ */
  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!detail) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateCommunication(detail._id, {
        title: detail.title,
        subtitle: detail.subtitle,
        body: detail.body,
        fields: detail.fields,
        advertKind: detail.advertKind,
        isPublic: detail.isPublic,
      });
      setDetail(res?.data || res);
      toast.success('Saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Save failed');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Status actions
     ============================================================ */
  const runStatus = async (action) => {
    setStatusLoading(action);
    try {
      const fn =
        action === 'publish'
          ? publishCommunication
          : action === 'unpublish'
          ? unpublishCommunication
          : action === 'archive'
          ? archiveCommunication
          : action === 'regenerate'
          ? regenerateAdvert
          : null;
      if (!fn) return;
      const res = await fn(detail._id);
      setDetail(res?.data || res);
      toast.success(`${action} successful`);
      setConfirm({ open: false, action: null });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || `${action} failed`);
    } finally {
      setStatusLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRowPublish = async (row, action) => {
    setRowAction(`${action}-${row._id}`);
    try {
      const fn = action === 'publish' ? publishCommunication : unpublishCommunication;
      await fn(row._id);
      toast.success(`${action} successful`);
      loadList(true);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || `${action} failed`);
    } finally {
      setRowAction(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRowDelete = async (row) => {
    setRowAction(`delete-${row._id}`);
    try {
      await deleteCommunication(row._id);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      loadList(true);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Delete failed');
    } finally {
      setRowAction(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!detail) return;
    try {
      await deleteCommunication(detail._id);
      toast.success('Deleted');
      setConfirm({ open: false, action: null });
      backToList();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Delete failed');
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Images
     ============================================================ */
  const handleImageUpload = async (file) => {
    if (!file || !detail) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('image', file);
      const res = await uploadCommunicationImage(detail._id, fd);
      setDetail(res?.data || res);
      toast.success('Image uploaded');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleImageRemove = async (publicId) => {
    if (!detail) return;
    try {
      const res = await removeCommunicationImage(detail._id, publicId);
      setDetail(res?.data || res);
      toast.success('Image removed');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Remove failed');
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Send
     ============================================================ */
  const handleSendEmail = async () => {
    const list = emailInput.split(/[\s,;]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!list.length) return toast.error('Enter at least one email');
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const res = await sendCommunicationEmail(detail._id, { recipients: list });
      toast.success(res?.data?.message || res?.message || 'Email sent');
      setEmailInput('');
      setSendPanel(null);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Send failed');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendSms = async () => {
    const list = smsInput.split(/[\s,;]+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!list.length) return toast.error('Enter at least one phone number');
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const res = await sendCommunicationSms(detail._id, { recipients: list });
      toast.success(res?.data?.message || res?.message || 'SMS sent');
      setSmsInput('');
      setSendPanel(null);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Send failed');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     Print / PDF
     ============================================================ */
  const handlePrint = async () => {
    const el = printRef.current;
    if (!el) {
      toast.error('Preview not ready, wait a moment');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await printElement(el);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('print error', err);
      toast.error(err.message || 'Print failed');
    }
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async () => {
    const el = printRef.current;
    if (!el) {
      toast.error('Preview not ready, wait a moment');
      return;
    }
    setPdfLoading(true);
    try {
      const safeName = (detail?.title || label).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '_').slice(0, 60);
      await exportElementToPdf(el, `${safeName}.pdf`);
      toast.success('PDF downloaded');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('pdf error', err);
      toast.error(err.message || 'PDF export failed');
    } finally {
      setPdfLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await loadList(true);
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER â€” LIST
     ============================================================ */
  if (view === 'list') {
    const columns = [
      {
        key: 'title',
        label: 'Title',
        render: (row) => (
          <div>
            <p className="font-medium text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">{row.title}</p>
            {row.subtitle && (
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate max-w-xs">{row.subtitle}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        ),
      },
      {
        key: 'status',
        label: 'Status',
        render: (row) => (
          <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[row.status] || 'default'} dot>
            {row.status}
          </Badge>
        ),
      },
      {
        key: 'createdAt',
        label: 'Created',
        render: (row) => (
          <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            {new Date(row.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
          </span>
        ),
      },
      {
        key: 'actions',
        label: '',
        align: 'right',
        render: (row) => {
          const busy = rowAction?.endsWith(row._id);
          const isPublishing = rowAction === `publish-${row._id}`;
          const isUnpublishing = rowAction === `unpublish-${row._id}`;
          const isDeleting = rowAction === `delete-${row._id}`;

          return (
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-1" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <button
                onClick={() => openView(row._id)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
                title="View"
                disabled={busy}
              >
                <HiEye className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={() => openEdit(row._id)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
                title="Edit"
                disabled={busy}
              >
                <HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              {row.status === 'draft' && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleRowPublish(row, 'publish')}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-50 text-green-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                  title="Publish"
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  {isPublishing ? <Spinner size="sm" /> : <HiCheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              )}

              {row.status === 'published' && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleRowPublish(row, 'unpublish')}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                  title="Unpublish"
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  {isUnpublishing ? <Spinner size="sm" /> : <HiMinusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  if (window.confirm(`Delete "${row.title}"?`)) handleRowDelete(row);
                }}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 text-red-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                title="Delete"
                disabled={busy}
              >
                {isDeleting ? <Spinner size="sm" /> : <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        },
      },
    ];

    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <StatCard label="Total" value={stats.total} />
          <StatCard label="Drafts" value={stats.drafts} />
          <StatCard label="Published" value={stats.published} />
          <StatCard label="Archived" value={stats.archived} />
        </div>

        <Card padding={false}>
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`Search ${label.toLowerCase()}...`}
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--bg-primary)] text-sm outline-none"
            />
            <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
              {STATUS_FILTERS.map((f) => (
                <button
                  key={f.value}
                  onClick={() => setStatusFilter(f.value)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition ${
                    statusFilter === f.value
                      ? 'bg-green-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {f.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4">
            {loading && !items.length ? (
              <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
                <Spinner size="lg" />
              </div>
            ) : !items.length ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
                <span className="text-4xl">{icon}</span>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                  {search || statusFilter
                    ? `No matching ${label.toLowerCase()}s`
                    : `No ${label.toLowerCase()}s yet`}
                </p>
                {!search && !statusFilter && (
                  <Button
                    icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    onClick={() => setView('create')}
                    size="sm"
                  >
                    Create First
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Table
                columns={columns}
                data={items}
                rowKey={(r) => r._id}
                onRowClick={(r) => openView(r._id)}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={<HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />}
            onClick={handleRefresh}
            disabled={refreshing}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={() => setView('create')}>
            New {label}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER â€” CREATE
     ============================================================ */
  if (view === 'create') {
    const isBundleAdvert =
      advertKinds &&
      (createForm.advertKind === 'services' || createForm.advertKind === 'products');

    return (
      <div className="space-y-4 max-w-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={backToList}>
            â† Back
          </Button>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">New {label}</h2>
        </div>

        <Card title="Content">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Input
              label="Title *"
              value={createForm.title}
              onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, title: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={titlePlaceholder}
            />
            <Input
              label="Subtitle"
              value={createForm.subtitle}
              onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, subtitle: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Optional subtitle"
            />

            {fields.map((f) =>
              f.type === 'textarea' ? (
                <Textarea
                  key={f.name}
                  label={f.label}
                  rows={f.rows || 3}
                  value={createForm.fields?.[f.name] || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCreateForm({
                      ...createForm,
                      fields: { ...createForm.fields, [f.name]: e.target.value },
                    })
                  }
                  placeholder={f.placeholder || ''}
                />
              ) : (
                <Input
                  key={f.name}
                  label={f.label}
                  type={f.type || 'text'}
                  value={createForm.fields?.[f.name] || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCreateForm({
                      ...createForm,
                      fields: { ...createForm.fields, [f.name]: e.target.value },
                    })
                  }
                  placeholder={f.placeholder || ''}
                />
              )
            )}

            {advertKinds && (
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2">
                  Advert Kind
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  {advertKinds.map((o) => (
                    <button
                      key={o.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, advertKind: o.value })}
                      className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition text-left ${
                        createForm.advertKind === o.value
                          ? 'border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent)]/5'
                          : 'border-[var(--border-color)]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">{o.label}</div>
                      {o.desc && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5">{o.desc}</div>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {isBundleAdvert ? (
              <div className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
                <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-1">Body auto-generated</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  At save time, the body will be built from your active {createForm.advertKind} list.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Textarea
                label="Body"
                rows={8}
                value={createForm.body}
                onChange={(e) => setCreateForm({ ...createForm, body: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={bodyPlaceholder}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={backToList} disabled={creating}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleCreate} loading={creating}>
            Create Draft
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER â€” EDIT
     ============================================================ */
  if (view === 'edit') {
    if (detailLoading || !detail) {
      return (
        <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
          <Spinner size="lg" />
        </div>
      );
    }

    const isBundleAdvert =
      advertKinds &&
      (detail.advertKind === 'services' || detail.advertKind === 'products');

    return (
      <div className="space-y-4 max-w-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={backToList}>
            â† Back
          </Button>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
              Edit {label}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{detail.title}</p>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={<HiEye className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => openView(detail._id)}
          >
            View
          </Button>
        </div>

        <Card title="Content">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Input
              label="Title"
              value={detail.title || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setDetail({ ...detail, title: e.target.value })}
            />
            <Input
              label="Subtitle"
              value={detail.subtitle || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setDetail({ ...detail, subtitle: e.target.value })}
            />

            {fields.map((f) =>
              f.type === 'textarea' ? (
                <Textarea
                  key={f.name}
                  label={f.label}
                  rows={f.rows || 3}
                  value={detail.fields?.[f.name] || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDetail({
                      ...detail,
                      fields: { ...detail.fields, [f.name]: e.target.value },
                    })
                  }
                />
              ) : (
                <Input
                  key={f.name}
                  label={f.label}
                  type={f.type || 'text'}
                  value={detail.fields?.[f.name] || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDetail({
                      ...detail,
                      fields: { ...detail.fields, [f.name]: e.target.value },
                    })
                  }
                />
              )
            )}

            {isBundleAdvert ? (
              <div className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-lg p-4 text-sm space-y-2">
                <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                  Body â€” auto-generated from {detail.advertKind}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  {detail.body?.length ? `${detail.body.length} characters` : 'Empty'}
                </p>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'regenerate' })}
                >
                  â†» Regenerate
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Textarea
                label="Body"
                rows={10}
                value={detail.body || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setDetail({ ...detail, body: e.target.value })}
              />
            )}

            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button onClick={handleSave} loading={saving}>
                Save Changes
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Images">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {(detail.images || []).length > 0 ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                {detail.images.map((img) => (
                  <div key={img.publicId} className="relative group">
                    <img
                      src={img.url}
                      alt={img.caption || ''}
                      className="w-full h-32 object-cover rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)]"
                    />
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleImageRemove(img.publicId)}
                      className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-full w-6 h-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition"
                    >
                      Ã—
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">No images yet.</p>
            )}
            <label className="inline-block cursor-pointer px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-sm">
              {uploading ? 'Uploading...' : '+ Add Image'}
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                disabled={uploading}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                  if (f) handleImageUpload(f);
                  e.target.value = '';
                }}
                className="hidden"
              />
            </label>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Status">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {detail.status === 'draft' && (
              <Button
                variant="success"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'publish' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'publish'}
              >
                Publish
              </Button>
            )}
            {detail.status === 'published' && (
              <Button
                variant="warning"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'unpublish' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'unpublish'}
              >
                Unpublish
              </Button>
            )}
            {detail.status !== 'archived' && (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'archive' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'archive'}
              >
                Archive
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              icon={<HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'delete' })}
              className="ml-auto"
            >
              Delete
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <ConfirmDialog
          open={confirm.open}
          onClose={() => setConfirm({ open: false, action: null })}
          onConfirm={() => {
            if (confirm.action === 'delete') handleDelete();
            else runStatus(confirm.action);
          }}
          title={
            confirm.action === 'delete'
              ? 'Delete'
              : confirm.action === 'publish'
              ? 'Publish'
              : confirm.action === 'unpublish'
              ? 'Unpublish'
              : confirm.action === 'archive'
              ? 'Archive'
              : confirm.action === 'regenerate'
              ? 'Regenerate Body'
              : 'Confirm'
          }
          message={
            confirm.action === 'delete'
              ? `Permanently delete "${detail.title}"?`
              : confirm.action === 'publish'
              ? `Publish "${detail.title}"?`
              : confirm.action === 'unpublish'
              ? `Move back to draft?`
              : confirm.action === 'archive'
              ? `Archive "${detail.title}"?`
              : confirm.action === 'regenerate'
              ? `Regenerate body from current ${detail.advertKind} list?`
              : ''
          }
          confirmLabel="Confirm"
          variant={confirm.action === 'delete' ? 'danger' : 'primary'}
          loading={confirm.action === 'delete' ? false : statusLoading === confirm.action}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER â€” VIEW
     ============================================================ */
  if (view === 'view') {
    if (detailLoading || !detail) {
      return (
        <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
          <Spinner size="lg" />
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-4 max-w-3xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={backToList}>
            â† Back
          </Button>
          <div className="flex-1" />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={<HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={() => openEdit(detail._id)}
          >
            Edit
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={handlePrint}
            icon={<HiPrinter className="w-4 h-4" />}
          >
            Print
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleExportPdf}
            loading={pdfLoading}
            icon={<HiDocumentDownload className="w-4 h-4" />}
          >
            PDF
          </Button>
        </div>

        <Card title="Meta">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
            <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[detail.status] || 'default'} dot>
              {detail.status}
            </Badge>
            {detail.advertKind && (
              <>
                <span>Â·</span>
                <span className="capitalize">{detail.advertKind}</span>
              </>
            )}
            <span>Â·</span>
            <span>Created {new Date(detail.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
            {detail.publishedAt && (
              <>
                <span>Â·</span>
                <span>Published {new Date(detail.publishedAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Preview" padding={false}>
          <div className="p-4 bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] overflow-auto">
            <div
              className="mx-auto bg-white shadow-md rounded"
              style={{ width: '794px', maxWidth: '100%' }}
            >
              <CommunicationDocument
                detail={detail}
                company={company}
                label={label}
                type={type}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Send">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <Button
                variant={sendPanel === 'email' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
                icon={<HiMail className="w-4 h-4" />}
                onClick={() => setSendPanel(sendPanel === 'email' ? null : 'email')}
              >
                Email
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant={sendPanel === 'sms' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
                icon={<HiDeviceMobile className="w-4 h-4" />}
                onClick={() => setSendPanel(sendPanel === 'sms' ? null : 'sms')}
              >
                SMS
              </Button>
            </div>

            {sendPanel === 'email' && (
              <div className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2">
                <Textarea
                  label="Recipients (comma or newline separated)"
                  rows={3}
                  value={emailInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmailInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="john@example.com, jane@example.com"
                />
                <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSendEmail} loading={sending}>
                  Send Email
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}

            {sendPanel === 'sms' && (
              <div className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2">
                <Textarea
                  label="Phone numbers (comma or newline separated)"
                  rows={3}
                  value={smsInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setSmsInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="254712345678, 254787654321"
                />
                <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSendSms} loading={sending}>
                  Send SMS
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Status">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {detail.status === 'draft' && (
              <Button
                variant="success"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'publish' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'publish'}
              >
                Publish
              </Button>
            )}
            {detail.status === 'published' && (
              <Button
                variant="warning"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'unpublish' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'unpublish'}
              >
                Unpublish
              </Button>
            )}
            {detail.status !== 'archived' && (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'archive' })}
                loading={statusLoading === 'archive'}
              >
                Archive
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              icon={<HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={() => setConfirm({ open: true, action: 'delete' })}
              className="ml-auto"
            >
              Delete
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <ConfirmDialog
          open={confirm.open}
          onClose={() => setConfirm({ open: false, action: null })}
          onConfirm={() => {
            if (confirm.action === 'delete') handleDelete();
            else runStatus(confirm.action);
          }}
          title={
            confirm.action === 'delete'
              ? 'Delete'
              : confirm.action === 'publish'
              ? 'Publish'
              : confirm.action === 'unpublish'
              ? 'Unpublish'
              : confirm.action === 'archive'
              ? 'Archive'
              : 'Confirm'
          }
          message={
            confirm.action === 'delete'
              ? `Permanently delete "${detail.title}"?`
              : confirm.action === 'publish'
              ? `Publish "${detail.title}"?`
              : confirm.action === 'unpublish'
              ? `Move back to draft?`
              : confirm.action === 'archive'
              ? `Archive "${detail.title}"?`
              : ''
          }
          confirmLabel="Confirm"
          variant={confirm.action === 'delete' ? 'danger' : 'primary'}
          loading={confirm.action === 'delete' ? false : statusLoading === confirm.action}
        />

        {/* Hidden print/pdf render target */}
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            width: '794px',
            opacity: 0.001,
            zIndex: -1,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            overflow: 'visible',
            background: '#ffffff',
          }}
        >
          <div ref={printRef}>
            <CommunicationDocument
              detail={detail}
              company={company}
              label={label}
              type={type}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return null;
}

/* ============================================================
   PRINTABLE DOCUMENT LAYOUT (type-aware)
   ============================================================ */
function CommunicationDocument({ detail, company, label, type }) {
  const c = company || {};

  const showStamp = !!c.stampUrl;

  const todayStr = (() => {
    const d = new Date();
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
  })();

  const docDateStr = (() => {
    const d = new Date(detail.createdAt || Date.now());
    const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
    return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
  })();

  const letterhead = (
    <div
      style={{
        borderBottom: '2px solid #0a1628',
        paddingBottom: '1rem',
        marginBottom: '1.5rem',
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        gap: '1.5rem',
      }}
    >
      <div>
        <h1
          style={{
            fontSize: '1.5rem',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: '#0a1628',
            margin: 0,
            letterSpacing: '0.05em',
          }}
        >
          {c.name || 'HDM TECHNOLOGIES'}
        </h1>
        {c.tagline && (
          <p
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.8rem',
              fontStyle: 'italic',
              color: '#4b5563',
              margin: '0.25rem 0',
            }}
          >
            {c.tagline}
          </p>
        )}
        <p style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#374151', margin: 0 }}>
          {[c.poBox, c.city, c.country].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')}
        </p>
        <p style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#1e6ef0', margin: '0.15rem 0 0' }}>
          {[c.email, c.website, c.phone].filter(Boolean).join('  Â·  ')}
        </p>
      </div>
      {c.logo && (
        <img
          src={c.logo}
          alt="logo"
          style={{ maxHeight: '60px', maxWidth: '120px', objectFit: 'contain' }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const watermark = c.logo ? (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '50%',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
        opacity: 0.06,
        pointerEvents: 'none',
        zIndex: 0,
        width: '55%',
        maxWidth: '420px',
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={c.logo}
        alt=""
        style={{ maxWidth: '100%', maxHeight: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }}
      />
    </div>
  ) : null;

  const stampBlock = showStamp ? (
    <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', minWidth: '180px' }}>
      <img
        src={c.stampUrl}
        alt="stamp"
        style={{
          width: '90px',
          height: '90px',
          objectFit: 'contain',
          display: 'block',
          marginLeft: 'auto',
        }}
      />
      <div
        style={{
          fontSize: '0.8rem',
          fontWeight: 700,
          color: '#1e6ef0',
          marginTop: '0.5rem',
          letterSpacing: '0.05em',
        }}
      >
        {todayStr}
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          borderTop: '1px solid #000',
          width: '120px',
          marginTop: '0.25rem',
          marginLeft: 'auto',
        }}
      />
      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', color: '#6b7280', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
        Official Stamp
      </div>
    </div>
  ) : null;

  const footer = (
    <div
      style={{
        marginTop: '2rem',
        borderTop: '1px solid #e5e7eb',
        paddingTop: '0.75rem',
        fontSize: '0.72rem',
        color: '#6b7280',
        textAlign: 'center',
      }}
    >
      <div>
        Â© {new Date().getFullYear()} {c.name || 'HDM Technologies'}. All rights reserved.
      </div>
      <div>{[c.email, c.phone, c.website].filter(Boolean).join('  Â·  ')}</div>
    </div>
  );

  const pageStyle = {
    position: 'relative',
    fontFamily: "'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif",
    background: '#fff',
    padding: '2rem 2.5rem',
    minHeight: '1123px',
    color: '#111',
    overflow: 'hidden',
  };

  const contentStyle = { position: 'relative', zIndex: 1 };

  /* ============================================================

  if (type === 'official-letter') {
    const f = detail.fields || {};

    return (
