              }}
            >
              {f.ctaUrl && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '0.05em' }}>
                  {f.ctaUrl}
                </div>
              )}
              {(f.contactEmail || f.contactPhone) && (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#93c5fd', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
                  {[f.contactEmail, f.contactPhone].filter(Boolean).join('  Â·  ')}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {footer}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ============================================================
     FALLBACK
     ============================================================ */
  const fieldEntries = Object.entries(detail.fields || {}).filter(
    ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''
  );

  return (
    <div style={pageStyle}>
      {watermark}
      <div style={contentStyle}>
        {letterhead}
        <h2
          style={{
            fontSize: '1.5rem',
            fontWeight: 700,
            color: '#0a1628',
            textAlign: 'center',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
            margin: '1.5rem 0 0.5rem',
          }}
        >
          {detail.title || label}
        </h2>
        <div style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #cbd5e1', margin: '0 0 1.5rem' }} />
        {fieldEntries.length > 0 && (
          <table
            style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', marginBottom: '1.5rem', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}
          >
            <tbody>
              {fieldEntries.map(([k, v]) => (
                <tr key={k}>
                  <td
                    style={{
                      padding: '0.35rem 1rem 0.35rem 0',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      color: '#0a1628',
                    }}
                  >
                    {k}:
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.35rem 0', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', color: '#1f2937' }}>
                    {String(v)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
        {detail.body && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', lineHeight: 1.7 }}>{detail.body}</div>
        )}
        <div style={{ marginTop: '3rem', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          {stampBlock}
        </div>
        {footer}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   StatCard
   ============================================================ */
function StatCard({ label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-1">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

              tab === t.key
                ? 'border-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent)]'
                : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
            }`}
          >
            <span>{t.icon}</span>
            <span>{t.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab content */}
      <div>
        {tab === 'memo' && <MemoTab />}
        {tab === 'announcement' && <AnnouncementTab />}
        {tab === 'advert' && <AdvertTab />}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  getCompany,
  updateCompany,
  uploadLogo,
  uploadLogoDark,
  uploadFavicon,
  uploadStamp,
  uploadSeal,
} from '../../services/portfolio/company';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';

export default function Company() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [company, setCompany] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    getCompany()
      .then((res) => setCompany(res.data || res))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load company'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const updateField = (key, value) =>
    setCompany((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

  const updateSocial = (key, value) =>
    setCompany((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      social: { ...prev.social, [key]: value },
    }));

  const updateHero = (key, value) =>
    setCompany((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      hero: { ...prev.hero, [key]: value },
    }));

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await updateCompany(company);
      toast.success('Company saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async (type, file) => {
    if (!file) return;
    const formData = new FormData();

    const fieldByType = {
      logo: 'logo',
      logoDark: 'logo',
      favicon: 'icon',
      stamp: 'stamp',
      seal: 'seal',
    };
    formData.append(fieldByType[type] || 'file', file);

    setUploading((p) => ({ ...p, [type]: true }));
    try {
      const fnByType = {
        logo: uploadLogo,
        logoDark: uploadLogoDark,
        favicon: uploadFavicon,
        stamp: uploadStamp,
        seal: uploadSeal,
      };
      const fn = fnByType[type] || uploadLogo;
      const res = await fn(formData);

      const updated = res.data || res;
      const url =
        updated[`${type}Url`] ||
        updated[type] ||
        updated.logo ||
        updated.icon ||
        updated.url;

      if (url) {
        const key =
          type === 'favicon'
            ? 'favicon'
            : type === 'stamp'
            ? 'stampUrl'
            : type === 'seal'
            ? 'sealUrl'
            : type;
        setCompany((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: url }));
      }
      toast.success(`${labelFor(type)} uploaded`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setUploading((p) => ({ ...p, [type]: false }));
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center py-10">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!company) return null;

  const socialKeys = [
    'facebook',
    'twitter',
    'instagram',
    'linkedin',
    'github',
    'youtube',
    'discord',
    'stackoverflow',
  ];

  return (

          Company Info
        </h3>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Name"
              value={company.name || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('name', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Tagline"
              value={company.tagline || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('tagline', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label="Description"
            value={company.description || ''}
            onChange={(e) => updateField('description', e.target.value)}
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Email"
              value={company.email || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('email', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Phone"
              value={company.phone || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('phone', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="WhatsApp"
              value={company.whatsapp || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('whatsapp', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label="WhatsApp Message"
            value={company.whatsappMessage || ''}
            onChange={(e) => updateField('whatsappMessage', e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Hello HDM!"
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <h3 className="font-semibold mb-4 text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          Address &amp; Location
        </h3>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Input
            label="Street / Physical Address"
            value={company.address || ''}
            onChange={(e) => updateField('address', e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Kenyatta Avenue"
          />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="P.O. Box"
              value={company.poBox || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('poBox', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="P.O. Box 2460-20100"
            />
            <Input
              label="Postal Code"
              value={company.postalCode || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('postalCode', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="20100"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input

              value={company.city || ''}
              onChange={(e) => updateField('city', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nakuru"
            />
            <Input
              label="Country"

function labelFor(type) {
  return {
    logo: 'Logo',
    logoDark: 'Dark Logo',
    favicon: 'Favicon',
    stamp: 'Stamp',
    seal: 'Seal',
  }[type] || type;
}

function ImageUpload({ label, value, onUpload, uploading, hint }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
        {label}
      </label>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        {value ? (
          <img
            src={value}
            alt={label}
            className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg object-contain bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] p-1"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--text-muted)] text-xs">
            None
          </div>
        )}
        <label className="cursor-pointer flex-1">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] transition-colors">
            {uploading ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Upload'}
          </span>
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            disabled={uploading}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0];
              if (f) onUpload(f);
              e.target.value = '';
            }}
            className="hidden"
          />
        </label>
      </div>
      {hint && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{hint}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\portfolio\Contacts.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  getContacts,
  markAsRead,
  markAsArchived,
  deleteContact,
} from '../../services/portfolio/contacts';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import SearchBar from '../../components/portfolio/ui/SearchBar';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import Spinner from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { formatDate, relativeTime } from '../../utils/portfolio/formatDate';
import {
  HiMail,
  HiArchive,
  HiTrash,
  HiCheckCircle,
  HiReply,
  HiInbox,
} from 'react-icons/hi';

const FILTERS = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { key: 'unread', label: 'Unread' },
  { key: 'archived', label: 'Archived' },
];

export default function Contacts() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({
    open: false,
    id: null,
  });

  const fetchContacts = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getContacts()
      .then((res) => setContacts(res.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load messages'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchContacts();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = contacts;

    if (filter === 'unread') list = list.filter((c) => !c.isRead);
    else if (filter === 'archived') list = list.filter((c) => c.isArchived);
    else list = list.filter((c) => !c.isArchived);

    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(
        (c) =>
          c.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          c.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          c.message?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    return [...list].sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt)
    );
  }, [contacts, filter, search]);

  const selected = contacts.find((c) => c._id === selectedId) || null;

  const unreadCount = contacts.filter(
    (c) => !c.isRead && !c.isArchived
  ).length;

  const handleSelect = async (contact) => {
    setSelectedId(contact._id);
    if (!contact.isRead) {
      try {
        await markAsRead(contact._id);
        setContacts((prev) =>
          prev.map((c) =>
            c._id === contact._id ? { ...c, isRead: true } : c
          )
        );
      } catch {
        /* silent */
      }
    }
  };

  const handleArchive = async (id) => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await markAsArchived(id);
      toast.success('Message archived');
      setContacts((prev) =>
        prev.map((c) => (c._id === id ? { ...c, isArchived: true } : c))
      );
      if (selectedId === id) setSelectedId(null);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to archive');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.id) return;
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await deleteContact(confirmDelete.id);
      toast.success('Message deleted');
      setContacts((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c._id !== confirmDelete.id));
      if (selectedId === confirmDelete.id) setSelectedId(null);
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Messages
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {contacts.length} total{unreadCount > 0 && ` Â· ${unreadCount} unread`}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* List */}
        <Card padding={false} className="lg:col-span-1">
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] space-y-3">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={setSearch}
              placeholder="Search messages..."
            />
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              {FILTERS.map((f) => (
                <button
                  key={f.key}
                  onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)}
                  className={`flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                    filter === f.key
                      ? 'bg-green-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)]'
                  }`}
                  type="button"
                >
                  {f.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
                <Spinner />
              </div>
            ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-12 text-center">
                <HiInbox className="w-8 h-8 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  No messages
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              filtered.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c._id}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(c)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] last:border-0 transition-colors ${
                    selectedId === c._id
                      ? 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950/30'
                      : 'hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]'
                  }`}
                  type="button"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {!c.isRead && (
                          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                        <p
                          className={`text-sm truncate ${
                            !c.isRead
                              ? 'font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                              : 'font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {c.name}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate mt-0.5">
                        {c.email}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] truncate mt-1">
                        {c.message}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] shrink-0">
                      {relativeTime(c.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Detail */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          {selected ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                    {selected.name}
                  </h2>
                  <a
                    href={`mailto:${selected.email}`}
                    className="text-sm text-green-600 hover:underline"
                  >
                    {selected.email}
                  </a>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                    Received {formatDate(selected.createdAt, 'full')}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                  {selected.isArchived && (
                    <Badge variant="default">Archived</Badge>
                  )}
                  {!selected.isRead && (
                    <Badge variant="warning">New</Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-4">
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] whitespace-pre-line leading-relaxed">
                  {selected.message}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-4 flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <a href={`mailto:${selected.email}`}>
                  <Button size="sm" icon={<HiReply className="w-4 h-4" />}>
                    Reply
                  </Button>
                </a>
                {!selected.isArchived && (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    icon={<HiArchive className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    onClick={() => handleArchive(selected._id)}
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                  >
                    Archive
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="danger"
                  icon={<HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  onClick={() =>
                    setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: selected._id })
                  }
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                >
                  Delete
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-20 text-center">
              <HiMail className="w-12 h-12 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                Select a message to read
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null })}
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
        title="Delete Message"
        message="Permanently delete this message? This cannot be undone."
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={actionLoading}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  HiServer,
  HiDatabase,
  HiStatusOnline,
  HiMail,
  HiDeviceMobile,
  HiCloud,
  HiRefresh,
  HiSparkles,
  HiClock,

  HiExternalLink,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Spinner';

import { formatDate } from '../../utils/portfolio/formatDate';

const OK_STATES = ['up', 'enabled', 'connected', 'healthy', 'running', 'OK'];

const REFRESH_MS = 30000;

function bytes(n) {
  const num = Number(n || 0);
  if (num < 1024) return `${num} B`;
  if (num < 1024 * 1024) return `${(num / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  if (num < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(num / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${(num / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}

function StatusDot({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn = status === 'disabled' || status === 'degraded';
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
        ok ? 'bg-green-500' : warn ? 'bg-gray-400' : 'bg-red-500'
      }`}
    />
  );
}

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn = status === 'disabled';
  return (
    <Badge variant={ok ? 'success' : warn ? 'default' : 'danger'} dot>
      {status || 'unknown'}
    </Badge>
  );
}

export default function Health() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await getHealth();
        setData(res?.data || res);
        setLastUpdated(new Date());
      } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load health');
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [toast]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(() => load(true), REFRESH_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return null;

    redis,

              Updated {lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString()} Â· auto-refresh 30s

function ServiceCard({ icon: Icon, title, status, children }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-secondary)]" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{title}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot status={status} />
          <StatusBadge status={status} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">{children}</dl>
    </Card>
  );
}

function Detail({ label, value, mono }) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd
        className={`text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs text-right truncate ${
          mono ? 'font-mono' : ''
        }`}
        title={String(value)}
      >
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Link, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/portfolio/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Spinner from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Spinner';
import { HiArrowLeft } from 'react-icons/hi';

export default function Login() {
  const { login, status } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/portfolio';

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (status === 'idle' || status === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === 'authenticated') {
    return <Navigate to={from} replace />;
  }

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      toast.success('Welcome back');
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
      <Link
        to="/"
        className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors"
      >
        <HiArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" /> Return Home
      </Link>

      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-[var(--card-bg)] rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-[var(--border-color)] p-6 sm:p-8">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 mb-4">
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400">
              P
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 mb-1">
            HDM Portfolio
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-sm">
            Admin Panel
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="admin@hdm.co.ke"
            autoComplete="email"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          <Button
            type="submit"
            fullWidth
            size="lg"

          </Button>

  );
}

    getMongoStats()
      .then((res) => setStats(res?.data || res || {}))
      .catch(() => {});
  };

  const fetchDatabases = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getMongoDatabases()
      .then((res) => setDatabases(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load databases'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStats();
    fetchDatabases();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const selectDatabase = (db) => {
    setSelectedDb(db);
    setSelectedCol('');
    setDocuments([]);
    setColStats(null);
    setLoading(true);
    getMongoDatabase(db)
      .then((res) => setCollections(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load collections'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  const selectCollection = (col) => {
    setSelectedCol(col);
    setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      getMongoCollection(selectedDb, col).catch(() => ({
        stats: {},
        indexes: [],
        sampleDocuments: [],
      })),
      queryMongoCollection(selectedDb, col, {
        filter: queryFilter,
        limit: 50,
      }).catch(() => ({ documents: [] })),
    ])
      .then(([colRes, queryRes]) => {
        setColStats(colRes?.data || colRes || {});
        setDocuments(
          queryRes?.data?.documents || queryRes?.documents || []
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load collection'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  const handleQuery = () => {
    if (!selectedCol) return;
    setLoading(true);
    queryMongoCollection(selectedDb, selectedCol, {
      filter: queryFilter,
      limit: 50,
    })
      .then((res) =>
        setDocuments(res?.data?.documents || res?.documents || [])
      )
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Query failed'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  const handleDropCol = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await dropMongoCollection(deleteConfirm.db, deleteConfirm.col);
      toast.success(`Dropped collection ${deleteConfirm.col}`);
      setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', db: '', col: '' });
      setSelectedCol('');
      selectDatabase(selectedDb);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e.message || 'Failed to drop collection');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDropDb = async () => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await dropMongoDatabase(deleteConfirm.db);
      toast.success(`Dropped database ${deleteConfirm.db}`);
      setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', db: '', col: '' });
      setSelectedDb('');
      setSelectedCol('');
      setCollections([]);
      fetchDatabases();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e.message || 'Failed to drop database');
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatSize = (bytes) => {
    if (!bytes) return 'â€”';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    if (bytes < 1073741824) return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    return `${(bytes / 1073741824).toFixed(2)} GB`;
  };

  const formatUptime = (hours) => {
    if (!hours) return 'â€”';
    const d = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    const h = Math.floor(hours % 24);
    return d > 0 ? `${d}d ${h}h` : `${h}h`;
  };

  if (loading && !databases.length) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-6">
        MongoDB Atlas Management
      </h1>

      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-red-300 bg-red-50 p-3 mb-6 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/30">
        <HiExclamation className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
        <div className="text-sm text-red-800 dark:text-red-200">
          <p className="font-medium">Danger zone</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-90">
            Dropping databases or collections is permanent and cannot be undone.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {stats && (
        <>
          <Card className="mb-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Storage</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                {formatSize(stats.storage?.dataSize)} / 512 MB
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-full h-3">
              <div
                className="bg-green-600 h-3 rounded-full transition-all"
                style={{
                  width: `${Math.min(
                    ((stats.storage?.dataSize || 0) / (512 * 1024 * 1024)) *
                      100,
                    100
                  )}%`,
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                Tier:{' '}
                <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                  {stats.tier || 'M0 (Free)'}
                </span>
              </p>
              {stats.host && (
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate ml-4 max-w-[300px]">
                  {stats.host}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-6">
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Version</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {stats.version || 'â€”'}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Uptime</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {formatUptime(stats.uptime)}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Connections</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {stats.connections?.current || 0}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Documents</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {(stats.storage?.objects || 0).toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Collections</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {stats.storage?.collections || 0}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Data Size</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {formatSize(stats.storage?.dataSize)}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Storage Size</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {formatSize(stats.storage?.storageSize)}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Index Size</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {formatSize(stats.storage?.indexSize)}
              </p>

            </p>

                          db: db.name,

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {selectedDb ? `${selectedDb} / Collections` : 'Select a database'}
          </h3>
          {selectedDb &&
            (collections.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4 text-center">
                No collections
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {collections.map((col) => (
                  <div
                    key={col.name}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)]"
                  >
                    <button
                      onClick={() => selectCollection(col.name)}
                      className={`text-sm text-left truncate ${
                        selectedCol === col.name
                          ? 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 font-medium'
                          : 'text-[var(--text-primary)]'
                      }`}
                      type="button"
                    >
                      {col.name}
                    </button>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                      <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                        {col.documentCount || 0} docs
                      </span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() =>
                          setDeleteConfirm({
                            open: true,
                            type: 'col',
                            db: selectedDb,
                            col: col.name,
                          })
                        }
                        className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20"
                        type="button"
                        title="Drop collection"
                      >
                        <HiTrash className="w-3 h-3 text-red-500" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ))}
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <h3 className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-3">
            {selectedCol ? `${selectedCol} / Documents` : 'Select a collection'}
          </h3>
          {selectedCol && (
            <>
              {colStats?.stats && (
                <div className="flex gap-3 mb-3 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  <span>Docs: {colStats.stats.documentCount || 0}</span>
                  <span>Size: {formatSize(colStats.stats.size)}</span>
                  <span>Indexes: {colStats.indexes?.length || 0}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
                <Input
                  value={queryFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setQueryFilter(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder='{"key": "value"}'
                  className="text-xs"
                />
                <Button size="sm" onClick={handleQuery}>
                  <HiSearch className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                {documents.map((doc, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={doc._id || i}
                    className="bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded p-2 text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)] overflow-x-auto"
                  >
                    {JSON.stringify(doc, null, 1).slice(0, 500)}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {documents.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4 text-center">
                    No documents
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteConfirm.open}
        onClose={() =>
          setDeleteConfirm({ open: false, type: '', db: '', col: '' })
        }
        onConfirm={deleteConfirm.type === 'db' ? handleDropDb : handleDropCol}
        title={
          deleteConfirm.type === 'db' ? 'Drop Database' : 'Drop Collection'
        }
        message={`Are you sure you want to drop ${
          deleteConfirm.type === 'db'
            ? deleteConfirm.db
            : `${deleteConfirm.col} in ${deleteConfirm.db}`
        }? This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Drop"
        variant="danger"
        loading={actionLoading}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function maskPhone(phone) {
  if (!phone) return 'â€”';
  const s = String(phone);
  if (s.length < 8) return s;
  return `${s.slice(0, 3)}***${s.slice(-4)}`;
}

function formatKES(amount) {
  const n = Number(amount || 0);
  return `KES ${n.toLocaleString('en-KE', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}`;
}

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  description: '',
  phone: '',
  amount: '',
};

const EMPTY_STATEMENT = {
  mode: 'full',
  month: '',
  from: '',
  to: '',
  status: '',
};

    pending: 0,
    success: 0,
    failed: 0,
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');

  const [pdfLoading, setPdfLoading] = useState(null);

  const [statementOpen, setStatementOpen] = useState(false);
  const [statementFilters, setStatementFilters] = useState(EMPTY_STATEMENT);
  const [downloadingStatement, setDownloadingStatement] = useState(false);

  });
  const [confirmCancel, setConfirmCancel] = useState({

    request: null,

  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await getPaymentRequests(
          filter ? { status: filter } : undefined
        );
        const data = res?.data || res || {};
        setRequests(data.requests || []);
        if (data.stats) setStats(data.stats);

        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load requests');

        if (!silent) setLoading(false);

  }, [filter]);

        clearInterval(pollRef.current);
        pollRef.current = null;
      }
      return;

    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => {
        const id = row._id || row.id;
        const busy = actionLoading === id;
        const buttons = [];

        if (row.status === 'pending') {
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="send"
              size="sm"
              variant="success"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleInitiate(row);
              }}
              loading={busy}
              title="Send STK"
            >
              Send
            </Button>
          );
        } else if (row.status === 'processing') {
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="resend"
              size="sm"
              variant="success"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleInitiate(row);
              }}
              loading={busy}
              title="Resend STK"
            >
              Resend
            </Button>
          );
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="check"
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setDetailId(id);
              }}
              title="Check status"
            >
              <HiRefresh className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </Button>
          );
        } else if (row.status === 'success') {
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="view"
              size="sm"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setDetailId(id);
              }}
              title="View"
            >
              <HiEye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </Button>
          );
        } else if (row.status === 'failed') {
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="retry"
              size="sm"
              variant="warning"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleInitiate(row);
              }}
              loading={busy}
              title="Retry"
            >
              Retry
            </Button>
          );
        }

        // Invoice PDF â€” available for all statuses
        buttons.push(
          <Button
            key="invoice"
            size="sm"

              title="Download receipt"
            >
              <HiReceiptTax className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </Button>
          );
        }

        if (['pending', 'processing', 'failed'].includes(row.status)) {
          buttons.push(
            <Button
              key="cancel"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setConfirmCancel({ open: true, request: row });
              }}
              disabled={busy}
              title="Cancel"
            >
              <HiBan className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </Button>
          );
        }

        buttons.push(
          <Button
            key="delete"
            size="sm"
            variant="danger"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setConfirmDelete({ open: true, request: row });
            }}
            disabled={busy}
            title="Delete"
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </Button>
        );

        return <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">{buttons}</div>;
      },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Payment Requests
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {stats.total} total Â· {stats.pending} pending Â· {stats.success} paid
            {stats.failed > 0 && ` Â· ${stats.failed} failed`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            icon={<HiDocumentReport className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={openStatement}
          >
            Statement
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            icon={
              <HiRefresh
                className={`w-4 h-4 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
              />
            }
            onClick={handleRefresh}
            disabled={refreshing}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreate}>
            New Request
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={setSearch}
              placeholder="Search ref, phone, description..."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
            {STATUS_FILTERS.map((f) => (
              <button
                key={f.key}
                onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                  filter === f.key
                    ? 'bg-green-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)]'
                }`}
                type="button"
              >
                {f.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          {loading && !requests.length ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <Spinner size="lg" />
            </div>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-16 text-center">
              <HiCreditCard className="w-12 h-12 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {search.trim() || filter
                  ? 'No matching payment requests'

          ) : (

            />
          )}

          {statementFilters.mode === 'range' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">

/* ============================================================
   Detail Modal
   ============================================================ */
function DetailModal({ id, onClose, onChanged }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [pdfLoading, setPdfLoading] = useState(null);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      if (!id) return;
      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await getPaymentRequest(id);
        setData(res?.data || res);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!silent) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load');
      } finally {
        if (!silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [id, toast]
  );

  const handleRefresh = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await load(true);
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleInvoice = async () => {
    if (!data) return;
    setPdfLoading('invoice');
    try {
      await downloadInvoicePdf(data);
      toast.success('Invoice downloaded');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to download invoice');
    } finally {
      setPdfLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReceipt = async () => {
    if (!data) return;
    setPdfLoading('receipt');
    try {
      await downloadReceiptPdf(data);
      toast.success('Receipt downloaded');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to download receipt');
    } finally {
      setPdfLoading(null);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) {
      setData(null);
      return;
    }
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data?.status !== 'processing') {
      if (pollRef.current) {
        clearInterval(pollRef.current);
        pollRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (pollRef.current) return;
    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => load(true), POLL_MS_DETAIL);
    return () => {
      if (pollRef.current) {
        clearInterval(pollRef.current);
        pollRef.current = null;
      }
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [data?.status]);

  if (!id) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      open={!!id}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={data?.invoiceNumber || data?.reference || 'Payment Request'}
      size="lg"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleInvoice}
            loading={pdfLoading === 'invoice'}
            disabled={pdfLoading === 'receipt'}
            icon={<HiDocumentDownload className="w-4 h-4" />}
          >
            Invoice PDF
          </Button>
          {data?.status === 'success' && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleReceipt}
              loading={pdfLoading === 'receipt'}
              disabled={pdfLoading === 'invoice'}
              icon={<HiReceiptTax className="w-4 h-4" />}
            >
              Receipt PDF
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={handleRefresh}
            disabled={refreshing || loading}
            icon={
              <HiRefresh
                className={`w-4 h-4 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
              />
            }
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      {loading && !data ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
          <Spinner size="lg" />
        </div>
      ) : !data ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] text-center py-8">
          Request not found
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Badge
              variant={STATUS_VARIANT[data.status] || 'default'}
              dot
              className={
                data.status === 'processing' ? 'animate-pulse' : undefined
              }
            >
              {STATUS_LABEL[data.status] || data.status}
            </Badge>
            {data.smsReceiptSent && (
              <Badge variant="success">
                <HiMail className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                SMS sent
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>

          <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">
            <Row label="Invoice #">
              <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                {data.invoiceNumber || data.reference || 'â€”'}
              </span>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Description">{data.description || 'â€”'}</Row>
            <Row label="Phone">
              <span className="font-mono">{data.phone}</span>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Amount">
              <span className="font-semibold">{formatKES(data.amount)}</span>
            </Row>
            <Row label="Status">
              {STATUS_LABEL[data.status] || data.status}
            </Row>
            <Row label="Attempts">{data.attempts ?? 0}</Row>
            {data.lastAttemptAt && (
              <Row label="Last attempt">
                {formatDate(data.lastAttemptAt, 'full')}
              </Row>
            )}
            <Row label="Created">
              {data.createdAt ? formatDate(data.createdAt, 'full') : 'â€”'}
            </Row>
            {data.createdBy && (
              <Row label="Created by">
                {data.createdBy.name || data.createdBy}
              </Row>
            )}
          </dl>

          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-[var(--border-color)]">
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
              M-Pesa
            </p>
            <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              {data.merchantRequestId && (
                <Row label="Merchant Req">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                    {data.merchantRequestId}
                  </span>
                </Row>
              )}
              {data.checkoutRequestId && (
                <Row label="Checkout Req">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs">
                    {data.checkoutRequestId}
                  </span>
                </Row>
              )}
              <Row label="Receipt">
                <span className="font-mono">
                  {data.mpesaReceiptNumber || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </Row>
              <Row label="Result code">
                <span className="font-mono">
                  {data.resultCode !== undefined && data.resultCode !== ''
                    ? data.resultCode
                    : 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </Row>
              <Row label="Result desc">{data.resultDesc || 'â€”'}</Row>
              <Row label="Paid at">
                {data.paidAt ? formatDate(data.paidAt, 'full') : 'â€”'}
              </Row>
            </dl>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   Row helper
   ============================================================ */
function Row({ label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] text-right text-xs break-all">
        {children}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  getPhotos,
  uploadPhoto,
  deletePhoto,
} from '../../services/portfolio/photos';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import SearchBar from '../../components/portfolio/ui/SearchBar';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { HiTrash, HiUpload, HiPlus, HiPhotograph } from 'react-icons/hi';

export default function Photos() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, photo: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ title: '', category: '', photo: null });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('');
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({
    open: false,
    id: null,
  });
  const [lightbox, setLightbox] = useState({ open: false, url: '' });

  const fetchPhotos = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getPhotos()
      .then((res) => setPhotos(res.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load photos'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPhotos();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const categories = Array.from(
    new Set(photos.map((p) => p.category).filter(Boolean))
  ).sort();

  const filtered = photos.filter((p) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !search.trim() ||
      p.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory =
      !categoryFilter || p.category === categoryFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const getImageUrl = (photo) => photo?.url || photo?.path || '';

  const openAdd = () => {
    setForm({ title: '', category: '', photo: null });
    setModal({ open: true, photo: null });
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error('File too large. Max 10MB');
      return;
    }
    setForm((p) => ({ ...p, photo: file }));
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    if (!form.photo) {
      toast.error('Please select a photo');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('title', form.title.trim());
    formData.append('category', form.category || '');
    formData.append('photo', form.photo);
    try {
      await uploadPhoto(formData);
      toast.success('Photo uploaded');
      setModal({ open: false, photo: null });
      fetchPhotos();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try {
      await deletePhoto(confirmDelete.id);
      toast.success('Photo deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null });
      fetchPhotos();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Photos
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {photos.length} photo{photos.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button icon={<HiUpload className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openAdd}>
          Upload Photo
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
        <div className="flex-1">
          <SearchBar
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            placeholder="Search photos..."
          />
        </div>
        {categories.length > 0 && (
          <select
            value={categoryFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500"
          >
            <option value="">All categories</option>
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <option key={c} value={c}>
                {c}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        )}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-green-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
        </div>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="text-center py-16">
          <HiPhotograph className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-3" />
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mb-2">
            {photos.length === 0 ? 'No photos yet' : 'No matches'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] text-sm mb-4">
            {photos.length === 0
              ? 'Upload your first photo to the gallery'
              : 'Try a different search or filter'}
          </p>
          {photos.length === 0 && (
            <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openAdd}>
              Upload Photo
            </Button>
          )}
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {filtered.map((p) => (
            <Card
              key={p._id}
              padding={false}
              className="overflow-hidden group"
            >
              <div className="relative">
                <img
                  src={getImageUrl(p)}
                  alt={p.title || 'Photo'}
                  className="w-full h-48 object-cover cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setLightbox({ open: true, url: getImageUrl(p) })
                  }
                  onError={(e) => {
                    e.target.src =
                      'data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200" fill="%23ddd"><rect width="200" height="200"/><text x="50%" y="50%" text-anchor="middle" dy=".3em" fill="%23999" font-size="16">No Image</text></svg>';
                  }}
                />
                <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: p._id })}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700"
                    type="button"
                    title="Delete photo"
                  >
                    <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                  {p.title || 'Untitled'}
                </p>
                {p.category && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                    {p.category}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Modal
        open={modal.open}
        onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, photo: null })}
        title="Upload Photo"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setModal({ open: false, photo: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} loading={saving}>
              Upload
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((p) => ({ ...p, title: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="Photo title"
            disabled={saving}
          />
          <Input
            label="Category"
            value={form.category}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((p) => ({ ...p, category: e.target.value }))
            }
            placeholder="e.g., Events, Office, Team"
            disabled={saving}
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Photo *
            </label>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp"
              onChange={handleFileChange}
              className="w-full text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-medium file:bg-green-50 dark:file:bg-green-900/20 file:text-green-700 dark:file:text-green-400"
              disabled={saving}
            />
            {form.photo && (
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                Selected: {form.photo.name}
              </p>
            )}
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WEBP. Max 10MB.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Lightbox */}
      <Modal
        open={lightbox.open}
        onClose={() => setLightbox({ open: false, url: '' })}
        title="Preview"
        size="xl"
      >
        {lightbox.url && (
          <img
            src={lightbox.url}
            alt="Preview"
            className="max-w-full max-h-[75vh] rounded-lg object-contain mx-auto"
          />
        )}
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null })}
        title="Delete Photo"
        message="Permanently delete this photo? It will also be removed from Cloudinary."
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { getProjects, createProject, updateProject, deleteProject } from '../../services/portfolio/projects';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Toggle from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Toggle';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { HiPencil, HiTrash, HiStar } from 'react-icons/hi';

export default function Projects() {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, project: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '', image: '', link: '', technologies: [], featured: false, isActive: true, order: 0 });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, id: null });

  const fetchProjects = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getProjects()
      .then(res => setProjects(res.data || res))
      .catch(console.error)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => { fetchProjects(); }, []);

  const openCreate = () => { setForm({ name: '', description: '', image: '', link: '', technologies: [], featured: false, isActive: true, order: 0 }); setModal({ open: true, project: null }); };
  const openEdit = (p) => { setForm({ ...p }); setModal({ open: true, project: p }); };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (modal.project) await updateProject(modal.project._id, form);
      else await createProject(form);
      setModal({ open: false, project: null });
      fetchProjects();
    } catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try { await deleteProject(confirmDelete.id); setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null }); fetchProjects(); }
    catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
  };

  const columns = [
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name', render: (row) => (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="font-medium">{row.name}</span>
        {row.featured && <HiStar className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />}
      </div>
    )},
    { key: 'isActive', label: 'Status', render: (row) => row.isActive ? <Badge variant="success">Active</Badge> : <Badge variant="default">Inactive</Badge> },
    { key: 'order', label: 'Order', render: (row) => <span className="text-sm">{row.order}</span> },
    { key: 'actions', label: 'Actions', render: (row) => (
      <div className="flex gap-1">
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => openEdit(row)}><HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: row._id })}><HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
      </div>
    )},
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">Projects</h1>
        <Button onClick={openCreate}>Add Project</Button>
      </div>
      <Card>
        <Table columns={columns} data={projects} loading={loading} emptyMessage="No projects." />
      </Card>

      <Modal open={modal.open} onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, project: null })} title={modal.project ? 'Edit Project' : 'New Project'} size="md">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input label="Name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, name: e.target.value }))} />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">Description</label>
            <textarea value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, description: e.target.value }))} rows={3}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500 resize-y text-sm" />
          </div>
          <Input label="Image URL" value={form.image} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, image: e.target.value }))} />
          <Input label="Link" value={form.link} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, link: e.target.value }))} />
          <Input label="Technologies (comma separated)" value={(form.technologies || []).join(', ')} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, technologies: e.target.value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()) }))} />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Toggle label="Featured" checked={form.featured || false} onChange={(v) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, featured: v }))} />
            <Toggle label="Active" checked={form.isActive} onChange={(v) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, isActive: v }))} />
            <Input label="Order" type="number" value={form.order} onChange={(e) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, order: Number(e.target.value) }))} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setModal({ open: false, project: null })}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} loading={saving}>Save</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog open={confirmDelete.open} onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null })} title="Delete Project" message="Delete this project?" confirmLabel="Delete" variant="danger" onConfirm={handleDelete} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  getServices,
  createService,
  updateService,
  deleteService,
} from '../../services/portfolio/services';
import Card from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Button';
import Modal from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Modal';
import Input from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Input';
import Toggle from '../../components/portfolio/ui/Toggle';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/portfolio/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/portfolio/ToastContext';
import { HiPencil, HiTrash, HiPlus } from 'react-icons/hi';

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  icon: 'âš¡',
  isActive: true,
  order: 0,
};

export default function Services() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [services, setServices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ open: false, service: null });
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, id: null });

  const fetchServices = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getServices()
      .then((res) => {
        const list = res.data || res || [];
        setServices(
          Array.isArray(list)
            ? [...list].sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0))
            : []
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load services'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchServices();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setModal({ open: true, service: null });
  };

  const openEdit = (s) => {
    setForm({ ...EMPTY_FORM, ...s });
    setModal({ open: true, service: s });
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (modal.service) await updateService(modal.service._id, form);
      else await createService(form);
      toast.success(modal.service ? 'Service updated' : 'Service created');
      setModal({ open: false, service: null });
      fetchServices();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    try {
      await deleteService(confirmDelete.id);
      toast.success('Service deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, id: null });
      fetchServices();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'title',
      label: 'Title',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          {row.title}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'icon',
      label: 'Icon',
      render: (row) => <span className="text-lg">{row.icon || 'âš¡'}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: 'isActive',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) =>
        row.isActive !== false ? (
          <Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge variant="default">Inactive</Badge>
        ),
    },
    {
      key: 'order',
      label: 'Order',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">{row.order}</span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => openEdit(row)}>
            <HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="danger"
            onClick={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: true, id: row._id })}
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Services
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {services.length} service{services.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreate}>
          Add Service
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={services}
            loading={loading}
            emptyMessage="No services yet."
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={modal.open}
        onClose={() => setModal({ open: false, service: null })}
        title={modal.service ? 'Edit Service' : 'New Service'}
        size="md"
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, title: e.target.value }))}
          />
          <Input
            label="Icon (emoji)"
            value={form.icon}
            onChange={(e) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, icon: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder="âš¡"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Description
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={form.description}
