import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  HiDownload,
  HiMail,
  HiTrash,
  HiPlus,
  HiRefresh,
  HiDatabase,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Toggle from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Toggle';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import Pagination from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Pagination';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getBackupSettings,
  updateBackupSettings,
  createBackupNow,
  getBackups,
  getBackupDownloadUrl,
  emailBackup,
  restoreBackup,
  deleteBackup,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/backup';
import { formatDateTime } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';
import { BACKUP_FREQUENCIES, statusVariant } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/constants';

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
  autoEnabled: false,
  frequency: 'daily',
  hourUtc: 3,
  dayOfWeek: 0,
  dayOfMonth: 1,
  emailOnCompletion: false,
  notifyEmails: [],
  retentionDays: 30,
};

const DAYS = [
  { value: 0, label: 'Sunday' },
  { value: 1, label: 'Monday' },
  { value: 2, label: 'Tuesday' },
  { value: 3, label: 'Wednesday' },
  { value: 4, label: 'Thursday' },
  { value: 5, label: 'Friday' },
  { value: 6, label: 'Saturday' },
];

export default function Backup() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState('list');

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  const [settingsLoading, setSettingsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [settingsSaving, setSettingsSaving] = useState(false);

  const [emailModal, setEmailModal] = useState({ open: false, backup: null });
  const [emailTo, setEmailTo] = useState('');
  const [emailSending, setEmailSending] = useState(false);

  const [restoreTarget, setRestoreTarget] = useState(null);
  const [restoreText, setRestoreText] = useState('');
  const [restoring, setRestoring] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({ open: false, backup: null });
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const loadBackups = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getBackups({ page, limit: 20 })
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res?.data || res;
        setItems(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.items || []);
        setMeta(res?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load backups'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  const loadSettings = () => {
    setSettingsLoading(true);
    getBackupSettings()
      .then((res) => {
        const s = res?.data || res;
        setSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...s });
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load settings'))
      .finally(() => setSettingsLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadBackups();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [page]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'settings') loadSettings();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [tab]);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setCreating(true);
    toast.info('Backup started â€” this can take 10â€“60 seconds');
    try {
      await createBackupNow();
      toast.success('Backup created');
      loadBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create backup');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

const handleDownload = async (row) => {
  try {
    const res = await getBackupDownloadUrl(row._id || row.id);
    const url = res?.data?.url || res?.url;
    const fileName = res?.data?.fileName || row.fileName || 'backup.json';
    if (!url) throw new Error('No download URL');

    const blobRes = await fetch(url);
    if (!blobRes.ok) throw new Error(`Fetch failed: ${blobRes.status}`);

    const blob = await blobRes.blob();
    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = blobUrl;
    a.download = fileName;
    a.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);

    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 1000);

    toast.success('Download started');
  } catch (err) {
    toast.error(err.message || 'Download failed');
  }
};

  const handleEmail = async () => {
    if (!emailModal.backup) return;
    const emails = emailTo
      .split(',')
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (emails.length === 0) {
      toast.error('Enter at least one email');
      return;
    }
    setEmailSending(true);
    try {
      await emailBackup(emailModal.backup._id || emailModal.backup.id, {
        emails,
      });
      toast.success(`Backup sent to ${emails.length} address(es)`);
      setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null });
      setEmailTo('');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to email');
    } finally {
      setEmailSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async () => {
    if (!restoreTarget || restoreText !== 'RESTORE') return;
    setRestoring(true);
    try {
      const res = await restoreBackup(restoreTarget._id || restoreTarget.id);
      const data = res?.data || res;
      const summary = data?.restored
        ? Object.entries(data.restored)
            .map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`)
            .join(', ')
        : 'complete';
      toast.success(`Restore complete â€” ${summary}`);
      setRestoreTarget(null);
      setRestoreText('');
      loadBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to restore');
    } finally {
      setRestoring(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.backup) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await deleteBackup(confirmDelete.backup._id || confirmDelete.backup.id);
      toast.success('Backup deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, backup: null });
      loadBackups();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSettings = async () => {
    setSettingsSaving(true);
    try {
      await updateBackupSettings(settings);
      toast.success('Backup settings saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSettingsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'fileName',
      label: 'File',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.fileName || row.filename || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          {row.size && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">
              {Math.round((row.size || 0) / 1024)} KB
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'documentsCount',
      label: 'Docs',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.documentsCount ?? 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={statusVariant(row.status)} dot>
          {row.status || 'success'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Created',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.createdAt ? formatDateTime(row.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleDownload(row);
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Download"
          >
            <HiDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setEmailTo('');
              setEmailModal({ open: true, backup: row });
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Email"
          >
            <HiMail className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setRestoreText('');
              setRestoreTarget(row);
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
            type="button"
            title="Restore"
          >
            <HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setConfirmDelete({ open: true, backup: row });
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-red-600"
            type="button"
            title="Delete"
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Backup
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            Database snapshots stored in Cloudinary
          </p>
        </div>
        {tab === 'list' && (
          <Button
            icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={handleCreate}
            loading={creating}
          >
            Create backup
          </Button>
        )}
        {tab === 'settings' && (
          <Button
            icon={<HiDatabase className="w-4 h-4" />}
            onClick={handleSaveSettings}
            loading={settingsSaving}
          >
            Save settings
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('list')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition ${
            tab === 'list'
              ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
          }`}
          type="button"
        >
          Backups
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setTab('settings')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition ${
            tab === 'settings'
              ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
          }`}
          type="button"
        >
          Settings
        </button>
      </div>

      {tab === 'list' && (
        <Card padding={false}>
          <div className="p-4">
            <Table
              columns={columns}
              data={items}
              loading={loading}
              rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
              emptyMessage="No backups yet"
            />
            <Pagination
              page={meta.page}
              totalPages={meta.pages}
              onPageChange={setPage}
            />
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {tab === 'settings' && (
        <Card>
          {settingsLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Toggle
                label="Auto backup enabled"
                description="Run backups on a schedule"
                checked={!!settings.autoEnabled}
                onChange={(v) =>
                  setSettings({ ...settings, autoEnabled: v })
                }
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <Select
                  label="Frequency"
                  value={settings.frequency || 'daily'}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({ ...settings, frequency: e.target.value })
                  }
                  options={BACKUP_FREQUENCIES}
                  disabled={!settings.autoEnabled}
                />
                <Input
                  label="Hour (UTC)"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  max="23"
                  value={settings.hourUtc ?? 3}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      hourUtc: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  disabled={!settings.autoEnabled}
                />
              </div>
              {settings.frequency === 'weekly' && (
                <Select
                  label="Day of week"
                  value={settings.dayOfWeek ?? 0}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      dayOfWeek: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  options={DAYS}
                  disabled={!settings.autoEnabled}
                />
              )}
              {settings.frequency === 'monthly' && (
                <Input
                  label="Day of month"
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="28"
                  value={settings.dayOfMonth ?? 1}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSettings({
                      ...settings,
                      dayOfMonth: Number(e.target.value),
                    })
                  }
                  disabled={!settings.autoEnabled}
                />
              )}
              <Input
                label="Retention (days)"
                type="number"
                value={settings.retentionDays ?? 30}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setSettings({
                    ...settings,
                    retentionDays: Number(e.target.value),
                  })
                }
              />
              <Toggle
                label="Email on completion"
                checked={!!settings.emailOnCompletion}
                onChange={(v) =>
                  setSettings({ ...settings, emailOnCompletion: v })
                }
              />
              <Input
                label="Notification emails"
                hint="Comma-separated"
                value={(settings.notifyEmails || []).join(', ')}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setSettings({
                    ...settings,
                    notifyEmails: e.target.value
                      .split(',')
                      .map((s) => s.trim())
                      .filter(Boolean),
                  })
                }
                placeholder="ops@tvetgrid.co.ke"
              />
              <dl className="pt-4 border-t border-[var(--border-color)] space-y-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <dt>Last run</dt>
                  <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                    {settings.lastRunAt
                      ? formatDateTime(settings.lastRunAt)
                      : 'Never'}
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <dt>Last status</dt>
                  <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] capitalize">
                    {settings.lastRunStatus || 'never'}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      <Modal
        open={emailModal.open}
        onClose={() => setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null })}
        title="Email backup"
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setEmailModal({ open: false, backup: null })}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleEmail} loading={emailSending}>
              Send
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Input
          label="Recipient emails"
          hint="Comma-separated"
          value={emailTo}
          onChange={(e) => setEmailTo(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="ops@tvetgrid.co.ke, admin@tvetgrid.co.ke"
        />
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        open={!!restoreTarget}
        onClose={() => {
          setRestoreTarget(null);
          setRestoreText('');
        }}
        title="Restore backup"
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setRestoreTarget(null);
                setRestoreText('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={handleRestore}
              disabled={restoreText !== 'RESTORE'}
              loading={restoring}
            >
              Restore
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg p-3">
            <p className="font-medium mb-1">This destroys current data.</p>
            <p>
              Every collection in the database will be dropped and re-inserted
              from{' '}
              <strong className="font-mono">
                {restoreTarget?.fileName}
              </strong>
              .
            </p>
          </div>
          <Input
            label='Type "RESTORE" to confirm'
            value={restoreText}
            onChange={(e) => setRestoreText(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="RESTORE"
            className="font-mono"
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, backup: null })}
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
        title="Delete backup"
        message={`Delete ${confirmDelete.backup?.fileName}? The file will be removed from Cloudinary and the database.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={deleting}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\tvetgrid\CourseDetail.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiPlus,
  HiTrash,
  HiSave,
  HiPencil,
  HiBookOpen,
  HiDocumentText,
  HiClipboardList,
  HiChevronUp,
  HiChevronDown,
  HiExclamation,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import { getCourse, updateCourse } from '../../services/tvetgrid/courses';
import {
  getSubjectsForCourse,
  createSubject,
  updateSubject,
  deleteSubject,
  reorderSubjects,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/subjects';
import { getNotes } from '../../services/tvetgrid/notes';
import { getPapers } from '../../services/tvetgrid/papers';

const TABS = [
  { key: 'subjects', label: 'Subjects', icon: HiBookOpen },
  { key: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: HiDocumentText },
  { key: 'papers', label: 'Papers', icon: HiClipboardList },
];

export default function CourseDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [course, setCourse] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('subjects');

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState('');
  const [syllabusCode, setSyllabusCode] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [isPublished, setIsPublished] = useState(false);
  const [savingCourse, setSavingCourse] = useState(false);

  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState([]);
  const [subjectsLoading, setSubjectsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [subjectModal, setSubjectModal] = useState({ open: false, mode: 'create', subject: null });
  const [subjectForm, setSubjectForm] = useState({ name: '', code: '', description: '', order: 0 });
  const [savingSubject, setSavingSubject] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDeleteSubject, setConfirmDeleteSubject] = useState({ open: false, subject: null });

  const [notes, setNotes] = useState([]);
  const [notesLoading, setNotesLoading] = useState(false);

  const [papers, setPapers] = useState([]);
  const [papersLoading, setPapersLoading] = useState(false);

  const loadCourse = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getCourse(id);
      const c = res?.data || res;
      setCourse(c);
      setTitle(c.title || '');
      setSubject(c.subject || '');
      setSyllabusCode(c.syllabusCode || '');
      setDescription(c.description || '');
      setIsPublished(!!c.isPublished);
      if (Array.isArray(c.subjects)) {
        setSubjects(c.subjects);
      } else {
        loadSubjects();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load course');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/courses');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadSubjects = () => {
    setSubjectsLoading(true);
    getSubjectsForCourse(id)
      .then((res) => setSubjects(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load subjects'))
      .finally(() => setSubjectsLoading(false));
  };

  const loadNotes = () => {
    setNotesLoading(true);
    getNotes({ courseId: id, limit: 100 })
      .then((res) => setNotes(res?.data || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load notes'))
      .finally(() => setNotesLoading(false));
  };

  const loadPapers = () => {
    setPapersLoading(true);
    getPapers({ courseId: id, limit: 100 })
      .then((res) => setPapers(res?.data || []))
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load papers'))
      .finally(() => setPapersLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCourse();
    loadNotes();
    loadPapers();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const handleSaveCourse = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    setSavingCourse(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateCourse(id, {
        title: title.trim(),
        subject: subject.trim(),
        syllabusCode: syllabusCode.trim(),
        description: description.trim(),
        isPublished,
      });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setCourse(updated);
      toast.success('Course saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSavingCourse(false);
    }
  };

  const openCreateSubject = () => {
    setSubjectForm({ name: '', code: '', description: '', order: subjects.length });
    setSubjectModal({ open: true, mode: 'create', subject: null });
  };

  const openEditSubject = (s) => {
    setSubjectForm({
      name: s.name,
      code: s.code || '',
      description: s.description || '',
      order: s.order || 0,
    });
    setSubjectModal({ open: true, mode: 'edit', subject: s });
  };

  const handleSaveSubject = async () => {
    if (!subjectForm.name.trim()) {
      toast.error('Subject name is required');
      return;
    }
    setSavingSubject(true);
    try {
      if (subjectModal.mode === 'create') {
        await createSubject({
          courseId: id,
          name: subjectForm.name.trim(),
          code: subjectForm.code.trim() || undefined,
          description: subjectForm.description.trim() || undefined,
          order: subjectForm.order,
        });
        toast.success('Subject created');
      } else {
        await updateSubject(subjectModal.subject._id, {
          name: subjectForm.name.trim(),
          code: subjectForm.code.trim() || null,
          description: subjectForm.description.trim() || null,
          order: subjectForm.order,
        });
        toast.success('Subject updated');
      }
      setSubjectModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', subject: null });
      loadSubjects();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save subject');
    } finally {
      setSavingSubject(false);
    }
  };

  const requestDeleteSubject = (subjectItem) => {
    if (subjects.length <= 1) {
      toast.error('A course must have at least one subject');
      return;
    }
    setConfirmDeleteSubject({ open: true, subject: subjectItem });
  };

  const handleDeleteSubject = async () => {
    if (!confirmDeleteSubject.subject) return;
    try {
      await deleteSubject(confirmDeleteSubject.subject._id);
      toast.success('Subject deleted');
      setConfirmDeleteSubject({ open: false, subject: null });
      loadSubjects();
      loadNotes();
      loadPapers();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'LAST_SUBJECT') {
        toast.error('A course must have at least one subject');
      } else {
        toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete subject');
      }
    }
  };

  const moveSubject = async (index, direction) => {
    const newSubjects = [...subjects];
    const swapIdx = index + direction;
    if (swapIdx < 0 || swapIdx >= newSubjects.length) return;

    [newSubjects[index], newSubjects[swapIdx]] = [newSubjects[swapIdx], newSubjects[index]];

    const items = newSubjects.map((s, i) => ({ id: s._id || s.id, order: i + 1 }));
    try {
      await reorderSubjects(items);
      setSubjects(newSubjects.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, order: i + 1 })));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to reorder');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!course) return null;

  const hasSubjects = subjects.length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/courses')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {course.title}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1 font-mono">
            {course.slug}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {!hasSubjects && (
            <Badge variant="warning" dot>
              No subjects yet
            </Badge>
          )}
          <Badge variant={course.isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
            {course.isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!hasSubjects && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/30 p-3">
          <HiExclamation className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          <div className="text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
            <p className="font-medium">Add at least one subject</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-90">
              Notes and papers attach to a subject. Add the first subject below
              before creating content.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <Card title="Course details">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Title *"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Subject label"
              value={subject}
              onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
              hint="Display label â€” different from the subjects below"
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label="Syllabus code"
            value={syllabusCode}
            onChange={(e) => setSyllabusCode(e.target.value)}
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Description
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              rows={3}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isPublished}
                onChange={(e) => setIsPublished(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-[var(--border-color)] text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
              Published
            </label>
            <Button
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={handleSaveCourse}
              loading={savingCourse}
            >
              Save changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] overflow-x-auto">
        {TABS.map((t) => {
          const Icon = t.icon;
          const disabled = t.key !== 'subjects' && !hasSubjects;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.key}
              onClick={() => !disabled && setTab(t.key)}
              disabled={disabled}
              title={disabled ? 'Add a subject first' : undefined}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 transition ${
                tab === t.key
                  ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400'
                  : disabled
                  ? 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-muted)] cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
                  : 'border-transparent text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]'
              }`}
              type="button"
            >
              <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {tab === 'subjects' && (
        <Card
          title={`Subjects${subjects.length > 0 ? ` (${subjects.length})` : ''}`}
          description={
            subjects.length === 0
              ? 'Add at least one subject before creating notes or papers'
              : undefined
          }
          actions={
            <Button
              size="sm"
              icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={openCreateSubject}
            >
              Add subject
            </Button>
          }
          padding={false}
        >
          {subjectsLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          ) : subjects.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-12 px-4 text-center">
              <HiBookOpen className="w-10 h-10 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
                Every course needs at least one subject before you can add notes
                or papers.
              </p>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
                onClick={openCreateSubject}
              >
                Add first subject
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
              {subjects.map((s, i) => {
                const isOnly = subjects.length === 1;
                return (
                  <li
                    key={s._id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] w-6 text-right shrink-0">
                        {i + 1}.
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                          {s.name}
                        </p>
                        {s.code && (
                          <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                            {s.code}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={() => moveSubject(i, -1)}
                        disabled={i === 0}
                        title="Move up"
                      >
                        <HiChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="ghost"
                        onClick={() => moveSubject(i, 1)}
                        disabled={i === subjects.length - 1}
                        title="Move down"
                      >
                        <HiChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="secondary"
                        onClick={() => openEditSubject(s)}
                      >
                        <HiPencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="danger"
                        onClick={() => requestDeleteSubject(s)}
                        disabled={isOnly}
                        title={
                          isOnly
                            ? 'Cannot delete the only subject'
                            : 'Delete subject'
                        }
                      >
                        <HiTrash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      {tab === 'notes' && hasSubjects && (
        <Card
          title={`Notes (${notes.length})`}
          actions={
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => navigate(`/tvetgrid/notes?courseId=${id}`)}
            >
              Manage notes
            </Button>
          }
          padding={false}
        >
          {notesLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          ) : notes.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-12 text-center">
              No notes yet.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
              {notes.map((n) => (
                <li key={n._id}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => navigate(`/tvetgrid/notes/${n._id}`)}
                    className="w-full text-left px-4 py-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    type="button"
                  >
                    <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                      {n.title}
                    </p>
                    <Badge variant="default">
                      {n.visibility || 'public'}
                    </Badge>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      {tab === 'papers' && hasSubjects && (
        <Card
          title={`Papers (${papers.length})`}
          actions={
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => navigate(`/tvetgrid/papers?courseId=${id}`)}
            >
              Manage papers
            </Button>
          }
          padding={false}
        >
          {papersLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          ) : papers.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-12 text-center">
              No papers yet.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
              {papers.map((p) => (
                <li key={p._id}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => navigate(`/tvetgrid/papers/${p._id}`)}
                    className="w-full text-left px-4 py-3 hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
                    type="button"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                        {p.year} {p.paperNo ? `Â· Paper ${p.paperNo}` : ''}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                        {p.totalMarks || 0} marks Â· {p.questions?.length || 0}{' '}
                        questions
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <Badge
                      variant={p.isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'}
                      dot
                    >
                      {p.isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
                    </Badge>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      <Modal
        open={subjectModal.open}
        onClose={() =>
          setSubjectModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', subject: null })
        }
        title={subjectModal.mode === 'create' ? 'New subject' : 'Edit subject'}
        size="md"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() =>
                setSubjectModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', subject: null })
              }
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSaveSubject} loading={savingSubject}>
              Save
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Name *"
            value={subjectForm.name}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setSubjectForm({ ...subjectForm, name: e.target.value })
            }
            placeholder="Basic Electricity"
          />
          <Input
            label="Code"
            value={subjectForm.code}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setSubjectForm({ ...subjectForm, code: e.target.value })
            }
            placeholder="ELEC-1.1"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Description
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={subjectForm.description}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSubjectForm({ ...subjectForm, description: e.target.value })
              }
              rows={2}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label="Order"
            type="number"
            value={subjectForm.order}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setSubjectForm({ ...subjectForm, order: Number(e.target.value) })
            }
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDeleteSubject.open}
        onClose={() =>
          setConfirmDeleteSubject({ open: false, subject: null })
        }
        onConfirm={handleDeleteSubject}
        title="Delete subject"
        message={`Delete "${confirmDeleteSubject.subject?.name}"? Notes in this subject will be deleted; papers will be unpublished. This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiPlus, HiPencil, HiTrash } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import SearchBar from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/SearchBar';
import Pagination from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Pagination';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getCourses,
  createCourse,
  deleteCourse,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/courses';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';

const PUBLISHED_FILTERS = [
  { value: '', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'true', label: 'Published' },
  { value: 'false', label: 'Draft' },
];

const EMPTY_FORM = {
  title: '',
  subject: '',
  syllabusCode: '',
  description: '',
  isPublished: false,
};

export default function Courses() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [published, setPublished] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState({
    open: false,
    course: null,
  });

  const load = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getCourses({
      page,
      limit: 20,
      q: search || undefined,
      published: published || undefined,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        setItems(res?.data || []);
        setMeta(res?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [page, search, published]);

  const patch = (key, value) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await createCourse({
        title: form.title.trim(),
        subject: form.subject.trim() || undefined,
        syllabusCode: form.syllabusCode.trim() || undefined,
        description: form.description.trim() || undefined,
        isPublished: form.isPublished,
      });
      const created = res?.data || res;
      toast.success('Course created â€” now add its first subject');
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
      if (created?._id) {
        navigate(`/tvetgrid/courses/${created._id}`);
      } else {
        load();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirmDelete.course) return;
    try {
      await deleteCourse(confirmDelete.course._id || confirmDelete.course.id);
      toast.success('Course deleted');
      setConfirmDelete({ open: false, course: null });
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    }
  };

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'title',
      label: 'Course',
      render: (row) => {
        const subjCount =
          row.subjects?.length ??
          (typeof row.subjectCount === 'number' ? row.subjectCount : null);

        return (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {row.title}
              </p>
              {subjCount === 0 && (
                <Badge variant="warning" dot>
                  No subjects
                </Badge>
              )}
              {subjCount !== null && subjCount > 0 && (
                <Badge variant="default">
                  {subjCount} subject{subjCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] font-mono">
              {row.slug}
            </p>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: 'subject',
      label: 'Subject label',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {row.subject || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'syllabusCode',
      label: 'Syllabus',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.syllabusCode || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'isPublished',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={row.isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
          {row.isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Created',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.createdAt ? formatDate(row.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1">
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              navigate(`/tvetgrid/courses/${row._id || row.id}`);
            }}
            title="Edit"
          >
            <HiPencil className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="danger"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setConfirmDelete({ open: true, course: row });
            }}
            title="Delete"
          >
            <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Courses
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} course{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => {
            setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
            setCreateOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          New course
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={(v) => {
                setSearch(v);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Search courses..."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="w-full sm:w-40">
            <Select
              value={published}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setPublished(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              options={PUBLISHED_FILTERS}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={items}
            loading={loading}
            rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
            onRowClick={(row) =>
              navigate(`/tvetgrid/courses/${row._id || row.id}`)
            }
            emptyMessage="No courses yet"
          />
          <Pagination
            page={meta.page}
            totalPages={meta.pages}
            onPageChange={setPage}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        title="New course"
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCreate} loading={saving}>
              Create
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) => patch('title', e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Basic Electricity"
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Subject label"
              value={form.subject}
              onChange={(e) => patch('subject', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Electrical"
              hint="Optional display label â€” different from the Subjects hierarchy"
            />
            <Input
              label="Syllabus code"
              value={form.syllabusCode}
              onChange={(e) => patch('syllabusCode', e.target.value)}
              placeholder="ELEC-101"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Description
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(e) => patch('description', e.target.value)}
              rows={4}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm"
              placeholder="Course overview..."
            />
          </div>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={form.isPublished}
              onChange={(e) => patch('isPublished', e.target.checked)}
              className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-[var(--border-color)] text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            />
            Publish immediately
          </label>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            After creating, you'll be taken to the course page to add its first
            subject.
          </p>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDelete.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDelete({ open: false, course: null })}
        onConfirm={handleDelete}
        title="Delete course"
        message={`Delete "${confirmDelete.course?.title}"? All subjects, lessons, notes, and papers under this course will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { getMeetings } from '../../services/tvetgrid/meetings';

export default function Dashboard() {

  const toast = useToast();

    users: 0,
    courses: 0,
    lessons: 0,
    papers: 0,
    meetingsLive: 0,
    meetingsTotal: 0,
  });
  const [recentUsers, setRecentUsers] = useState([]);
  const [attempts30d, setAttempts30d] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [usersRes, coursesRes, lessonsRes, papersRes, meetingsRes, attemptsRes] =
        await Promise.all([
          getUsers({ limit: 5 }).catch(() => ({ data: [], meta: { total: 0 } })),
          getCourses({ limit: 1 }).catch(() => ({ data: [], meta: { total: 0 } })),
          getLessons({ limit: 1 }).catch(() => ({ data: [], meta: { total: 0 } })),
          getPapers({ limit: 1 }).catch(() => ({ data: [], meta: { total: 0 } })),
          getMeetings({ limit: 100 }).catch(() => ({ data: [], meta: { total: 0 } })),
          getAttemptsAnalytics({}).catch(() => ({ last30Days: 0 })),
        ]);

      const meetings = meetingsRes?.data || [];
      setStats({
        users: usersRes?.meta?.total ?? 0,
        courses: coursesRes?.meta?.total ?? 0,
        lessons: lessonsRes?.meta?.total ?? 0,
        papers: papersRes?.meta?.total ?? 0,
        meetingsLive: meetings.filter((m) => m.status === 'live').length,
        meetingsTotal: meetingsRes?.meta?.total ?? meetings.length,
      });
      setRecentUsers(usersRes?.data || []);
      setAttempts30d(attemptsRes?.last30Days ?? 0);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load dashboard');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );

    { label: 'Users', path: '/tvetgrid/users', icon: HiUsers, color: 'from-indigo-500 to-blue-600' },
    { label: 'Courses', path: '/tvetgrid/courses', icon: HiBookOpen, color: 'from-emerald-500 to-green-600' },
    { label: 'Lessons', path: '/tvetgrid/lessons', icon: HiVideoCamera, color: 'from-violet-500 to-purple-600' },
    { label: 'Notes', path: '/tvetgrid/notes', icon: HiDocumentText, color: 'from-amber-500 to-orange-600' },
    { label: 'Papers', path: '/tvetgrid/papers', icon: HiClipboardList, color: 'from-sky-500 to-cyan-600' },
    { label: 'Meetings', path: '/tvetgrid/meetings', icon: HiUserGroup, color: 'from-rose-500 to-pink-600' },

    { label: 'Backup', path: '/tvetgrid/backup', icon: HiRefresh, color: 'from-slate-500 to-gray-600' },
  ];

  return (

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">

          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            TVETGrid platform overview
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiRefresh className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={load}
          loading={loading}
        >
          Refresh
        </Button>
      </div>

        />
        <StatCard

          hint={`${stats.meetingsTotal} total Â· ${stats.meetingsLive} live now`}

        title="Recent users"

              >
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                    {u.name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">
                    {u.email}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  HiServer,
  HiDatabase,
  HiStatusOnline,
  HiCloud,
  HiVideoCamera,
  HiMail,
  HiSparkles,
  HiRefresh,
  HiChip,
  HiInbox,
  HiCog,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import { getDetailedHealth } from '../../services/tvetgrid/health';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';

const OK_STATES = ['up', 'enabled', 'connected', 'healthy', 'configured'];
const REFRESH_MS = 30000;

function StatusDot({ status }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn =
    status === 'disabled' || status === 'degraded' || status === 'idle';
  const color = ok ? 'bg-green-500' : warn ? 'bg-gray-400' : 'bg-red-500';
  return <span className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${color}`} />;
}

function Badge({ color = 'gray', children }) {
  const colors = {
    green:
      'bg-green-500/10 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 border-green-500/20',
    red: 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border-red-500/20',
    yellow:
      'bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/20',
    blue: 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-500/20',
    gray: 'bg-gray-500/10 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 border-gray-500/20',
  };
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${colors[color]}`}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value, hint }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-[var(--text-muted)] uppercase tracking-wider">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] mt-0.5 truncate">
        {value ?? 'â€”'}
      </p>
      {hint && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-0.5 truncate">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Detail({ label, value, mono }) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-muted)] text-xs shrink-0">{label}</dt>
      <dd
        className={`text-[var(--text-primary)] text-xs text-right truncate ${
          mono ? 'font-mono' : ''
        }`}
        title={String(value)}
      >
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function ServiceCard({ icon: Icon, title, status, children }) {
  const ok = OK_STATES.includes(status);
  const warn =
    status === 'disabled' || status === 'degraded' || status === 'idle';
  return (
    <div className="bg-[var(--bg-primary)] rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)] p-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]">{title}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <StatusDot status={status} />
          <Badge color={ok ? 'green' : warn ? 'gray' : 'red'}>
            {status || 'unknown'}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>
      <dl className="space-y-2 text-sm">{children}</dl>
    </div>
  );
}

// Unwrap ApiResponse.ok body: { success, data, message } â†’ data
// Falls back to the body itself if it's already the payload.
function unwrapHealth(res) {
  if (!res || typeof res !== 'object') return null;
  const candidate = res.data ?? res;
  if (!candidate || typeof candidate !== 'object') return null;
  return candidate;
}

function isUsablePayload(p) {
  if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return false;
  // Must have at least one expected top-level key
  return ['server', 'database', 'status', 'overall', 'redis'].some(
    (k) => p[k] !== undefined
  );
}

export default function HealthPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const toastRef = useRef(toast);
  const inFlight = useRef(false);

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);
  const [rateLimited, setRateLimited] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    toastRef.current = toast;
  }, [toast]);

  const load = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    if (!silent) setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await getDetailedHealth();
      const payload = unwrapHealth(res);

      if (isUsablePayload(payload)) {
        setData(payload);
        setLastUpdated(new Date());
        setRateLimited(false);
        setErrorMsg(null);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setErrorMsg('Health endpoint returned an empty or unexpected payload.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // normalizeError flattens the axios error â€” use err.status, not err.response.status
      const status = err?.status ?? err?.response?.status;
      if (status === 429) {
        setRateLimited(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Failed to load health');
        toastRef.current.error(err?.message || 'Failed to load health');
      }
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (!silent) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const t = setInterval(() => load(true), REFRESH_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [load]);

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {rateLimited
            ? 'Rate limited â€” retrying automatically.'
            : errorMsg || 'Health data unavailable.'}
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => load()}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const s = data.server || {};
  const cpu = s.cpu || {};
  const mem = s.memory || {};
  const dbx = data.database || {};
  const redis = data.redis || {};
  const cloud = data.cloudinary || {};
  const lk = data.livekit || {};
  const bridge = data.hdmBridge || {};
  const ai = data.hdmAi || {};
  const queues = data.queues || { queues: [] };
  const counts = data.data || {};
  const activity = data.activity || {};
  const overall = data.overall || { up: 0, total: 0 };
  const isHealthy = data.status === 'healthy';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
              System Health
            </h1>
            <Badge color={isHealthy ? 'green' : 'yellow'}>
              {data.status || 'unknown'}
            </Badge>
            <Badge color="blue">
              {overall.up}/{overall.total} services
            </Badge>
            {rateLimited && <Badge color="yellow">rate limited</Badge>}
          </div>
          {lastUpdated && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Updated {lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString()} Â· auto-refresh 30s
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => load()}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] hover:bg-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <HiRefresh className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Server card */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--bg-primary)] rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)] p-5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiPlus, HiScale, HiArrowRight } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import { getLegalDocs, createLegalDoc } from '../../services/tvetgrid/legal';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';

export default function Legal() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [docs, setDocs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState('');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');

  const load = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getLegalDocs()
      .then((res) => {
        const data = res?.data || res;
        setDocs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      })
      .catch((err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load'))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!slug.trim() || !title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Slug and title are required');
      return;
    }
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await createLegalDoc({
        slug: slug.trim(),
        title: title.trim(),
        bodyMd: '# ' + title.trim(),
        isPublished: false,
      });
      toast.success('Legal doc created');
      setCreateOpen(false);
      setSlug('');
      setTitle('');
      navigate(`/tvetgrid/legal/${slug.trim()}`);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create');
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Legal
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {docs.length} document{docs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => {
            setSlug('');
            setTitle('');
            setCreateOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          New document
        </Button>
      </div>

      {docs.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <div className="text-center py-12">
            <HiScale className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-3" />
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
              No legal documents yet
            </p>
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {docs.map((d) => (
            <Card key={d.slug}>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                    <h3 className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                      {d.title}
                    </h3>
                    <Badge variant={d.isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
                      {d.isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                    /{d.slug} Â· v{d.version}
                  </p>
                  {d.updatedAt && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                      Updated {formatDate(d.updatedAt)}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  icon={<HiArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/tvetgrid/legal/${d.slug}`)}
                >
                  Edit
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <Modal
        open={createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        title="New legal document"
        size="sm"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCreate} loading={creating}>
              Create
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Slug *"
            value={slug}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setSlug(e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'))
            }
            placeholder="terms"
            hint="Used in URLs and as a stable identifier"
          />
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Terms of Service"
          />
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiSave, HiUpload, HiEye } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getLegalDoc,
  updateLegalDoc,
  publishLegalDoc,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/legal';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';

export default function LegalDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [doc, setDoc] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [bodyMd, setBodyMd] = useState('');
  const [effectiveAt, setEffectiveAt] = useState('');
  const [isPublished, setIsPublished] = useState(false);

  const [confirmPublish, setConfirmPublish] = useState(false);
  const [publishing, setPublishing] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getLegalDoc(slug);
      const d = res?.data || res;
      setDoc(d);
      setTitle(d.title || '');
      setBodyMd(d.bodyMd || '');
      setEffectiveAt(
        d.effectiveAt ? d.effectiveAt.slice(0, 16) : ''
      );
      setIsPublished(!!d.isPublished);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/legal');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [slug]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateLegalDoc(slug, {
        title: title.trim(),
        bodyMd,
        effectiveAt: effectiveAt || undefined,
        isPublished,
      });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setDoc(updated);
      toast.success('Saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePublish = async () => {
    setPublishing(true);
    try {
      const res = await publishLegalDoc(slug);
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) {
        setDoc(updated);
        setIsPublished(true);
      }
      toast.success('Published');
      setConfirmPublish(false);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to publish');
    } finally {
      setPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!doc) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/legal')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {doc.title}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1 font-mono">
            /{slug} Â· v{doc.version}
          </p>
          {doc.updatedAt && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Updated {formatDate(doc.updatedAt, 'full')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge variant={isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
            {isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
          </Badge>
          {!isPublished && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="success"
              icon={<HiUpload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              onClick={() => setConfirmPublish(true)}
            >
              Publish
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card title="Content">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title"
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          />
          <Input
            label="Effective date"
            type="datetime-local"
            value={effectiveAt}
            onChange={(e) => setEffectiveAt(e.target.value)}
            hint="Optional â€” when this version becomes effective"
          />
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Body (Markdown)
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={bodyMd}
              onChange={(e) => setBodyMd(e.target.value)}
              rows={20}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm font-mono"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={handleSave}
              loading={saving}
            >
              Save changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {doc.bodyMd && (
        <Card
          title="Preview"
          actions={
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] flex items-center gap-1">
              <HiEye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Rendered as text (not markdown)
            </span>
          }
        >
          <div className="text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)] whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] p-4 rounded-lg max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {doc.bodyMd}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmPublish}
        onClose={() => setConfirmPublish(false)}
        onConfirm={handlePublish}
        title="Publish document"
        message={`Publish "${doc.title}"? A new version (v${(doc.version || 1) + 1}) will be created and become public immediately.`}
        confirmLabel="Publish"
        variant="success"
        loading={publishing}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
