import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiSave,
  HiVideoCamera,
  HiUpload,
  HiSparkles,
  HiTrash,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getLesson,
  updateLesson,
  deleteLesson,
  requestUploadSignature,
  summarizeLesson,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/lessons';
import { getCourses } from '../../services/tvetgrid/courses';
import { getSubjectsForCourse } from '../../services/tvetgrid/subjects';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';

export default function LessonDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const fileRef = useRef(null);

  const [lesson, setLesson] = useState(null);
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState('');
  const [subjectId, setSubjectId] = useState('');
  const [order, setOrder] = useState(0);
  const [isPublished, setIsPublished] = useState(false);

  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [summarizing, setSummarizing] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [coursesRes, lessonRes] = await Promise.all([
        getCourses({ limit: 100 }).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
        getLesson(id),
      ]);

      setCourses(coursesRes?.data || []);

      const l = lessonRes?.data || lessonRes;
      setLesson(l);
      setTitle(l.title || '');
      setCourseId(l.courseId || '');
      setSubjectId(l.subjectId || '');
      setOrder(l.order ?? 0);
      setIsPublished(!!l.isPublished);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load lesson');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/lessons');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!courseId) {
      setSubjects([]);
      return;
    }
    getSubjectsForCourse(courseId)
      .then((res) => setSubjects(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch(() => setSubjects([]));
  }, [courseId]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    if (!courseId) {
      toast.error('Course is required');
      return;
    }
    if (!subjectId) {
      toast.error('Subject is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateLesson(id, {
        title: title.trim(),
        courseId,
        subjectId,
        order: Number(order) || 0,
        isPublished,
      });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setLesson(updated);
      toast.success('Lesson saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUploadVideo = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.size > 500 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error('Max video size is 500 MB');
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    setUploadProgress(0);

    try {
      const sigRes = await requestUploadSignature({ resourceType: 'video' });
      const sig = sigRes?.data || sigRes;

      if (!sig?.signature || !sig?.uploadUrl) {
        throw new Error('Invalid upload signature response');
      }

      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('file', file);
      form.append('api_key', sig.apiKey);
      form.append('timestamp', sig.timestamp);
      form.append('signature', sig.signature);
      form.append('folder', sig.folder);

      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open('POST', sig.uploadUrl);

      xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev) => {
        if (ev.lengthComputable) {
          setUploadProgress(Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100));
        }
      };

      const cloudRes = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        xhr.onload = () => {
          if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            try {
              resolve(JSON.parse(xhr.responseText));
            } catch {
              reject(new Error('Invalid response from Cloudinary'));
            }
          } else {
            reject(new Error(`Upload failed (${xhr.status})`));
          }
        };
        xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Upload network error'));
        xhr.send(form);
      });

      const video = {
        publicId: cloudRes.public_id,
        url: cloudRes.secure_url,
        duration: cloudRes.duration || null,
        format: cloudRes.format || 'mp4',
      };
      const res = await updateLesson(id, { video });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setLesson(updated);
      toast.success('Video uploaded');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setUploadProgress(0);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleSummarize = async () => {
    setSummarizing(true);
    try {
      const res = await summarizeLesson(id);
      const data = res?.data || res;
      toast.success(
        data?.jobId
          ? `AI summary queued (job ${data.jobId})`
          : 'AI summary queued'
      );
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to queue summary');
    } finally {
      setSummarizing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await deleteLesson(id);
      toast.success('Lesson deleted');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/lessons');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!lesson) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-3xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/lessons')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {lesson.title || 'Lesson'}
          </h1>
          {lesson.createdAt && (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Created {formatDate(lesson.createdAt, 'full')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Badge variant={isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
          {isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <Card title="Details">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Select
              label="Course *"
              value={courseId}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCourseId(e.target.value);
                setSubjectId('');
              }}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: 'Select a course...' },
                ...courses.map((c) => ({
                  value: c._id || c.id,
                  label: c.title,
                })),
              ]}
            />
            <Select
              label="Subject *"
              value={subjectId}
              onChange={(e) => setSubjectId(e.target.value)}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: 'Select subject...' },
                ...subjects.map((s) => ({
                  value: s._id || s.id,
                  label: s.name,
                })),
              ]}
              disabled={!courseId}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Order"
              type="number"
              value={order}
              onChange={(e) => setOrder(e.target.value)}
            />
            <div className="pt-6">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={isPublished}
                  onChange={(e) => setIsPublished(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-[var(--border-color)] text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
                Published
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={handleSave}
              loading={saving}
            >
              Save changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Video">
        {lesson?.video?.url ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-black">
              <video
                src={lesson.video.url}
                controls
                className="w-full max-h-96"
                preload="metadata"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                {lesson.video.format?.toUpperCase()}
                {lesson.video.duration
                  ? ` Â· ${Math.round(lesson.video.duration / 60)} min`
                  : ''}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  icon={<HiUpload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
                  disabled={uploading}
                >
                  {uploading ? 'Uploadingâ€¦' : 'Replace video'}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="secondary"
                  icon={<HiSparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  onClick={handleSummarize}
                  loading={summarizing}
                >
                  AI Summarize
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-8">
            <HiVideoCamera className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-3" />
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">

    getCourses({ limit: 100 })

      setSubjects([]);

      .catch(() => setSubjects([]));

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\tvetgrid\Login.jsx =====
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Link, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HiArrowLeft, HiAcademicCap } from 'react-icons/hi';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/tvetgrid/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';

export default function Login() {
  const { login, status } = useAuth();
  const toast = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/tvetgrid';

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (status === 'idle' || status === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-primary)] flex items-center justify-center">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === 'authenticated') {
    return <Navigate to={from} replace />;
  }

  const onSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      toast.success('Welcome back');
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
      <Link
        to="/"
        className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-colors"
      >
        <HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Return Home
      </Link>

      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-blue-600 text-white mb-4">
            <HiAcademicCap className="w-8 h-8" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            TVETGrid
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mt-1">
            Admin access only
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4 text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="admin@tvetgrid.co.ke"
            autoComplete="email"
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          <Button type="submit" fullWidth size="lg" loading={submitting}>
            Sign In
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] text-center mt-6">
          Admin-only access. Students and teachers use the mobile app.
        </p>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

      getMeeting(id).catch((err) => {

      }),

    ])

          navigate('/tvetgrid/meetings');

        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);

              {row.phone}
            </p>
          )}

      ),

      key: 'rsvp',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge
          variant={
            row.rsvp === 'attended'
              ? 'success'
              : row.rsvp === 'absent'
              ? 'danger'
              : 'info'
          }
          dot
        >
          {statusLabel(row.rsvp)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },

} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getNote,
  updateNote,

  deleteNote,
  generateQuestions,
  requestUploadSignature,
  confirmUpload,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/notes';
import {
  uploadToCloudinary,
  NOTE_ALLOWED_TYPES,
  NOTE_MAX_FILE_SIZE,
  NOTE_MAX_FILES,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/upload';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';

const ACCEPT =
  '.pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,.docx,application/pdf,image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes) return 'â€”';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1048576) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function fileIcon(mime) {
  if (!mime) return 'ðŸ“„';
  if (mime.startsWith('image/')) return 'ðŸ–¼ï¸';
  if (mime.includes('pdf')) return 'ðŸ“•';
  if (mime.includes('word')) return 'ðŸ“˜';
  return 'ðŸ“„';
}

export default function NoteDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [note, setNote] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState('public');
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([]);
  const [filesDirty, setFilesDirty] = useState(false);

  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState({});

  const [genOpen, setGenOpen] = useState(false);
  const [genCount, setGenCount] = useState(5);
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);

  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getNote(id);
      const n = res?.data || res;
      setNote(n);
      setTitle(n.title || '');
      setDescription(n.description || '');
      setVisibility(n.visibility || 'public');
      setFiles(n.files || []);
      setFilesDirty(false);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load note');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/notes');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!title.trim()) {
      toast.error('Title is required');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await updateNote(id, {
        title: title.trim(),
        description: description.trim(),
        visibility,
      });

      if (filesDirty) {
        await replaceNoteFiles(id, files);
      }

      toast.success('Note saved');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddFiles = async (e) => {
    const picked = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    e.target.value = '';
    if (picked.length === 0) return;

    if (files.length + picked.length > NOTE_MAX_FILES) {
      toast.error(`Max ${NOTE_MAX_FILES} files per note`);
      return;
    }

    for (const file of picked) {
      if (file.size > NOTE_MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        toast.error(`${file.name}: max 10 MB`);
        continue;
      }
      if (!NOTE_ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
        toast.error(`${file.name}: unsupported file type`);
        continue;
      }

      const tempId = `${Date.now()}-${file.name}`;
      setUploadProgress((p) => ({ ...p, [tempId]: 0 }));
      setUploading(true);

      try {
        const sigRes = await requestUploadSignature({});
        const sig = sigRes?.data || sigRes;

        const cloudRes = await uploadToCloudinary(file, sig, (pct) => {
          setUploadProgress((p) => ({ ...p, [tempId]: pct }));
        });

        const confirmRes = await confirmUpload({
          publicId: cloudRes.public_id,
          resourceType: cloudRes.resource_type || 'auto',
        });
        const confirmed = confirmRes?.data || confirmRes;

        const rec = {
          publicId: confirmed.publicId || cloudRes.public_id,
          url: confirmed.url || cloudRes.secure_url,
          fileName: file.name,
          size: confirmed.bytes || cloudRes.bytes,
          mimeType: file.type,
          resourceType: confirmed.resourceType || cloudRes.resource_type || 'auto',
        };

        setFiles((prev) => [...prev, rec]);
        setFilesDirty(true);
      } catch (err) {
        toast.error(`${file.name}: ${err.message || 'upload failed'}`);
      } finally {
        setUploadProgress((p) => {
          const n = { ...p };
          delete n[tempId];
          return n;
        });
        setUploading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const removeFile = (idx) => {
    setFiles((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
    setFilesDirty(true);
  };

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setGenerating(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateQuestions(id, genCount);
      const data = res?.data || res;
      toast.success(
        data?.jobId
          ? `Question generation queued (job ${data.jobId})`
          : 'Question generation queued'
      );
      setGenOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to queue');
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await deleteNote(id);
      toast.success('Note deleted');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/notes');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!note) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/notes')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {note.title}
          </h1>
          {note.createdAt && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Created {formatDate(note.createdAt, 'full')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Badge variant={note.visibility === 'public' ? 'info' : 'default'}>
          {note.visibility || 'public'}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <Card title="Details">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          />
          <Input
            label="Description"
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
            hint="Optional short description"
          />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                Course
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <HiLockClosed className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {note.courseId?.title || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                Subject
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <HiLockClosed className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {note.subjectId?.name || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] -mt-2">
            Course and subject cannot be changed after creation.
          </p>

          <Select
            label="Visibility"
            value={visibility}
            onChange={(e) => setVisibility(e.target.value)}
            options={NOTE_VISIBILITY_LIST}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card
        title={`Files (${files.length}/${NOTE_MAX_FILES})`}
        actions={
          <label
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] ${
              files.length >= NOTE_MAX_FILES || uploading
                ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
                : ''
            }`}
          >
            <HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add file
            <input
              type="file"
              multiple
              accept={ACCEPT}
              onChange={handleAddFiles}
              className="hidden"
              disabled={files.length >= NOTE_MAX_FILES || uploading}
            />
          </label>
        }
        padding={false}
      >
        {files.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-8 text-center">
            No files yet. Add at least one.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
            {files.map((f, i) => (
              <li
                key={f.publicId || i}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="text-xl shrink-0">{fileIcon(f.mimeType)}</span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                      {f.fileName}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                      {formatBytes(f.size)} Â· {f.mimeType}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <a
                    href={f.url}
                    target="_blank"

                    className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
                    title="Open"
                  >
                    <HiExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </a>
                  <a
                    href={f.url}
                    download={f.fileName}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"

                    <HiDownload className="w-4 h-4" />

                  <button

        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={deleting}
      />

            navigate(`/tvetgrid/notes/${row._id || row.id}`);
          }}
        >
          View
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Notes
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            {meta.total} note{meta.total !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => {
            setForm({
              title: '',
              description: '',
              courseId: courseId || '',
              subjectId: '',
              visibility: 'public',
              files: [],
            });
            setFormSubjects([]);
            setUploadProgress({});
            setCreateOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          New note
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <SearchBar
            value={search}
            onChange={(v) => {
              setSearch(v);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            placeholder="Search notes..."
          />
          <Select
            value={courseId}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setCourseId(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: 'All courses' },
              ...courses.map((c) => ({
                value: c._id || c.id,
                label: c.title,
              })),
            ]}
          />
          <Select
            value={subjectId}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSubjectId(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            options={[
              { value: '', label: 'All subjects' },
              ...subjects.map((s) => ({
                value: s._id || s.id,
                label: s.name,
              })),
            ]}
            disabled={!courseId}
          />
          <Select
            value={visibility}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setVisibility(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            options={VISIBILITY_FILTERS}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={items}
            loading={loading}
            rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
            onRowClick={(row) => navigate(`/tvetgrid/notes/${row._id || row.id}`)}
            emptyMessage="No notes yet"
          />
          <Pagination
            page={meta.page}
            totalPages={meta.pages}
            onPageChange={setPage}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        open={createOpen}
        onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
        title="New note"
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
              disabled={creating || uploading}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleCreate} loading={creating} disabled={uploading}>
              Create
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Title *"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Ohm Law Cheatsheet"
          />
          <Input
            label="Description"
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Quick reference"
            hint="Optional short description"
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Select
              label="Course *"
              value={form.courseId}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({ ...form, courseId: e.target.value, subjectId: '' })
              }
              options={[
                { value: '', label: 'Select...' },
                ...courses.map((c) => ({
                  value: c._id || c.id,
                  label: c.title,
                })),
              ]}
            />
            <Select
              label="Subject *"
              value={form.subjectId}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subjectId: e.target.value })}
              options={[
                { value: '', label: 'Select...' },
                ...formSubjects.map((s) => ({
                  value: s._id || s.id,
                  label: s.name,
                })),
              ]}
              disabled={!form.courseId}
            />
          </div>
          <Select
            label="Visibility"
            value={form.visibility}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, visibility: e.target.value })}
            options={NOTE_VISIBILITY_LIST}
          />

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Files * ({form.files.length}/{NOTE_MAX_FILES})
            </label>

            {form.files.length > 0 && (
              <ul className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                {form.files.map((f, i) => (
                  <li
                    key={i}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-sm"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                        {f.fileName}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                        {formatBytes(f.size)} Â· {f.mimeType}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => removeFile(i)}
                      className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 text-red-600"
                      aria-label="Remove"
                    >
                      <HiX className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}

            {Object.entries(uploadProgress).map(([id, pct]) => (
              <div key={id} className="mb-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1">
                  <span className="truncate">{id.split('-').slice(1).join('-')}</span>
                  <span>{pct}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-full h-1.5">
                  <div
                    className="bg-indigo-600 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all"
                    style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            <label
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] ${
                form.files.length >= NOTE_MAX_FILES || uploading
                  ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
                  : ''
              }`}
            >
              <HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
              Add file
              <input
                type="file"
                multiple
                accept={ACCEPT}
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                className="hidden"
                disabled={form.files.length >= NOTE_MAX_FILES || uploading}
              />
            </label>
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-2">
              PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, DOCX Â· max 10 MB per file Â· up to 5 files
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\tvetgrid\PaperDetail.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiSave,
  HiPlus,
  HiTrash,
  HiChevronUp,
  HiChevronDown,
  HiLockClosed,
  HiExternalLink,
  HiX,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/ConfirmDialog';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getPaper,
  updatePaper,
  updatePaperQuestions,
  replacePaperPdf,
  deletePaper,
  requestUploadSignature,
  confirmUpload,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/papers';
import {
  uploadToCloudinary,
  PAPER_MAX_FILE_SIZE,
  PAPER_ALLOWED_TYPES,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/upload';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';
import { DIFFICULTY } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/constants';

const EMPTY_Q = {
  qid: '',
  order: 0,
  stem: '',
  options: ['', '', '', ''],
  answer: '',
  solution: '',
  subjectId: '',
  difficulty: 'medium',
  linkedLessonId: '',
  linkedVideoTs: null,
  marks: 1,
};

const ACCEPT = '.pdf,application/pdf';

function formatBytes(b) {
  if (!b) return 'â€”';
  if (b < 1024) return `${b} B`;
  if (b < 1048576) return `${(b / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(b / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

export default function PaperDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [paper, setPaper] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [year, setYear] = useState('');
  const [paperNo, setPaperNo] = useState('');
  const [durationMin, setDurationMin] = useState('');
  const [isPublished, setIsPublished] = useState(false);

  const [sourcePdf, setSourcePdf] = useState(null);
  const [pdfDirty, setPdfDirty] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingPdf, setUploadingPdf] = useState(false);
  const [pdfPct, setPdfPct] = useState(null);

  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [qModal, setQModal] = useState({ open: false, mode: 'create', index: -1 });
  const [qForm, setQForm] = useState(EMPTY_Q);
  const [savingQ, setSavingQ] = useState(false);
  const [confirmDeleteQ, setConfirmDeleteQ] = useState({ open: false, index: -1 });

  const [confirmDeletePaper, setConfirmDeletePaper] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getPaper(id);
      const p = res?.data || res;
      setPaper(p);
      setYear(p.year || '');
      setPaperNo(p.paperNo || '');
      setDurationMin(p.durationMin || '');
      setIsPublished(!!p.isPublished);
      setQuestions(Array.isArray(p.questions) ? p.questions : []);
      setSourcePdf(p.sourcePdf || null);
      setPdfDirty(false);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load paper');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/papers');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const handleSavePaper = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await updatePaper(id, {
        year: year ? Number(year) : undefined,
        paperNo: paperNo ? Number(paperNo) : undefined,
        durationMin: durationMin ? Number(durationMin) : undefined,
        isPublished,
      });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setPaper((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));

      if (pdfDirty && sourcePdf?.url) {
        const pdfRes = await replacePaperPdf(id, {
          publicId: sourcePdf.publicId,
          url: sourcePdf.url,
          fileName: sourcePdf.fileName || null,
          size: sourcePdf.size || null,
          mimeType: sourcePdf.mimeType || 'application/pdf',
        });
        const pdfUpdated = pdfRes?.data || pdfRes;
        if (pdfUpdated) setPaper((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...pdfUpdated }));
        setPdfDirty(false);
      }

      toast.success('Paper saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePickPdf = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.size > PAPER_MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      toast.error(`Max ${formatBytes(PAPER_MAX_FILE_SIZE)}`);
      return;
    }
    if (!PAPER_ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      toast.error('Only PDF files allowed');
      return;
    }

    setUploadingPdf(true);
    setPdfPct(0);
    try {
      const sigRes = await requestUploadSignature({});
      const sig = sigRes?.data || sigRes;

      const cloud = await uploadToCloudinary(file, sig, setPdfPct);

      const confirmRes = await confirmUpload({
        publicId: cloud.public_id,
        resourceType: cloud.resource_type || 'raw',
      });
      const confirmed = confirmRes?.data || confirmRes;

      setSourcePdf({
        publicId: confirmed.publicId || cloud.public_id,
        url: confirmed.url || cloud.secure_url,
        fileName: file.name,
        size: confirmed.bytes || cloud.bytes,
        mimeType: confirmed.mimeType || file.type || 'application/pdf',
      });
      setPdfDirty(true);
      toast.success('New PDF ready â€” click Save details to apply');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Upload failed');
    } finally {
      setUploadingPdf(false);
      setPdfPct(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveQuestions = async (nextQuestions) => {
    try {
      const res = await updatePaperQuestions(id, nextQuestions);
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setPaper((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
      toast.success('Questions saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save questions');
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const openCreateQ = () => {
    setQForm({ ...EMPTY_Q, order: questions.length + 1 });
    setQModal({ open: true, mode: 'create', index: -1 });
  };

  const openEditQ = (index) => {
    const q = questions[index];
    setQForm({
      ...EMPTY_Q,
      ...q,
      options: [...(q.options || ['', '', '', ''])].slice(0, 4),
      subjectId: q.subjectId || '',
    });
    setQModal({ open: true, mode: 'edit', index });
  };

  const patchQ = (key, value) => setQForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  const patchOption = (i, value) => {
    const next = [...qForm.options];
    next[i] = value;
    setQForm({ ...qForm, options: next });
  };

  const handleSaveQ = async () => {
    if (!qForm.stem.trim()) return toast.error('Question text is required');
    if (!qForm.answer.trim()) return toast.error('Answer is required');
    setSavingQ(true);
    try {
      const nextQ = {
        qid: qForm.qid || `q${Date.now()}`,
        order: Number(qForm.order) || questions.length + 1,
        stem: qForm.stem.trim(),
        options: qForm.options.filter((o) => o.trim()),
        answer: qForm.answer.trim(),
        solution: qForm.solution.trim() || undefined,
        subjectId: qForm.subjectId || undefined,
        difficulty: qForm.difficulty,
        marks: Number(qForm.marks) || 1,
      };

      const list = [...questions];
      if (qModal.mode === 'create') list.push(nextQ);
      else list[qModal.index] = nextQ;

      await handleSaveQuestions(list);
      setQuestions(list);
      setQModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', index: -1 });
    } catch {
      /* toast already shown */
    } finally {
      setSavingQ(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteQ = async () => {
    const list = questions.filter((_, i) => i !== confirmDeleteQ.index);
    try {
      await handleSaveQuestions(list);
      setQuestions(list);
      setConfirmDeleteQ({ open: false, index: -1 });
    } catch {
      /* toast already shown */
    }
  };

  const moveQ = async (index, dir) => {
    const swap = index + dir;
    if (swap < 0 || swap >= questions.length) return;
    const list = [...questions];
    [list[index], list[swap]] = [list[swap], list[index]];
    list.forEach((q, i) => (q.order = i + 1));
    try {
      await handleSaveQuestions(list);
      setQuestions(list);
    } catch {
      /* toast already shown */
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePaper = async () => {
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await deletePaper(id);
      toast.success('Paper deleted');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/papers');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to delete');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!paper) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/papers')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {year} {paperNo ? `Â· Paper ${paperNo}` : ''}
          </h1>
          {paper.createdAt && (
            <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
              Created {formatDate(paper.createdAt, 'full')}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Badge variant={isPublished ? 'success' : 'default'} dot>
          {isPublished ? 'Published' : 'Draft'}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <Card title="Paper details">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                Course
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <HiLockClosed className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {paper.courseId?.title || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                Subject
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                <HiLockClosed className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {paper.subjectId?.name || 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] -mt-2">
            Course and subject cannot be changed after creation.
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Year"
              type="number"
              value={year}
              onChange={(e) => setYear(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Paper number"
              type="number"
              value={paperNo}
              onChange={(e) => setPaperNo(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Duration (min)"
              type="number"
              value={durationMin}
              onChange={(e) => setDurationMin(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Total marks"
              value={paper.totalMarks ?? 0}
              disabled
              hint="Auto-computed"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isPublished}
                onChange={(e) => setIsPublished(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-[var(--border-color)] text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
              Published
            </label>
            <Button
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              onClick={handleSavePaper}
              loading={saving}
              disabled={uploadingPdf}
            >
              Save details
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card
        title="Source PDF"
        actions={
          sourcePdf ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <a
                href={sourcePdf.url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-[var(--sidebar-hover)] text-[var(--text-secondary)]"
                title="Open"
              >
                <HiExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
              </a>
              <label
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] ${
                  uploadingPdf ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''
                }`}
              >
                <HiX className="w-4 h-4 rotate-45" />
                Replace
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept={ACCEPT}
                  onChange={handlePickPdf}
                  className="hidden"
                  disabled={uploadingPdf}
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <label
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] ${
                uploadingPdf ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
              Upload PDF
              <input
                type="file"
                accept={ACCEPT}
                onChange={handlePickPdf}
                className="hidden"
                disabled={uploadingPdf}
              />
            </label>
          )
        }
        padding={false}
      >
        <div className="px-4 py-3">
          {!sourcePdf ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4">
              No PDF attached.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
                  {sourcePdf.fileName || 'source.pdf'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                  {formatBytes(sourcePdf.size)} Â· {sourcePdf.mimeType || 'application/pdf'}
                  {pdfDirty && ' Â· unsaved'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {pdfPct !== null && (
            <div className="mt-2">
              <div className="w-full bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded-full h-1.5">
                <div
                  className="bg-indigo-600 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all"
                  style={{ width: `${pdfPct}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card
        title={`Questions (${questions.length})`}
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={openCreateQ}>
            Add question
          </Button>
        }
        padding={false}
      >
        {questions.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-12 text-center">
            No questions yet. Add the first one.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-[var(--border-color)]">
            {questions.map((q, i) => (

                            opt === q.answer
                              ? 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 font-medium'
                              : ''
                          }

                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => moveQ(i, -1)} disabled={i === 0}>
                      <HiChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => moveQ(i, 1)} disabled={i === questions.length - 1}>
                      <HiChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => openEditQ(i)}>
                      Edit
                    </Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteQ({ open: true, index: i })}>
                      <HiTrash className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>

      <div className="flex justify-end pt-2 border-t border-[var(--border-color)]">
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => setConfirmDeletePaper(true)}
        >
          Delete paper
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Modal
        open={qModal.open}
        onClose={() => setQModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', index: -1 })}
        title={qModal.mode === 'create' ? 'Add question' : 'Edit question'}
        size="lg"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setQModal({ open: false, mode: 'create', index: -1 })}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSaveQ} loading={savingQ}>
              Save question
            </Button>
          </>

            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Question text *
            </label>
            <textarea
              value={qForm.stem}
              onChange={(e) => patchQ('stem', e.target.value)}
              rows={2}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm"
              placeholder="What is the SI unit of voltage?"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
              Options
            </label>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <Input
                  key={i}
                  value={qForm.options[i] || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => patchOption(i, e.target.value)}
                  placeholder={`Option ${String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}`}
                />
              ))}

            label="Answer *"

            />
          </div>

            label="Subject override (optional)"
            value={qForm.subjectId || ''}
            onChange={(e) => patchQ('subjectId', e.target.value)}
            options={[

              ...(paper.subjectId
                ? [{ value: paper.subjectId._id || paper.subjectId, label: paper.subjectId.name || 'Subject' }]
                : []),
            ]}
            hint="Rarely needed â€” leaves the question tied to the paper's subject by default."
          />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Select
              label="Difficulty"
              value={qForm.difficulty}
              onChange={(e) => patchQ('difficulty', e.target.value)}
              options={DIFFICULTY}
            />
            <Input
              label="Marks"
              type="number"
              min="1"
              value={qForm.marks}
              onChange={(e) => patchQ('marks', e.target.value)}
            />
            <Input
              label="Order"
              type="number"
              value={qForm.order}
              onChange={(e) => patchQ('order', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDeleteQ.open}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDeleteQ({ open: false, index: -1 })}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteQ}
        title="Delete question"
        message="Delete this question from the paper?"
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
      />

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={confirmDeletePaper}
        onClose={() => setConfirmDeletePaper(false)}
        onConfirm={handleDeletePaper}
        title="Delete paper"
        message={`Delete this ${paper.year} paper? This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        variant="danger"
        loading={deleting}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

const PUBLISHED_FILTERS = [
  { value: '', label: 'All' },
  { value: 'true', label: 'Published' },
  { value: 'false', label: 'Draft' },
];

const ACCEPT = '.pdf,application/pdf';

function formatBytes(b) {
  if (!b) return 'â€”';
  if (b < 1024) return `${b} B`;
  if (b < 1048576) return `${(b / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(b / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function buildTitle({ subject, year, paperNo }) {
  return [subject?.trim(), year, paperNo ? `Paper ${paperNo}` : null]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' Â· ');
}

export default function Papers() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  const [courses, setCourses] = useState([]);
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState(params.get('courseId') || '');
  const [published, setPublished] = useState('');
  const [year, setYear] = useState('');

  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState([]);
  const [subjectId, setSubjectId] = useState(params.get('subjectId') || '');

  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    courseId: params.get('courseId') || '',
    subjectId: '',
    subject: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    paperNo: 1,
    durationMin: 120,
    isPublished: false,
    sourcePdf: null,
  });
  const [formSubjects, setFormSubjects] = useState([]);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadPct, setUploadPct] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    getCourses({ limit: 100 })
      .then((res) => setCourses(res?.data || []))
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!courseId) {
      setSubjects([]);
      setSubjectId('');
      return;
    }
    getSubjectsForCourse(courseId)
      .then((res) => setSubjects(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch(() => setSubjects([]));
  }, [courseId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!form.courseId) {
      setFormSubjects([]);
      return;
    }
    getSubjectsForCourse(form.courseId)
      .then((res) => setFormSubjects(res?.data || res || []))
      .catch(() => setFormSubjects([]));
  }, [form.courseId]);

  const load = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    getPapers({
      page,
      limit: 20,
      courseId: courseId || undefined,
      subjectId: subjectId || undefined,
      published: published || undefined,
      year: year || undefined,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        setItems(res?.data || []);
        setMeta(res?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })

  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [page, courseId, subjectId, published, year]);

  const handlePickPdf = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.size > PAPER_MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      toast.error(`Max ${formatBytes(PAPER_MAX_FILE_SIZE)} for paper PDFs`);
      return;

    if (!PAPER_ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {

        isPublished: form.isPublished,
        sourcePdf: {

          url: form.sourcePdf.url,
          fileName: form.sourcePdf.fileName || null,
          size: form.sourcePdf.size || null,
          mimeType: form.sourcePdf.mimeType || 'application/pdf',
        },
      });

            </p>

    },
    {

      render: (row) => (

  const [confirmPw, setConfirmPw] = useState('');
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false);

  const name = user?.name || user?.fullName || 'Admin';
  const email = user?.email || '';
  const role = user?.role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : user?.role || 'Admin';

  const handleChangePassword = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!currentPw || !newPw || !confirmPw) {
      toast.error('All fields are required');
      return;
    }
    if (newPw !== confirmPw) {
      toast.error('New passwords do not match');
      return;
    }
    if (newPw.length < 8) {
      toast.error('Password must be at least 8 characters');
      return;
    }
    setSavingPw(true);
    try {
      await changePassword({
        currentPassword: currentPw,
        newPassword: newPw,
      });
      toast.success('Password changed â€” please log in again on other devices');
      setCurrentPw('');
      setNewPw('');
      setConfirmPw('');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'INVALID_PASSWORD') {
        toast.error('Current password is incorrect');
      } else {
        toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to change password');
      }
    } finally {
      setSavingPw(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          Profile
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
          Your admin account
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xl font-bold shrink-0">
            {initials(name) || 'A'}
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)] truncate">
              {name}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate">{email}</p>
            <Badge variant="warning" dot className="mt-1">
              {role}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Account details">
        <dl className="space-y-3 text-sm">
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiUser className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Name
            </dt>
            <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">{name}</dd>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiMail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Email
            </dt>
            <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">{email}</dd>
          </div>
          {user?.phone && (
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <HiPhone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Phone
              </dt>
              <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">{user.phone}</dd>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
            <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)] inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HiShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Role
            </dt>
            <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)] capitalize">{role}</dd>
          </div>
          {user?.lastLoginAt && (
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Last login</dt>
              <dd className="text-[var(--text-primary)]">
                {formatDateTime(user.lastLoginAt)}
              </dd>
            </div>
          )}
          {user?.permissions && (
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[var(--border-color)]">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2">
                Permissions
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {user.permissions.map((p) => (
                  <Badge key={p} variant="info">
                    {p}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </dl>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Change password">
        <form onSubmit={handleChangePassword} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Current password"
            type="password"
            value={currentPw}
            onChange={(e) => setCurrentPw(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="current-password"
          />
          <Input
            label="New password"
            type="password"
            hint="At least 8 characters"
            value={newPw}
            onChange={(e) => setNewPw(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="new-password"
          />
          <Input
            label="Confirm new password"
            type="password"
            value={confirmPw}
            onChange={(e) => setConfirmPw(e.target.value)}
            autoComplete="new-password"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
            Changing your password will sign you out on all other devices. You
            will receive a confirmation email.
          </p>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              type="submit"
              icon={<HiKey className="w-4 h-4" />}
              loading={savingPw}
            >
              Update password
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { HiSave, HiPlus, HiTrash } from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import {
  getSettings,
  updateSettings,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/settings';

const SOCIALS = ['facebook', 'twitter', 'instagram', 'tiktok', 'youtube'];

export default function Settings() {
  const toast = useToast();

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [appName, setAppName] = useState('');
  const [logoUrl, setLogoUrl] = useState('');
  const [supportEmail, setSupportEmail] = useState('');
  const [supportPhone, setSupportPhone] = useState('');
  const [contactAddress, setContactAddress] = useState('');
  const [social, setSocial] = useState({});
  const [faq, setFaq] = useState([]);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getSettings();
      const s = res?.data || res;
      setSettings(s);
      setAppName(s.appName || '');
      setLogoUrl(s.logoUrl || '');
      setSupportEmail(s.supportEmail || '');
      setSupportPhone(s.supportPhone || '');
      setContactAddress(s.contactAddress || '');
      setSocial(s.socialLinks || {});
      setFaq(Array.isArray(s.faq) ? s.faq : []);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load settings');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateSettings({
        appName: appName.trim(),
        logoUrl: logoUrl.trim(),
        supportEmail: supportEmail.trim(),
        supportPhone: supportPhone.trim(),
        contactAddress: contactAddress.trim(),
        socialLinks: social,
        faq,
      });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setSettings(updated);
      toast.success('Settings saved');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const addFaq = () => {
    setFaq([...faq, { q: '', a: '' }]);
  };

  const updateFaq = (i, key, value) => {
    const next = [...faq];
    next[i] = { ...next[i], [key]: value };
    setFaq(next);
  };

  const removeFaq = (i) => {
    setFaq(faq.filter((_, j) => j !== i));
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-3xl">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            Settings
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
            Platform configuration Â· changes reflect on the public site
            immediately
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={handleSave}
          loading={saving}
        >
          Save changes
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card title="General">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="App name"
            value={appName}
            onChange={(e) => setAppName(e.target.value)}
          />
          <Input
            label="Logo URL"
            value={logoUrl}
            onChange={(e) => setLogoUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="https://res.cloudinary.com/..."
          />
          {logoUrl && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <img
                src={logoUrl}
                alt="Logo preview"
                className="h-12 max-w-[160px] object-contain bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] p-1 rounded"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.target.style.display = 'none';
                }}
              />
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Preview</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Support">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Support email"
            type="email"
            value={supportEmail}
            onChange={(e) => setSupportEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="support@tvetgrid.co.ke"
          />
          <Input
            label="Support phone"
            value={supportPhone}
            onChange={(e) => setSupportPhone(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="+254700000000"
          />
          <Input
            label="Contact address"
            value={contactAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setContactAddress(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Nairobi, Kenya"
          />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Social links">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {SOCIALS.map((s) => (
            <Input
              key={s}
              label={s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)}
              value={social[s] || ''}
              onChange={(e) => setSocial({ ...social, [s]: e.target.value })}
              placeholder={`https://${s}.com/...`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card
        title="FAQ"
        actions={
          <Button size="sm" icon={<HiPlus className="w-4 h-4" />} onClick={addFaq}>
            Add FAQ
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {faq.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] py-4 text-center">
            No FAQ entries yet
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {faq.map((item, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-4 space-y-2"
              >
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">
                    #{i + 1}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeFaq(i)}
                    className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 text-red-600"
                  >
                    <HiTrash className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <Input
                  label="Question"
                  value={item.q || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFaq(i, 'q', e.target.value)}
                />
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-1">
                    Answer
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    value={item.a || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => updateFaq(i, 'a', e.target.value)}
                    rows={2}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border-color)] bg-[var(--input-bg)] text-[var(--text-primary)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 resize-y text-sm"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
