import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  HiArrowLeft,
  HiLockClosed,
  HiLockOpen,
  HiSave,
  HiShieldCheck,
  HiTrash,
  HiExclamation,
} from 'react-icons/hi';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import Input from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Input';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Modal from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Modal';
import Textarea from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Textarea';
import Spinner from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Spinner';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/tvetgrid/AuthContext';
import {
  getUser,
  updateUser,
  changeUserRole,
  disableUser,
  enableUser,
  permanentDeleteUser,
} from '../../services/tvetgrid/users';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';
import { USER_ROLE_LIST, statusLabel } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/constants';

export default function UserDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user: me } = useAuth();

  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [savingProfile, setSavingProfile] = useState(false);

  const [roleOpen, setRoleOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState('student');
  const [changingRole, setChangingRole] = useState(false);

  const [disableOpen, setDisableOpen] = useState(false);
  const [disableReason, setDisableReason] = useState('');

  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState('');
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  const meId = me?.id || me?._id;
  const isMe = meId && (meId === id || meId === user?._id || meId === user?.id);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await getUser(id);
      const u = res?.data || res;
      setUser(u);
      setName(u.name || '');
      setPhone(u.phone || '');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load user');
      navigate('/tvetgrid/users');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [id]);

  const handleSaveProfile = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast.error('Name is required');
      return;
    }
    setSavingProfile(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateUser(id, { name: name.trim(), phone: phone.trim() });
      const updated = res?.data || res;
      if (updated) setUser(updated);
      toast.success('Profile updated');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to save');
    } finally {
      setSavingProfile(false);
    }
  };

  const handleChangeRole = async () => {
    if (newRole === user.role) {
      setRoleOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    setChangingRole(true);
    try {
      await changeUserRole(id, newRole);
      toast.success(`Role changed to ${statusLabel(newRole)}`);
      setRoleOpen(false);
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'SELF_DEMOTE') {
        toast.error('You cannot change your own role');
      } else {
        toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to change role');
      }
    } finally {
      setChangingRole(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisable = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await disableUser(id, disableReason.trim() || undefined);
      toast.success('User disabled');
      setDisableOpen(false);
      setDisableReason('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.code === 'SELF_DISABLE') {
        toast.error('You cannot disable yourself');
      } else {
        toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to disable');
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEnable = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await enableUser(id);
      toast.success('User enabled');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to enable');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePermanentDelete = async () => {
    if (deleteConfirm !== user.email) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      const res = await permanentDeleteUser(id);
      const d = res?.data?.deleted || {};
      toast.success(
        `User deleted â€” ${d.attempts || 0} attempts, ${d.progress || 0} progress, ${d.invites || 0} invites, ${d.hostedMeetings || 0} meetings`
      );
      navigate('/tvetgrid/users');
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Delete failed');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Spinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!user) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-3xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          icon={<HiArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/tvetgrid/users')}
        >
          Back
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {user.name || 'User'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{user.email}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Badge
            variant={
              user.role === 'admin'
                ? 'warning'
                : user.role === 'teacher'
                ? 'info'
                : 'default'
            }
          >
            {statusLabel(user.role)}
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant={user.isActive ? 'success' : 'danger'} dot>
            {user.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
          </Badge>
          {isMe && <Badge variant="info">You</Badge>}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card title="Profile">
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveProfile} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Full name"
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          />
          <Input
            label="Email"
            value={user.email}
            disabled
            hint="Cannot be changed"
          />
          <Input
            label="Phone"
            value={phone}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="254712345678"
          />
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              type="submit"
              icon={<HiSave className="w-4 h-4" />}
              loading={savingProfile}
            >
              Save changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Access & permissions">
        <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-3 items-center">
            <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Role</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Badge
                variant={
                  user.role === 'admin'
                    ? 'warning'
                    : user.role === 'teacher'
                    ? 'info'
                    : 'default'
                }
              >
                {statusLabel(user.role)}
              </Badge>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                icon={<HiShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                onClick={() => {
                  setNewRole(user.role);
                  setRoleOpen(true);
                }}
                disabled={isMe}
                title={isMe ? 'Cannot change your own role' : undefined}
              >
                Change
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-3 items-center">
            <span className="text-[var(--text-secondary)]">Account</span>
            {user.isActive ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="warning"
                icon={<HiLockClosed className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                onClick={() => setDisableOpen(true)}
                disabled={busy || isMe}
                title={isMe ? 'Cannot disable yourself' : undefined}
              >
                Disable

                size="sm"
                variant="success"
                icon={<HiLockOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}

                loading={busy}

      {/* Change role modal */}
      <Modal
        open={roleOpen}
        onClose={() => setRoleOpen(false)}
        title="Change role"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRoleOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleChangeRole}
              loading={changingRole}
              disabled={newRole === user.role}
            >
              Change role
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">
          Change <strong>{user.name}</strong>'s role. This affects what they can access in the platform.
        </p>
        <Select
          label="New role"
          value={newRole}
          onChange={(e) => setNewRole(e.target.value)}
          options={USER_ROLE_LIST}
        />
      </Modal>

      {/* Disable user modal */}
      <Modal
        open={disableOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setDisableOpen(false);
          setDisableReason('');
        }}
        title="Disable user"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setDisableOpen(false);
                setDisableReason('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={handleDisable} loading={busy}>
              Disable
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-4">
          Disable <strong>{user.name}</strong>? They won't be able to log in until re-enabled.
          An email will be sent to them.
        </p>
        <Textarea
          label="Reason"
          hint="Optional, sent to the user by email"
          value={disableReason}
          onChange={(e) => setDisableReason(e.target.value)}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="e.g. Terms violation"
        />
      </Modal>

      {/* Permanent delete modal */}
      <Modal
        open={deleteOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setDeleteOpen(false);
          setDeleteConfirm('');
        }}
        title="Permanently delete user"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => {
                setDeleteOpen(false);
                setDeleteConfirm('');
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={handlePermanentDelete}
              disabled={deleteConfirm !== user.email}
              loading={deleting}
            >
              Delete Forever
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/30 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
            <p className="font-medium mb-1">This cannot be undone.</p>
            <p>The following will be permanently deleted:</p>
            <ul className="mt-2 ml-4 list-disc space-y-0.5">
              <li>Their account and login credentials</li>
              <li>All paper attempts and scores</li>
              <li>All revision progress</li>
              <li>All meeting invitations</li>
              {user.role === 'teacher' && (
                <li>All meetings they hosted and their invitations</li>
              )}
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] mb-2">
              Type <strong className="font-mono text-[var(--text-primary)]">{user.email}</strong> to confirm:
            </p>
            <Input
              value={deleteConfirm}
              onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={user.email}
              className="font-mono"
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\pages\tvetgrid\Users.jsx =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Card';
import Table from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Table';
import Badge from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Badge';
import Button from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Button';
import SearchBar from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/SearchBar';
import Select from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Select';
import Pagination from '../../components/tvetgrid/ui/Pagination';
import { useToast } from '../../context/tvetgrid/ToastContext';
import { getUsers } from '../../services/tvetgrid/users';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/formatDate';
import { USER_ROLE_LIST, statusLabel } from '../../utils/tvetgrid/constants';

const ROLE_OPTIONS = [{ value: '', label: 'All roles' }, ...USER_ROLE_LIST];

export default function Users() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    getUsers({
      page,
      limit: 20,
      q: search || undefined,
      role: role || undefined,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setItems(res?.data || []);
        setMeta(res?.meta || { page: 1, pages: 1, total: 0 });
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!cancelled) toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to load users');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [page, search, role]);

  const columns = [
    {
      key: 'name',
      label: 'User',
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <p className="font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]">
            {row.name || 'â€”'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{row.email}</p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'phone',
      label: 'Phone',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)]">
          {row.phone || 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'role',
      label: 'Role',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge
          variant={
            row.role === 'admin'
              ? 'warning'
              : row.role === 'teacher'
              ? 'info'
              : 'default'
          }
        >
          {statusLabel(row.role)}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'isActive',
      label: 'Status',
      render: (row) => (
        <Badge variant={row.isActive ? 'success' : 'danger'} dot>
          {row.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
        </Badge>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'emailVerified',
      label: 'Verified',
      render: (row) =>
        row.emailVerified ? (
          <Badge variant="success">Yes</Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge variant="warning">No</Badge>
        ),
    },
    {
      key: 'createdAt',
      label: 'Joined',
      render: (row) => (
        <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">
          {row.createdAt ? formatDate(row.createdAt) : 'â€”'}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      label: '',
      align: 'right',
      render: (row) => (
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            navigate(`/tvetgrid/users/${row._id}`);
          }}
        >
          View
        </Button>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]">
          Users
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
          {meta.total} registered users
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card padding={false}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <SearchBar
              value={search}
              onChange={(v) => {
                setSearch(v);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Search by name or email..."
            />
          </div>
          <div className="w-full sm:w-48">
            <Select
              value={role}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setRole(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              options={ROLE_OPTIONS}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <Table
            columns={columns}
            data={items}
            loading={loading}
            rowKey={(r) => r._id || r.id}
            onRowClick={(row) => navigate(`/tvetgrid/users/${row._id}`)}
            emptyMessage="No users found"
          />
          <Pagination
            page={meta.page}
            totalPages={meta.pages}
            onPageChange={setPage}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\bizhub\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_BIZHUB_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin';
const isDev = import.meta.env.DEV;

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

if (isDev) {
  api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
    console.log(`[${config.method?.toUpperCase()}] ${config.baseURL}${config.url}`);
    return config;
  });
}

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => {
    if (isDev) console.log(`[${response.status}] ${response.config.url}`);
    return response;
  },
  (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    const url = error.config?.url || 'unknown';
    if (status >= 500 || !status) {
      console.error(`[ERROR] ${status || 'NETWORK'} â€” ${url}`, error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    } else if (isDev) {
      console.warn(`[${status}] ${url} â€” ${error.response?.data?.message || error.message}`);
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) {
  refreshSubscribers.forEach((cb) => cb(token));
  refreshSubscribers = [];
}
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) {
  refreshSubscribers.push(cb);
}

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => {
      const body = response.data;

      if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'success' in body) {
        return {
          ...response,
          data: body.data,
          pagination: body.pagination,
          message: body.message,
          success: body.success,
          error: body.error,
        };
      }

      return response;
    },
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);

      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }

      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;

      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('bizhub_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');

        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
        const accessToken = res.data?.data?.accessToken || res.data?.accessToken;
        const newRefresh = res.data?.data?.refreshToken || res.data?.refreshToken;

        if (!accessToken) throw new Error('No access token in refresh response');

        localStorage.setItem('bizhub_token', accessToken);
        if (newRefresh) localStorage.setItem('bizhub_refresh_token', newRefresh);

        setAuthToken(accessToken);
        onRefreshed(accessToken);
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onRefreshed(null);
        localStorage.removeItem('bizhub_token');
        localStorage.removeItem('bizhub_refresh_token');
        localStorage.removeItem('bizhub_admin');
        if (typeof logoutFn === 'function') logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally {
        isRefreshing = false;
      }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

  return res.data;

export async function uploadBackup(file) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('backup', file);
  const res = await api.post('/backups/upload', formData, {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
  });
  return res.data;
}

export async function restoreBackup(id) {
  const res = await api.put(`/backups/${id}/restore`);
  return res.data;
}

export async function downloadBackup(id) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('bizhub_token');
  const response = await fetch(`${api.defaults.baseURL}/backups/${id}/download`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed');
  const blob = await response.blob();
  const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `backup-${id}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  return { success: true };
}

export async function emailBackup(id, email) {
  const res = await api.post(`/backups/${id}/email`, { email });
  return res.data;
}

export async function deleteBackup(id) {
  const res = await api.delete(`/backups/${id}`);
  return res.data;
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\bridge\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_BRIDGE_API || 'http://localhost:5000/admin/api';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      }
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
  );
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\eduprime\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_EDUPRIME_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    if (status >= 500 || !status) {
      console.error(`[ERROR] ${status || 'NETWORK'} â€” ${error.config?.url}`, error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) { refreshSubscribers.forEach(cb => cb(token)); refreshSubscribers = []; }
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) { refreshSubscribers.push(cb); }

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);
      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('eduprime_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');
        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
        const { token: accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh } = res.data.data || res.data;
        localStorage.setItem('eduprime_token', accessToken);
        localStorage.setItem('eduprime_refresh_token', newRefresh);
        setAuthToken(accessToken);
        onRefreshed(accessToken);
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onRefreshed(null);
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally { isRefreshing = false; }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\eduprime\auth.js =====
import api, { setAuthToken } from './api';

export async function login(email, password) {
  const res = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
  const d = res.data.data || res.data;
  localStorage.setItem('eduprime_token', d.token);
  localStorage.setItem('eduprime_refresh_token', d.refreshToken);
  localStorage.setItem('eduprime_admin', JSON.stringify(d.admin || d));
  setAuthToken(d.token);
  return res.data;
}

export async function getMe() {
  const res = await api.get('/auth/me');
  return res.data;
}

export async function logout() {
  localStorage.removeItem('eduprime_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('eduprime_refresh_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('eduprime_admin');
  setAuthToken(null);
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\farmvexa\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_FARMVEXA_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    if (status >= 500 || !status) {
      console.error(`[ERROR] ${status || 'NETWORK'} â€” ${error.config?.url}`, error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) { refreshSubscribers.forEach(cb => cb(token)); refreshSubscribers = []; }
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) { refreshSubscribers.push(cb); }

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);
      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('farmvexa_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');
        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
        const { token: accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh } = res.data.data || res.data;
        localStorage.setItem('farmvexa_token', accessToken);
        localStorage.setItem('farmvexa_refresh_token', newRefresh);
        setAuthToken(accessToken);
        onRefreshed(accessToken);
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onRefreshed(null);
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally { isRefreshing = false; }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

export async function uploadBackup(formData, token) {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/backups/upload`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
    body: formData,
  });
  return res.json();
}

export async function restoreBackup(id) {
  const res = await api.post(`/backups/${id}/restore`);
  return res.data;
}

export async function downloadBackup(id, filename, token) {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/backups/${id}/download`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  const blob = await res.blob();
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename || 'backup.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export async function emailBackup(id, email) {
  const res = await api.post(`/backups/${id}/email`, { email });
  return res.data;
}

  const res = await api.delete(`/backups/${id}`);
  return res.data;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\farmvexa\paymentMethods.js =====
import api from './api';

function normalizeMethodPayload(data = {}) {
  const out = { ...data };

  if (out.type && !out.code) out.code = out.type;
  if (out.name && !out.label) out.label = out.name;
  if (out.details && !out.config) out.config = out.details;

  delete out.type;
  delete out.name;
  delete out.details;
  delete out.isDefault;
  delete out._id;
  delete out.id;
  delete out.__v;

  if (!out.mode && out.code) {
    out.mode = out.code === 'mpesa_stk' || out.code === 'stripe' ? 'auto' : 'manual';
  }

  return out;
}

export async function getPaymentMethods() {
  const res = await api.get('/payment-methods');
  return res.data;
}

export async function createPaymentMethod(data) {
  const res = await api.post('/payment-methods', normalizeMethodPayload(data));
  return res.data;
}

export async function updatePaymentMethod(id, data) {
  const res = await api.put(`/payment-methods/${id}`, normalizeMethodPayload(data));
  return res.data;
}

export async function togglePaymentMethod(id) {
  const res = await api.put(`/payment-methods/${id}/toggle`);
  return res.data;
}

export async function deletePaymentMethod(id) {
  const res = await api.delete(`/payment-methods/${id}`);
  return res.data;
}

  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) { refreshSubscribers.forEach(cb => cb(token)); refreshSubscribers = []; }
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) { refreshSubscribers.push(cb); }

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);
      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally {
        isRefreshing = false;
      }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

export async function downloadBackup(id) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('flax_token');
  const response = await fetch(`${api.defaults.baseURL}/backups/${id}/download`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed');
  const disposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
  let filename = 'backup.json';
  if (disposition) {
    const match = disposition.match(/filename="?(.+?)"?$/);
    if (match) filename = match[1];
  }
  const blob = await response.blob();
  const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  return { success: true };
}

export async function emailBackup(id, email) {
  const res = await api.post(`/backups/${id}/send-email`, email ? { email } : {});
  return res.data;
}

  return res.data;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\hdmisp\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_HDMISP_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

let authToken = null;
let refreshHandler = null;
let unauthorizedHandler = null;
let refreshing = null;

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  authToken = token || null;
  if (authToken) {
    api.defaults.headers.common.Authorization = `Bearer ${authToken}`;
  } else {
    delete api.defaults.headers.common.Authorization;
  }
}

export function setupInterceptors({ getRefreshToken, onTokenRefreshed, onUnauthorized } = {}) {
  refreshHandler = async () => {
    const rt = getRefreshToken?.();
    if (!rt) throw new Error('No refresh token');

    if (refreshing) return refreshing;

    refreshing = (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await axios.post(
          `${API_BASE}/auth/refresh`,
          { refreshToken: rt },
          { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, timeout: 15000 }
        );
        const payload = res?.data?.data || res?.data;
        if (!payload?.accessToken) throw new Error('Refresh response missing accessToken');

        setAuthToken(payload.accessToken);
        onTokenRefreshed?.(payload);
        return payload.accessToken;
      } finally {
        refreshing = null;
      }
    })();

    return refreshing;
  };

  unauthorizedHandler = onUnauthorized || null;

  api.interceptors.request.use(
    (config) => {
      if (authToken) {
        config.headers = config.headers || {};
        config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${authToken}`;
      }
      return config;
    },
    (err) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(err))
  );

  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (res) => res,
    async (error) => {
      const original = error.config;
      const status = error.response?.status;
      const isRefreshCall = original?.url?.includes('/auth/refresh');
      const isLoginCall = original?.url?.includes('/auth/login');

      if (status === 401 && !original?._retry && !isRefreshCall && !isLoginCall && refreshHandler) {
        original._retry = true;
        try {
          await refreshHandler();
          return api(original);
        } catch {
          unauthorizedHandler?.();
          return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
        }
      }

      if (status === 401 && !isLoginCall && !isRefreshCall) {
        unauthorizedHandler?.();
      }

      return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
    }
  );
}

export function normalizeError(err) {
  if (!err) return { message: 'Unknown error', status: 0, payload: null };

  const res = err.response;
  const body = res?.data || {};
  const status = res?.status ?? 0;

  let message =
    body.message ||
    body.error?.message ||
    (typeof body === 'string' ? body : null) ||
    err.message ||
    'Request failed';

  if (status === 401) message = body.message || 'Session expired. Please sign in again.';
  if (status === 403) message = body.message || 'You do not have permission to do that.';
  if (status === 429) message = body.message || 'Too many requests. Please try again shortly.';
  if (status === 502) message = body.message || 'Upstream service failed. Try again.';
  if (status === 503) message = body.message || 'Service temporarily unavailable.';
  if (status >= 500 && !body.message) message = 'Server error. Please try again.';

  return {
    message,
    status,
    code: body.code || null,
    requestId: body.requestId || null,
    details: body.details || null,
    payload: body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : null,
  };
}

export function unwrap(res) {
  const body = res?.data;
  if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'success' in body) {
    return { data: body.data, meta: body.meta || null, message: body.message };
  }
  return { data: body, meta: null, message: null };
}

export async function get(url, config) {
  const res = await api.get(url, config);
  return unwrap(res);
}

export async function post(url, body, config) {
  const res = await api.post(url, body, config);
  return unwrap(res);
}

export async function patch(url, body, config) {
  const res = await api.patch(url, body, config);
  return unwrap(res);
}

export async function del(url, config) {
  const res = await api.delete(url, config);
  return unwrap(res);
}

export default api;

import api, { get, post, setAuthToken, unwrap } from './api';

export async function login(email, password) {
  const res = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
  const body = res?.data?.data || res?.data;
  if (!body?.accessToken) throw new Error('Login response missing accessToken');
  setAuthToken(body.accessToken);
  return body; // { accessToken, refreshToken, admin }
}

export async function refresh(refreshToken) {
  const res = await api.post('/auth/refresh', { refreshToken });
  const body = res?.data?.data || res?.data;
  if (!body?.accessToken) throw new Error('Refresh response missing accessToken');
  return body;
}

export async function me() {
  const { data } = await get('/auth/me');
  return data;
}

export async function changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) {
  const { data } = await post('/auth/change-password', { currentPassword, newPassword });
  return data;
}

export async function logout() {
  try {
    const { data } = await post('/auth/logout');
    return data;
  } catch {
    return { loggedOut: true };
  } finally {
    setAuthToken(null);
  }
}

export { setAuthToken };
export default { login, refresh, me, changePassword, logout };

    const res = await api.get('/health', { timeout: 10000 });
    return res?.data || null;
  } catch (err) {
    const norm = normalizeError(err);
    if (norm.status === 503 && norm.payload?.status) {
      return norm.payload;
    }
    throw norm;
  }
}

    const res = await api.get('/health/detailed', { timeout: 20000 });
    return res?.data || null;
  } catch (err) {
    const norm = normalizeError(err);
    if (norm.status === 503 && norm.payload?.server) {
      return norm.payload;
    }
    throw norm;
  }
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\marketbridge\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_MARKETBRIDGE_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) { refreshSubscribers.forEach(cb => cb(token)); refreshSubscribers = []; }
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) { refreshSubscribers.push(cb); }

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);
      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('marketbridge_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');
        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
        const { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh } = res.data;
        localStorage.setItem('marketbridge_token', accessToken);
        localStorage.setItem('marketbridge_refresh_token', newRefresh);
        setAuthToken(accessToken);
        onRefreshed(accessToken);
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onRefreshed(null);
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally { isRefreshing = false; }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\meteo\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_METEO_API || 'http://localhost:5000/admin';

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

export function setupInterceptors({ onUnauthorized } = {}) {
  api.interceptors.request.use(
    (config) => {
      if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) {
        config.headers['X-Request-Id'] = crypto.randomUUID();
      }
      return config;
    },
    (error) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(error))
  );

  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    (error) => {
      const status = error.response?.status;
      const code = error.response?.data?.code;

      if (status === 401) {
        onUnauthorized?.();
      }

      if (status === 403 && code === 'SUPER_ADMIN_REQUIRED') {
        // Surface as-is; pages can decide how to handle it
      }

      return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
    }
  );
}

export function normalizeError(error) {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error && 'code' in error) {
    return error;
  }

  const res = error?.response;
  const data = res?.data;

  const code =
    data?.code ||
    data?.error?.code ||
    (res?.status ? `HTTP_${res.status}` : 'NETWORK_ERROR');

  const message =
    data?.message ||
    data?.error?.message ||
    error?.message ||
    'Something went wrong';

  return {
    status: res?.status ?? 0,
    code,
    message,
    details: data?.details ?? null,
    requestId: data?.requestId ?? null,
    isNetwork: !res,
    isServer: (res?.status ?? 0) >= 500,
    isForbidden: res?.status === 403,
    isSuperAdminRequired: code === 'SUPER_ADMIN_REQUIRED',
    raw: error,
  };
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\nexguard\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_NEXGUARD_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    if (status >= 500 || !status) {
      console.error(`[ERROR] ${status || 'NETWORK'} â€” ${error.config?.url}`, error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

let isRefreshing = false;
let refreshSubscribers = [];

function onRefreshed(token) { refreshSubscribers.forEach(cb => cb(token)); refreshSubscribers = []; }
function addRefreshSubscriber(cb) { refreshSubscribers.push(cb); }

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);
      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          addRefreshSubscriber((token) => {
            if (!token) return reject(new Error('Session expired'));
            originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
            resolve(api(originalRequest));
          });
        });
      }
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('nexguard_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');
        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
        const { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh } = res.data;
        localStorage.setItem('nexguard_token', accessToken);
        localStorage.setItem('nexguard_refresh_token', newRefresh);
        setAuthToken(accessToken);
        onRefreshed(accessToken);
        originalRequest.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${accessToken}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onRefreshed(null);
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      } finally { isRefreshing = false; }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
  });

  const res = await api.get(`/backups/${id}`);
  return res.data;

export async function downloadBackup(id) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('nexguard_token');
  const response = await fetch(`${api.defaults.baseURL}/backups/${id}/download`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed');
  const blob = await response.blob();
  const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `backup-${id}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  return { success: true };
}

  const res = await api.post(`/backups/${id}/send-email`, { email });

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\pharmasys\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_PHARMASYS_API ||
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

let getRefreshToken = () => null;
let onTokenRefreshed = () => {};
let onUnauthorized = () => {};

export function setupInterceptors({
  getRefreshToken: getRT,
  onTokenRefreshed: onRefreshed,
  onUnauthorized: onUnauth,
} = {}) {
  if (getRT) getRefreshToken = getRT;
  if (onRefreshed) onTokenRefreshed = onRefreshed;
  if (onUnauth) onUnauthorized = onUnauth;
}

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) {
    api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  } else {
    delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
  }
}

api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) {
      config.headers['X-Request-Id'] = crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(error))
);

let refreshPromise = null;

async function refreshAccessToken() {
  const refreshToken = getRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');

  const res = await axios.post(
    `${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`,
    { refreshToken },
    { timeout: 15000 }
  );

  const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
  const accessToken = payload?.accessToken || payload?.token;
  const newRefresh = payload?.refreshToken;

  if (!accessToken) throw new Error('Refresh did not return access token');

  onTokenRefreshed({ accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh || refreshToken });
  setAuthToken(accessToken);

  return accessToken;
}

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    const original = error.config;

    if (!original) return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));

    const url = original.url || '';
    const isAuthEndpoint =
      url.includes('/auth/login') || url.includes('/auth/refresh');

    if (status === 401 && !original._retry && !isAuthEndpoint) {
      original._retry = true;

      try {
        if (!refreshPromise) {
          refreshPromise = refreshAccessToken().finally(() => {
            refreshPromise = null;
          });
        }

        const newToken = await refreshPromise;

        original.headers = original.headers || {};
        original.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${newToken}`;

        return api(original);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onUnauthorized();
        return Promise.reject(normalizeError(refreshErr));
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
  }
);

export function normalizeError(error) {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error && 'code' in error) {
    return error;
  }

  const res = error?.response;
  const data = res?.data;

  const code =
    data?.error?.code ||
    data?.code ||
    (res?.status ? `HTTP_${res.status}` : 'NETWORK_ERROR');

  const message =
    data?.error?.message ||
    data?.message ||
    error?.message ||
    'Something went wrong';

  return {
    status: res?.status ?? 0,
    code,
    message,
    details: data?.error?.details ?? data?.details ?? null,
    requestId: data?.error?.requestId ?? null,
    isNetwork: !res,
    isServer: (res?.status ?? 0) >= 500,
    raw: error,
  };
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\portfolio\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const ADMIN_BASE =
  import.meta.env.VITE_PORTFOLIO_API || '/hdm/api/admin';

const ROOT = ADMIN_BASE.replace(/\/hdm\/api\/admin\/?$/, '');

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: ADMIN_BASE,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export const publicApi = axios.create({
  baseURL: `${ROOT}/hdm/api`,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.request.use(
    (config) => {
      if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) {
        config.headers['X-Request-Id'] = crypto.randomUUID();
      }
      return config;
    },
    (error) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(error))
  );

  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    (error) => {
      if (error.response?.status === 401) logoutFn?.();
      return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
    }
  );
}

export function normalizeError(error) {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error && 'code' in error) {
    return error;
  }

  const res = error?.response;
  const data = res?.data;

  const code =
    data?.code ||
    data?.error?.code ||
    (res?.status ? `HTTP_${res.status}` : 'NETWORK_ERROR');

  const message =
    data?.message ||
    data?.error?.message ||
    error?.message ||
    'Something went wrong';

  return {
    status: res?.status ?? 0,
    code,
    message,
    details: data?.details ?? data?.error?.details ?? null,
    isNetwork: !res,
    isServer: (res?.status ?? 0) >= 500,
    raw: error,
  };
}

export default api;

export async function downloadBackup(id) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('portfolio_token');
  const baseUrl =
    import.meta.env.VITE_PORTFOLIO_API ||
    `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000'}/hdm/api/admin`;
  const url = `${baseUrl}/backups/${id}/download`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Download failed');
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const objectUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = objectUrl;
    a.download = `backup-${id}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  } catch (err) {
    // Fallback: open the URL directly (backend may 302-redirect to Cloudinary)
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }
}

const triggerBlobDownload = (blob, filename) => {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    a.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);
};

export async function downloadInvoicePdf(request) {
  const id = request._id || request.id;
  const res = await api.get(`/payment-requests/${id}/invoice.pdf`, {
    responseType: 'blob',
  });
  const filename = `${request.invoiceNumber || request.reference || 'invoice'}.pdf`;
  triggerBlobDownload(res.data, filename);
}

export async function downloadReceiptPdf(request) {
  const id = request._id || request.id;
  const res = await api.get(`/payment-requests/${id}/receipt.pdf`, {
    responseType: 'blob',
  });
  const name =
    request.mpesaReceiptNumber ||
    request.invoiceNumber ||
    request.reference ||
    'receipt';
  triggerBlobDownload(res.data, `Receipt-${name}.pdf`);
}

export async function downloadStatementPdf({ from, to, month, status } = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (month) params.set('month', month);
  else {
    if (from) params.set('from', from);
    if (to) params.set('to', to);
  }
  if (status) params.set('status', status);

  const query = params.toString();
  const url = `/payment-requests/statement.pdf${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;

  const res = await api.get(url, { responseType: 'blob' });

  const label = month || (from && to ? `${from}_to_${to}` : from || to || 'Full');
  const filename = `Statement-${label}.pdf`;

  triggerBlobDownload(res.data, filename);
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\rvnp\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_RVNP_API || 'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    if (status >= 500 || !status) {
      console.error(`[ERROR] ${status || 'NETWORK'} â€” ${error.config?.url}`, error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

export function setupInterceptors(logoutFn) {
  api.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    async (error) => {
      const originalRequest = error.config;
      if (error.response?.status !== 401 || originalRequest._retry) return Promise.reject(error);

      originalRequest._retry = true;

      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('rvnp_refresh_token');
        if (!refreshToken) {
          logoutFn();
          return Promise.reject(new Error('No refresh token'));
        }

        const res = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh-token`, { refreshToken });
        const d = res.data.data || res.data;
        const accessToken = d.accessToken;
        const newRefresh = d.refreshToken;

        localStorage.setItem('rvnp_token', accessToken);
        localStorage.setItem('rvnp_refresh_token', newRefresh);
        setAuthToken(accessToken);

        // CRITICAL: Recreate headers object with fresh token
        originalRequest.headers = {
          ...originalRequest.headers,
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
        };

        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        logoutFn();
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expired'));
      }
    }
  );
}

export default api;

import api, { setAuthToken } from './api';

export async function login(email, password) {
  const res = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
  const d = res.data.data || res.data;
  localStorage.setItem('rvnp_token', d.accessToken);
  localStorage.setItem('rvnp_refresh_token', d.refreshToken);
  localStorage.setItem('rvnp_admin', JSON.stringify(d.admin || d));
  setAuthToken(d.accessToken);
  return res.data;
}

export async function logout() {
  localStorage.removeItem('rvnp_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('rvnp_refresh_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('rvnp_admin');

}

export async function downloadBackup(filename, token) {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/backups/download/${filename}`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  const blob = await res.blob();
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

  const res = await api.post(`/backups/send-email/${filename}`, data);
  return res.data;
}

  return res.data;

  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/backups/upload-restore`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
    body: formData,
  });
  return res.json();
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\smartpos\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_SMARTPOS_API ||
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:5000/api/admin';

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

let getRefreshToken = () => null;
let onTokenRefreshed = () => {};
let onUnauthorized = () => {};

export function setupInterceptors({
  getRefreshToken: getRT,
  onTokenRefreshed: onRefreshed,
  onUnauthorized: onUnauth,
} = {}) {
  if (getRT) getRefreshToken = getRT;
  if (onRefreshed) onTokenRefreshed = onRefreshed;
  if (onUnauth) onUnauthorized = onUnauth;
}

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) {
    api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  } else {
    delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
  }
}

api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) {
      config.headers['X-Request-Id'] = crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(error))
);

let refreshPromise = null;

async function refreshAccessToken() {
  const refreshToken = getRefreshToken();
  if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token');

  const res = await axios.post(
    `${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`,
    { refreshToken },
    { timeout: 15000 }
  );

  const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
  const accessToken = payload?.accessToken || payload?.token;
  const newRefresh = payload?.refreshToken;

  if (!accessToken) throw new Error('Refresh did not return access token');

  onTokenRefreshed({ accessToken, refreshToken: newRefresh || refreshToken });
  setAuthToken(accessToken);

  return accessToken;
}

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    const original = error.config;

    if (!original) return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));

    const url = original.url || '';
    const isAuthEndpoint =
      url.includes('/auth/login') || url.includes('/auth/refresh');

    if (status === 401 && !original._retry && !isAuthEndpoint) {
      original._retry = true;

      try {
        if (!refreshPromise) {
          refreshPromise = refreshAccessToken().finally(() => {
            refreshPromise = null;
          });
        }

        const newToken = await refreshPromise;

        original.headers = original.headers || {};
        original.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${newToken}`;

        return api(original);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onUnauthorized();
        return Promise.reject(normalizeError(refreshErr));
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
  }
);

export function normalizeError(error) {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error && 'code' in error) {
    return error;
  }

  const res = error?.response;
  const data = res?.data;

  const code =
    data?.error?.code ||
    data?.code ||
    (res?.status ? `HTTP_${res.status}` : 'NETWORK_ERROR');

  const message =
    data?.error?.message ||
    data?.message ||
    error?.message ||
    'Something went wrong';

  return {
    status: res?.status ?? 0,
    code,
    message,
    details: data?.error?.details ?? data?.details ?? null,
    isNetwork: !res,
    isServer: (res?.status ?? 0) >= 500,
    raw: error,
  };
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\tvetgrid\api.js =====
import axios from 'axios';

const ROOT = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000';
const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_TVETGRID_API || `${ROOT}/api/admin`;

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

export function setAuthToken(token) {
  if (token) api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  else delete api.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
}

// â”€â”€â”€ Silent refresh state â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
let getAccessToken = () => null;
let getRefreshToken = () => null;
let onRefresh = async () => null;
let onRefreshSuccess = () => {};
let onUnauthorized = () => {};
let refreshPromise = null;

export function setupInterceptors({
  getAccessToken: gAT,
  getRefreshToken: gRT,
  onRefresh: oR,
  onRefreshSuccess: oRS,
  onUnauthorized: oU,
} = {}) {
  if (gAT) getAccessToken = gAT;
  if (gRT) getRefreshToken = gRT;
  if (oR) onRefresh = oR;
  if (oRS) onRefreshSuccess = oRS;
  if (oU) onUnauthorized = oU;
}

api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) {
      config.headers['X-Request-Id'] = crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(normalizeError(error))
);

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const status = error.response?.status;
    const code = error.response?.data?.code;
    const original = error.config;

    if (!original) return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));

    const url = original.url || '';
    const isAuthEndpoint =
      url.includes('/auth/login') ||
      url.includes('/auth/refresh') ||
      url.includes('/auth/logout');

    // Silent refresh on TOKEN_EXPIRED (or 401 on protected routes)
    const shouldRefresh =
      status === 401 &&
      !original._retry &&
      !isAuthEndpoint &&
      (code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED' || !code);

    if (shouldRefresh) {
      original._retry = true;

      try {
        if (!refreshPromise) {
          refreshPromise = onRefresh().finally(() => {
            refreshPromise = null;
          });
        }

        const newToken = await refreshPromise;

        original.headers = original.headers || {};
        original.headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${newToken}`;

        return api(original);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        onUnauthorized();
        return Promise.reject(normalizeError(refreshErr));
      }
    }

    // Any other 401 â†’ logout
    if (status === 401) {
      onUnauthorized();
    }

    return Promise.reject(normalizeError(error));
  }
);

export function normalizeError(error) {
  if (error && typeof error === 'object' && 'status' in error && 'code' in error) {
    return error;
  }

  const res = error?.response;
  const data = res?.data;

  const code =
    data?.code ||
    data?.error?.code ||
    (res?.status ? `HTTP_${res.status}` : 'NETWORK_ERROR');

  const message =
    data?.error ||
    data?.message ||
    data?.error?.message ||
    error?.message ||
    'Something went wrong';

  return {
    status: res?.status ?? 0,
    code,
    message: typeof message === 'string' ? message : 'Request failed',
    details: data?.details ?? null,
    isNetwork: !res,
    isServer: (res?.status ?? 0) >= 500,
    isForbidden: res?.status === 403,
    isNotFound: res?.status === 404,
    isValidation: code === 'VALIDATION_001',
    raw: error,
  };
}

export default api;

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\services\tvetgrid\upload.js =====
export async function uploadToCloudinary(file, signature, onProgress) {
  const { uploadUrl, apiKey, timestamp, signature: sig, folder, uploadPreset } = signature;

  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('file', file);
  form.append('api_key', apiKey);
  form.append('timestamp', String(timestamp));
  form.append('signature', sig);
  form.append('folder', folder);
  if (uploadPreset) form.append('upload_preset', uploadPreset);

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('POST', uploadUrl);

    if (onProgress) {
      xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev) => {
        if (ev.lengthComputable) {
          onProgress(Math.round((ev.loaded / ev.total) * 100));
        }
      };
    }

    xhr.onload = () => {
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        try {
          resolve(JSON.parse(xhr.responseText));
        } catch {
          reject(new Error('Invalid response from Cloudinary'));
        }
      } else {
        let msg = `Upload failed (${xhr.status})`;
        try {
          const body = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
          if (body?.error?.message) msg = `${msg}: ${body.error.message}`;
        } catch { /* ignore */ }
        reject(new Error(msg));
      }
    };
    xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Upload network error'));
    xhr.send(form);
  });
}

              <HiClock className={`text-4xl ${system.textColor}`} />

            </p>

            <button

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\bizhub\formatDate.js =====
export function formatDate(dateString, format = 'DD/MM/YYYY') {
  if (!dateString) return 'N/A';
  const date = new Date(dateString);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Invalid date';
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  switch (format) {
    case 'DD/MM/YYYY': return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
    case 'full': return date.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    default: return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  }
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\bridge\validators.js =====
export function validateEmail(email) {
  if (!email) return 'Email is required';
  const re = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  return re.test(email) ? '' : 'Invalid email address';
}

export function validatePassword(password) {
  if (!password) return 'Password is required';
  if (password.length < 6) return 'Password must be at least 6 characters';
  return '';
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\eduprime\formatters.js =====
const EXCHANGE_RATES = {
  USD: 1,
  EUR: 0.92,
  GBP: 0.79,
  KES: 130,
  NGN: 1550,
  ZAR: 18.5,
  GHS: 15.5,
  TZS: 2650,
  UGX: 3750,
};

const NO_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES = ['KES', 'UGX', 'TZS', 'NGN', 'GHS'];

export function formatCurrency(amount, currency = 'USD') {
  if (amount === null || amount === undefined) return 'â€”';
  const num = Number(amount);
  const rate = EXCHANGE_RATES[currency] || 1;
  const converted = num * rate;

  if (NO_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES.includes(currency)) {
    return `${currency} ${Math.round(converted).toLocaleString()}`;
  }

  return `${currency} ${converted.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

export function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024));
  return `${(bytes / Math.pow(1024, i)).toFixed(1)} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

    case 'approved':
    case 'verified':
      return 'success';
    case 'pending':
    case 'unverified':
    case 'awaiting_payment':
    case 'awaiting_approval':
      return 'warning';
    case 'failed':
    case 'rejected':
    case 'suspended':
    case 'cancelled':
    case 'expired':
      return 'danger';
    case 'support':
      return 'info';
    case 'superadmin':
      return 'warning';
    default:
      return 'default';
  }
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\hdmisp\formatDate.js =====
const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

function toDate(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const d = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

export function formatDate(value, style = 'short') {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return 'â€”';

  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();

  if (style === 'DD/MM/YYYY') return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
  if (style === 'full') return `${dd} ${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${yyyy}`;
  return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy}`;
}

export function formatDateTime(value) {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return 'â€”';
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const mi = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${dd}/${mm}/${yyyy} ${hh}:${mi}`;
}

export function relativeTime(value) {
  const d = toDate(value);
  if (!d) return 'â€”';

  const diff = Date.now() - d.getTime();
  const sec = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
  if (sec < 45) return 'just now';
  const min = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;
  const hr = Math.floor(min / 60);
  if (hr < 24) return `${hr}h ago`;
  const day = Math.floor(hr / 24);
  if (day < 30) return `${day}d ago`;
  const mo = Math.floor(day / 30);
  if (mo < 12) return `${mo}mo ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(mo / 12)}y ago`;
}

export function todayISO() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function daysAgoISO(days) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function formatDate(dateString, format = 'DD/MM/YYYY') {
  if (!dateString) return 'N/A';
  const date = new Date(dateString);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Invalid date';
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  switch (format) {
    case 'DD/MM/YYYY': return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
    case 'full': return date.toLocaleDateString('en-KE', { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    default: return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  }
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\meteo\formatDate.js =====
const LOCALE = 'en-KE';

export function formatDate(input, style = 'DD/MM/YYYY') {
  if (!input) return 'â€”';
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'â€”';

  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

  switch (style) {
    case 'full':
      return date.toLocaleDateString(LOCALE, {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'long',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
    case 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm':
      return `${day}/${month}/${year} ${hours}:${minutes}`;
    case 'DD/MM/YYYY':
    default:
      return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  }
}

export function formatTime(input) {
  if (!input) return 'â€”';
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'â€”';
  return date.toLocaleTimeString(LOCALE, {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

export function formatDateTime(input) {
  if (!input) return 'â€”';
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'â€”';
  return `${formatDate(date)} ${formatTime(date)}`;
}

export function relativeTime(input) {
  if (!input) return 'â€”';
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'â€”';

  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
  const s = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);

  if (s < 60) return 'just now';
  if (m < 60) return `${m}m ago`;
  if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
  if (d < 30) return `${d}d ago`;
  return formatDate(date);
}

export function toISO(input) {
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  return date.toISOString();
}

export function isToday(input) {
  if (!input) return false;
  const date = input instanceof Date ? input : new Date(input);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return false;
  const now = new Date();
  return (
    date.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() &&
    date.getMonth() === now.getMonth() &&
    date.getDate() === now.getDate()
  );
}

===== D:\Dev\HDM-ADMIN\src\utils\meteo\formatMoney.js =====
const SYMBOLS = {
  KES: 'KSh',
  USD: '$',
  EUR: 'â‚¬',
  GBP: 'Â£',
  TZS: 'TSh',
  UGX: 'USh',
  NGN: 'â‚¦',
  GHS: 'â‚µ',
  ZAR: 'R',
  RWF: 'FRw',
  BIF: 'FBu',
};

const NO_DECIMAL = new Set(['KES', 'UGX', 'TZS', 'NGN', 'GHS', 'RWF', 'BIF']);

export function getCurrencySymbol(code) {
  return SYMBOLS[code] || code || '';
}

export function toMinor(amount) {
  return Math.round(Number(amount || 0) * 100);
}

export function toMajor(amountMinor) {
  return Number(amountMinor || 0) / 100;
}

export function formatMoney(amountMinor, currency = 'KES') {
  const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(currency);
  const major = toMajor(amountMinor);
  const noDecimals = NO_DECIMAL.has(currency);

  const formatted = major.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: noDecimals ? 0 : 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: noDecimals ? 0 : 2,
  });

  return `${symbol} ${formatted}`;
}

export function formatMoneyMajor(amount, currency = 'KES') {
  const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(currency);
  const n = Number(amount || 0);
  const noDecimals = NO_DECIMAL.has(currency);

  const formatted = n.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: noDecimals ? 0 : 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: noDecimals ? 0 : 2,
  });

  return `${symbol} ${formatted}`;
}

export function formatPrice(amountMinor) {
  return toMajor(amountMinor).toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });
}

export default {
  toMinor,
  toMajor,
  getCurrencySymbol,
  formatMoney,
  formatMoneyMajor,
  formatPrice,
};

export function capitalize(s) {
  return s ? s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) : '';
}

export function titleCase(s) {
  return String(s || '')
    .replace(/\w\S*/g, (w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase());
}

export function truncate(s, len, suffix = 'â€¦') {
  const str = String(s || '');
  return str.length > len ? str.slice(0, len) + suffix : str;
}

export function initials(name) {
  return String(name || '')
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((p) => p[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');
}

export function maskEmail(email) {
  const [user, domain] = String(email || '').split('@');
  if (!domain) return '[redacted]';
  return `${user.slice(0, 2)}***@${domain}`;
}

export function maskPhone(phone) {
  const s = String(phone || '');
  if (s.length < 6) return '[redacted]';
  return `${s.slice(0, 4)}***${s.slice(-2)}`;
}

export function bytes(n) {
  const num = Number(n || 0);
  if (num < 1024) return `${num} B`;
  if (num < 1024 * 1024) return `${(num / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  if (num < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(num / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`;
  return `${(num / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}

export function number(n, locale = 'en-KE') {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(Number(n || 0));
}

export function percent(n, digits = 1) {
  return `${Number(n || 0).toFixed(digits)}%`;
}

export function pluralize(count, singular, plural) {
  return `${count} ${count === 1 ? singular : plural || `${singular}s`}`;
}

export function randomId() {
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
}

export function humanizeKey(key) {
  return String(key || '')
    .replace(/[_-]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase())
    .trim();
}
